mahyaṃ ca svasutāṃ śīghraṃ samarpaya sukhī bhava .. 9 ..
3.2.d:
तृतीयश्चाह भो राजन्धनपालाय शोभिने ॥
सर्वजीवस्य भाषाणां ज्ञायिने गुणरूपिणे ॥
मह्यं च स्वसुतां शीघ्रं समर्पय सुखी भव ॥ 9 ॥
3.2.m: The third said: “O king, give your daughter quickly / to me, splendid Dhanapāla, who knows the languages of all living beings and is endowed with virtues, / and be happy!”

3.2.s:
caturthaścāha bho rājansarvakalāsu kovidaḥ ..
pañcaratnasamudyogī pratyahaṃ bhūpate hyaham .. .. 3.2.7.10 ..
3.2.d:
चतुर्थश्चाह भो राजन्सर्वकलासु कोविदः ॥
पञ्चरत्नसमुद्योगी प्रत्यहं भूपते ह्यहम् ॥ ॥ 3.2.7.10 ॥
3.2.m: And the fourth said: “O king, I am skilled in all the arts. / Every day, O king, I endeavour to procure five jewels:

3.2.s:
puṇyārthamekaratnaṃ ca homārthaṃ dvitiyaṃ vasu ..
ātmārthaṃ tṛtiyaṃ ratnaṃ patnyarthe turiyaṃ vasu .. 11 ..
3.2.d:
पुण्यार्थमेकरत्नं च होमार्थं द्वितियं वसु ॥
आत्मार्थं तृतियं रत्नं पत्न्यर्थे तुरियं वसु ॥ 11 ॥
3.2.m: one jewel for spiritual merit, a second wealth for the fire-offering, / a third jewel for myself, and a fourth wealth for my wife.

3.2.s:
śeṣaṃ subhojanārthaṃ ca ratnaṃ nityaṃ mayāhṛtam ..
īdṛgvidhaṃ māṃ puruṣaṃ svasutāṃ dātumarhasi .. 12 ..
3.2.d:
शेषं सुभोजनार्थं च रत्नं नित्यं मयाहृतम् ॥
ईदृग्विधं मां पुरुषं स्वसुतां दातुमर्हसि ॥ 12 ॥
3.2.m: The remaining jewel brought by me daily is for fine food. / You ought to give your daughter to such a man as me.”

3.2.s:
iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ mohito nṛpatistadā ..
svasutāṃ prāha dharmātmā kasmai dāsyāmi kanyake .. 13 ..
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां मोहितो नृपतिस्तदा ॥
स्वसुतां प्राह धर्मात्मा कस्मै दास्यामि कन्यके ॥ 13 ॥
3.2.m: Hearing their words, the righteous king, bewildered at that time, / said to his daughter: “To whom shall I give you, O maiden?”

3.2.s:
sā devī tu vacaḥ śrutvā vrīḍitā daivamohitā ..
nottaraṃ ca dadau tasmai svapitre dharmaśālinī .. 14 ..
3.2.d:
सा देवी तु वचः श्रुत्वा व्रीडिता दैवमोहिता ॥
नोत्तरं च ददौ तस्मै स्वपित्रे धर्मशालिनी ॥ 14 ॥
3.2.m: Hearing his words, the virtuous maiden, modest and bewildered by destiny, / gave no answer to her father.

3.2.s:
ityuktvā sa tu vaitālo vihasyovāca bhūpatim ..
kasmai yogyā bhavetkanyā rūpayauvanaśālinī .. 15 ..
3.2.d:
इत्युक्त्वा स तु वैतालो विहस्योवाच भूपतिम् ॥
कस्मै योग्या भवेत्कन्या रूपयौवनशालिनी ॥ 15 ॥
3.2.m: Having said this, the vetāla laughed and said to the king: / “To whom would the maiden, endowed with beauty and youth, be suited?”

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ityuktaḥ sa tu bhūpālo vacanaṃ taṃ samabravīt ..
dharmadattāya sā kanyā yogyā bhavati rūpiṇī .. 16 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
इत्युक्तः स तु भूपालो वचनं तं समब्रवीत् ॥
धर्मदत्ताय सा कन्या योग्या भवति रूपिणी ॥ 16 ॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / Being addressed thus, the king spoke this reply to him: / “That beautiful maiden is suitable for Dharmadatta.

3.2.s:
sarvaśāstreṣu nipuṇaḥ sa dvijo varṇataḥ smṛtaḥ ..
bhāṣāvettā tu vaṇijo dhanadhānya prasārakaḥ ..17..
3.2.d:
सर्वशास्त्रेषु निपुणः स द्विजो वर्णतः स्मृतः ॥
भाषावेत्ता तु वणिजो धनधान्य प्रसारकः ॥17॥
3.2.m: The one skilled in all scriptures is traditionally regarded as a twice-born by caste; / the one who knows languages is a merchant, an expander of wealth and grain;

3.2.s:
kalājñaḥ sa tu śūdro hi dhanurvedī sa bhūpatiḥ..
savarṇāya ca vaitāla sadā yogyā hi kanyakā ..
ato vivāhitā bālā dharmadattāya śīline..18..
tulanīya - kathāsaritsāgare vetālapañcaviṃśati
campā śabdopari ṭippaṇī
3.2.d:
कलाज्ञः स तु शूद्रो हि धनुर्वेदी स भूपतिः॥
सवर्णाय च वैताल सदा योग्या हि कन्यका ॥
अतो विवाहिता बाला धर्मदत्ताय शीलिने॥18॥
तुलनीय - कथासरित्सागरे वेतालपञ्चविंशति
चम्पा शब्दोपरि टिप्पणी
3.2.m:
the one who knows the arts is indeed a śūdra, and the one who knows archery is a king. / A maiden, O vetāla, is always suited to one of her own caste; / therefore, the girl was wedded to the well-behaved Dharmadatta.”
[Compare: Vetālapañcaviṃśati in the Kathāsaritsāgara]
[Note on the word Campā]

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iti śrutvā sa vaitālo rājānamidamabravīt ..
videhadeśe bhūpāla nagarī mithilāvatī .. 1 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
इति श्रुत्वा स वैतालो राजानमिदमब्रवीत् ॥
विदेहदेशे भूपाल नगरी मिथिलावती ॥ 1 ॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / Hearing this, the vetāla said this to the king: / “In the country of Videha, O king, there is the city Mithilāvatī.

3.2.s:
guṇādhipastatra rājā dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ ..
ciraṃdeva iti khyāto rājanyaḥ kaścanāgataḥ .. 2 ..
3.2.d:
गुणाधिपस्तत्र राजा धनधान्यसमन्वितः ॥
चिरंदेव इति ख्यातो राजन्यः कश्चनागतः ॥ 2 ॥
3.2.m: Guṇādhipa, endowed with wealth and grain, was the king there. / A certain nobleman named Ciraṃdeva arrived there

3.2.s:
vṛttyarthaṃ mithilādeśe tatra vāsaṃ cakāra saḥ ..
varṣāṃte bhūpatiḥ so'pi caturaṅgabalānvitaḥ .. 3 ..
3.2.d:
वृत्त्यर्थं मिथिलादेशे तत्र वासं चकार सः ॥
वर्षांते भूपतिः सोऽपि चतुरङ्गबलान्वितः ॥ 3 ॥
3.2.m: for the sake of livelihood, and made his dwelling in the country of Mithilā. / At the end of a year, that king, accompanied by his fourfold army,

3.2.s:
mṛgayārthe vanaṃ prāptastatra śārdūlamuttamam ..
dṛṣṭvā taṃ cāvadhīdrājā krodhatāmrekṣaṇo vane .. 4 ..
3.2.d:
मृगयार्थे वनं प्राप्तस्तत्र शार्दूलमुत्तमम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा तं चावधीद्राजा क्रोधताम्रेक्षणो वने ॥ 4 ॥
3.2.m: reached a forest for hunting. Seeing a magnificent tiger there, / the king, his eyes copper-red with rage, killed it in the forest.

3.2.s:
vyāghra mārgeṇa bhūpālo vanāntaramupāyayau ..
ciraṃdevastu tatpaścādgataḥ sa gahane vane .. 5 ..
3.2.d:
व्याघ्र मार्गेण भूपालो वनान्तरमुपाययौ ॥
चिरंदेवस्तु तत्पश्चाद्गतः स गहने वने ॥ 5 ॥
3.2.m: Following the tiger's trail, the king came to another forest. / Ciraṃdeva followed after him into the dense forest.

3.2.s:
kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭho nṛpatiḥ śramasantāpapīḍitaḥ ..
ciraṃdevamuvācāśu bhojanaṃ dehi me'dya bhoḥ .. 6 ..
3.2.d:
क्षुत्क्षामकण्ठो नृपतिः श्रमसन्तापपीडितः ॥
चिरंदेवमुवाचाशु भोजनं देहि मेऽद्य भोः ॥ 6 ॥
3.2.m: His throat emaciated by hunger, oppressed by fatigue and heat, / the king quickly said to Ciraṃdeva: ‘Give me food today, friend!’

3.2.s:
iti śrutvā sa rājanyo hatvā hariṇamuttamam ..
saṃskṛtya pradadau rājñe tanmāṃsaṃ bhūpatipriyam .. 7 ...
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स राजन्यो हत्वा हरिणमुत्तमम् ॥
संस्कृत्य प्रददौ राज्ञे तन्मांसं भूपतिप्रियम् ॥ 7 ॥।
3.2.m: Hearing this, that nobleman killed an excellent deer, / prepared its meat, which was pleasing to the king, and gave it to the ruler.

3.2.s:
tuṣṭo bhūpastadā prāha varaṃ varaya sattama ..
vāṃchitaṃ te dadāmyāśu sa hovāca mahīpatim.. 8..
3.2.d:
तुष्टो भूपस्तदा प्राह वरं वरय सत्तम ॥
वांछितं ते ददाम्याशु स होवाच महीपतिम्॥ 8॥
3.2.m: Gratified, the king then said: ‘Choose a boon, O best of men! / I shall quickly give you whatever you desire.’ He said to the king:

3.2.s:
tvayā sahasramudrāśca khāditā mama bhūpate..
gṛhamānīya bhūpāla tāḥ samarpaya mā ciram..9..
3.2.d:
त्वया सहस्रमुद्राश्च खादिता मम भूपते॥
गृहमानीय भूपाल ताः समर्पय मा चिरम्॥9॥
3.2.m: "A thousand coins of mine have been consumed by you, O lord of the earth! / Bring them to my house, O protector of the earth, and hand them over without delay.

3.2.s:
śatamudrāstu māsānte mahyaṃ dehi kuṭuṃbine..
tathetyuktvā sa nṛpatiḥ svagehaṃ śīghramāyayau.. 3.2.8.10..
3.2.d:
शतमुद्रास्तु मासान्ते मह्यं देहि कुटुंबिने॥
तथेत्युक्त्वा स नृपतिः स्वगेहं शीघ्रमाययौ॥ 3.2.8.10॥
3.2.m:
And at the end of the month, give a hundred coins to me, a householder."
Saying "So be it," the king quickly returned to his own house.

3.2.s:
ekasmindivase rājansa ca rājā guṇādhipaḥ..
ciraṃdevaṃ svabhṛtyaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa sāgare..11..
3.2.d:
एकस्मिन्दिवसे राजन्स च राजा गुणाधिपः॥
चिरंदेवं स्वभृत्यं च प्रेषयामास सागरे॥11॥
3.2.m: One day, O king, that king Guṇādhipa / sent his servant Ciraṃdeva to the ocean.

3.2.s:
sa gatvā sāgarataṭe devīmūrtiṃ dadarśa ha..
nāmnā kusumadāṃ devīṃ mārkaṇḍeyasthalasthitām..12..
3.2.d:
स गत्वा सागरतटे देवीमूर्तिं ददर्श ह॥
नाम्ना कुसुमदां देवीं मार्कण्डेयस्थलस्थिताम्॥12॥
3.2.m: Having gone, he indeed saw the image of the goddess on the ocean shore, / the goddess named Kusumadā, standing in the sacred site of Mārkaṇḍeya.

3.2.s:
gandharvatanayāṃ subhrūṃ pūjayitvā prasannadhīḥ..
prāṃjaliḥ puratastasthau tadā devī samāgatā. .. 13 ..
3.2.d:
गन्धर्वतनयां सुभ्रूं पूजयित्वा प्रसन्नधीः॥
प्रांजलिः पुरतस्तस्थौ तदा देवी समागता॥। 13 ॥
3.2.m: Having worshipped the daughter of the Gandharva, the fair-browed one, with a serene mind, / he stood before her with folded hands; then the goddess appeared.

3.2.s:
varaṃ varaya taṃ prāha ciraṃdevastu cābravīt ..
pāṇiṃ gṛhāṇa me subhrūstvadrūpeṇa vimohitaḥ ..14..
3.2.d:
वरं वरय तं प्राह चिरंदेवस्तु चाब्रवीत् ॥
पाणिं गृहाण मे सुभ्रूस्त्वद्रूपेण विमोहितः ॥14॥
3.2.m: "Choose a boon," she said to him; and Ciraṃdeva said: / "Take my hand, O fair-browed one! I am captivated by your beauty."

3.2.s:
iti śrutvā tu sā devī vihasyovāca kāminam ..
adya snānaṃ vidhehi tvaṃ matkuṇḍe devanirmite..15..
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा देवी विहस्योवाच कामिनम् ॥
अद्य स्नानं विधेहि त्वं मत्कुण्डे देवनिर्मिते॥15॥
3.2.m: Hearing this, the goddess smiled and said to her lover: / "Bathe today in my pool built by the gods."

3.2.s:
tathetyuktvā gatastoye plāvito mithilāṃ yayau..
sa sthito bhūpatiṃ prāha kāraṇaṃ vismayapradam..16..
3.2.d:
तथेत्युक्त्वा गतस्तोये प्लावितो मिथिलां ययौ॥
स स्थितो भूपतिं प्राह कारणं विस्मयप्रदम्॥16॥
3.2.m: Saying "So be it," he went into the water; carried away [by the current], he went to Mithilā. / Remaining there, he told the king the astonishing matter.

3.2.s:
guṇādhipastu tacchrutvā svabhṛtyena samanvitaḥ..
prāptavānmaṃdire devyāḥ sā bhūyaḥ prāha puṣpadā..17..
3.2.d:
गुणाधिपस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा स्वभृत्येन समन्वितः॥
प्राप्तवान्मंदिरे देव्याः सा भूयः प्राह पुष्पदा॥17॥
3.2.m: Hearing that, Guṇādhipa, accompanied by his servant, / arrived at the temple of the goddess. Puṣpadā spoke to him again:

3.2.s:
gāṃdharveṇa vivāhena māṃ gṛhāṇa guṇādhipa..
iti śrutvā nṛpaḥ prāha yadi devi vaco mama..18..
3.2.d:
गांधर्वेण विवाहेन मां गृहाण गुणाधिप॥
इति श्रुत्वा नृपः प्राह यदि देवि वचो मम॥18॥
3.2.m:
"Take me by the Gāndharva marriage, O Guṇādhipa!"
Hearing this, the king said: "O goddess, if my word

3.2.s:
puṇyade tvaṃ gṛhāṇādya tarhi tvāṃ saṃbhajāmyaham..
tatheti matvā taṃ prāha satvaṃ kāryaṃ nivedaya..19..
3.2.d:
पुण्यदे त्वं गृहाणाद्य तर्हि त्वां संभजाम्यहम्॥
तथेति मत्वा तं प्राह सत्वं कार्यं निवेदय॥19॥
3.2.m:
you accept today, O bestower of merit, then I will unite with you."
Thinking "So be it," she said to him: "State your business at once."

3.2.s:
sa hovāca śṛṇu tvaṃ bho mama bhṛtyaṃ ciraṃ suram ..
bhaja tvaṃ capalāpāṃgi devi satyaṃ vacaḥ kuru ..3.2.8.20..
3.2.d:
स होवाच शृणु त्वं भो मम भृत्यं चिरं सुरम् ॥
भज त्वं चपलापांगि देवि सत्यं वचः कुरु ॥3.2.8.20॥
3.2.m: He said: "Listen, O goddess! My servant Ciraṃdeva is a god. / Unite with him, O woman with tremulous eyes! Make your word true, O goddess!"

3.2.s:
vrīḍitā tu kathāṃ kṛtvā bhūpatiṃ prāha kāminī..
māṃ bhajasva dayāsiṃdho kāminīṃ śakracoditām .. 21 ..
3.2.d:
व्रीडिता तु कथां कृत्वा भूपतिं प्राह कामिनी॥
मां भजस्व दयासिंधो कामिनीं शक्रचोदिताम् ॥ 21 ॥
3.2.m: Embarrassed, the passionate woman spoke and said to the king: / "Unite with me, O ocean of compassion, a woman longing with desire, urged on by Śakra!

3.2.s:
ciraṃdevaṃ tu saṃprāpya kāmāṃdhā tvāṃ samāgatā ..
puṣpadaṃtaruya? tanayā gandharvasya śubhānanā..
śāpitā devadevena narabhogakarī hyaham ..22..
3.2.d:
चिरंदेवं तु संप्राप्य कामांधा त्वां समागता ॥
पुष्पदंतरुय? तनया गन्धर्वस्य शुभानना॥
शापिता देवदेवेन नरभोगकरी ह्यहम् ॥22॥
3.2.m: Having obtained Ciraṃdeva, blind with passion, I have approached you. / I, the lovely-faced daughter of the Gandharva Puṣpadanta, / was indeed cursed by the god of gods to provide enjoyment for a mortal."

3.2.s:
iti śrutvā sa bhūpālo dharmātmā śīlavigrahaḥ ..
kathaṃ bhajāmyahaṃ subhrūḥ snuṣāmiva sudharmiṇīm .. 23 ..
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स भूपालो धर्मात्मा शीलविग्रहः ॥
कथं भजाम्यहं सुभ्रूः स्नुषामिव सुधर्मिणीम् ॥ 23 ॥
3.2.m: Hearing this, the king, righteous-minded and the very embodiment of virtue, [said]: / "How can I unite with you, O fair-browed one, who are like a daughter-in-law of good virtue?

3.2.s:
ciraṃdevastu rājanyo matputra iva vartate ..
tasya tvaṃ bhoginī nārī śobhane bhava sāṃpratam .. 24 ..
3.2.d:
चिरंदेवस्तु राजन्यो मत्पुत्र इव वर्तते ॥
तस्य त्वं भोगिनी नारी शोभने भव सांप्रतम् ॥ 24 ॥
3.2.m: The warrior Ciraṃdeva is like my own son. / Become his enjoying wife right now, O beautiful one!"

3.2.s: lajjitā sā tadā devī snuṣevaḥ ca vavarta vai .. 25 ..
3.2.d: लज्जिता सा तदा देवी स्नुषेवः च ववर्त वै ॥ 25 ॥
3.2.m: Ashamed, the goddess then indeed conducted herself as a daughter-in-law.

3.2.s:
ityuktvā bhūpatiṃ prāha vaitālo rudrakiṃkaraḥ ..
satyaṃ dharmaśca kasyaiva jātastanme vadasva bhoḥ .. 26 ..
3.2.d:
इत्युक्त्वा भूपतिं प्राह वैतालो रुद्रकिंकरः ॥
सत्यं धर्मश्च कस्यैव जातस्तन्मे वदस्व भोः ॥ 26 ॥
3.2.m: Having said this, the vetāla, the servant of Rudra, asked the king: / "Whose truth and righteousness were greater? Tell me that, sir!"

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ...
bhūpatistaṃ vihasyāha ciraṃdevasya jāyate ..
satyaṃ dharmaśca vetāla śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ śubham .. 27 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥।
भूपतिस्तं विहस्याह चिरंदेवस्य जायते ॥
सत्यं धर्मश्च वेताल शृणु तत्कारणं शुभम् ॥ 27 ॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / Smiling at him, the king said: "They belong to Ciraṃdeva. / Truth and righteousness [were his], O vetāla; listen to the auspicious reason for that:

3.2.s:
nṛpāṇāṃ paramo dharmaḥ sarvopakaraṇaṃ smṛtaḥ ..
kṛtopakārabhṛtyasya tena tatkiṃ hi satyatā .. 28 ..
3.2.d:
नृपाणां परमो धर्मः सर्वोपकरणं स्मृतः ॥
कृतोपकारभृत्यस्य तेन तत्किं हि सत्यता ॥ 28 ॥
3.2.m: The supreme duty of kings is remembered to be benefiting everyone; / so what truthfulness is there in benefiting a servant who has [already] served him?

3.2.s:
bhṛtyena ca kṛtaṃ karma tacchṛṇuṣva vadāmyaham ..
vinā vṛttiṃ sthito gehe bhūpaterguṇaśālinaḥ ..
sevā vṛttiḥ kṛtā sarvā yathānyairna naraiḥ kṛtā .. 29 ..
3.2.d:
भृत्येन च कृतं कर्म तच्छृणुष्व वदाम्यहम् ॥
विना वृत्तिं स्थितो गेहे भूपतेर्गुणशालिनः ॥
सेवा वृत्तिः कृता सर्वा यथान्यैर्न नरैः कृता ॥ 29 ॥
3.2.m: Now listen to the deed done by the servant; I shall tell you: / He stayed without a stipend in the house of the virtuous king; / he performed all kinds of service such as other men had never done.

3.2.s:
paścādbhūpatinā jñātaḥ saṃkaṭe bṛhadāgate ..
ciraṃdevastu tasmācca kāraṇādadhiko mataḥ .. 3.2.8.30 ..
tulanīya - kathāsaritsāgare vetālapañcaviṃśatiḥ
3.2.d:
पश्चाद्भूपतिना ज्ञातः संकटे बृहदागते ॥
चिरंदेवस्तु तस्माच्च कारणादधिको मतः ॥ 3.2.8.30 ॥
तुलनीय - कथासरित्सागरे वेतालपञ्चविंशतिः
3.2.m:
Only later was he recognised by the king when a great crisis arose; / and for that reason, Ciraṃdeva is considered superior."
Compare: The Twenty-Five Tales of the Vetāla in the Kathāsaritsāgara.

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
bho śaunaka mahābuddhe vaitālena mahīpatiḥ ..
mahāpravīṇaśca matastamāha sa ca bhūpatim .. 1 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
भो शौनक महाबुद्धे वैतालेन महीपतिः ॥
महाप्रवीणश्च मतस्तमाह स च भूपतिम् ॥ 1 ॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / O Śaunaka of great intellect! The king was considered highly accomplished / by the vetāla, and he said to the king:

3.2.s:
rājankāmapure ramye vīrasiṃho mahīpatiḥ ..
nyāyato dharmataścaiva tatra rājyamacīkarat .. 2 ..
3.2.d:
राजन्कामपुरे रम्ये वीरसिंहो महीपतिः ॥
न्यायतो धर्मतश्चैव तत्र राज्यमचीकरत् ॥ 2 ॥
3.2.m: "O king, in the delightful city of Kāmapura, King Vīrasiṃha / ruled the kingdom there in accordance with justice and righteousness.

3.2.s:
hiraṇyadattastatraiva vaiśyo dhanamadānvitaḥ ..
kāmālasā tasya sutā rūpayauvanaśālinī .. 3 ..
3.2.d:
हिरण्यदत्तस्तत्रैव वैश्यो धनमदान्वितः ॥
कामालसा तस्य सुता रूपयौवनशालिनी ॥ 3 ॥
3.2.m: There was a vaiśya there named Hiraṇyadatta, swollen with the pride of wealth. / His daughter was Kāmālasā, endowed with beauty and youth.

3.2.s:
avasatsukhato nityaṃ vasaṃte kusumapriyā ..
kadācitkusumārthaṃ vai vanaṃ bhramaranāditam .. 4 ..
3.2.d:
अवसत्सुखतो नित्यं वसंते कुसुमप्रिया ॥
कदाचित्कुसुमार्थं वै वनं भ्रमरनादितम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.2.m: She lived always in happiness, fond of flowers in the spring. / Once, for the sake of flowers, [she entered] a forest resounding with the hum of bees.

3.2.s:
gacchantīṃ tāṃ samālokya dharmadattātmajo balī ..
somadatta iti khyātaḥ pasparśa madanālasām .. 5 ..
3.2.d:
गच्छन्तीं तां समालोक्य धर्मदत्तात्मजो बली ॥
सोमदत्त इति ख्यातः पस्पर्श मदनालसाम् ॥ 5 ॥
3.2.m: Seeing her walking along, the strong son of Dharmadatta, / known as Somadatta, touched her who was languid with love.

3.2.s:
sā tu taṃ nirjane sthāne provāca vinayānvitā ..
kanyakāhaṃ mahāvīra tyaja māṃ dharmatodya bhoḥ .. 6 ..
3.2.d:
सा तु तं निर्जने स्थाने प्रोवाच विनयान्विता ॥
कन्यकाहं महावीर त्यज मां धर्मतोद्य भोः ॥ 6 ॥
3.2.m: In that secluded place, she modestly said to him: / 'I am an unmarried maiden, O great hero! Release me today in accordance with righteousness, sir!

3.2.s:
vivāhe sati pūrvaṃ tvāṃ bhajāmi daśame'hani ..
ato daśadinasyaivādeśaṃ dehi dayānidhe .. 7 ..
3.2.d:
विवाहे सति पूर्वं त्वां भजामि दशमेऽहनि ॥
अतो दशदिनस्यैवादेशं देहि दयानिधे ॥ 7 ॥
3.2.m: When my marriage has taken place, I will unite with you first on the tenth day; / therefore give me leave for ten days, O treasure of compassion!'

3.2.s:
tatheti matvā tāṃ tyaktvā nijagehaṃ samāgataḥ ..
kāmālasā tu tadgrāme pitrā dattā varāya ca .. 8 ..
3.2.d:
तथेति मत्वा तां त्यक्त्वा निजगेहं समागतः ॥
कामालसा तु तद्ग्रामे पित्रा दत्ता वराय च ॥ 8 ॥
3.2.m: Thinking 'So be it,' he released her and returned to his own home. / In that village, Kāmālasā was given by her father to a bridegroom,

3.2.s:
madapālāya vaiśyāya maṇigrīvasutāya ca ..
śvaśurasya gṛhaṃ gatvā svamitraṃ pratyacintayat .. 9 ..
3.2.d:
मदपालाय वैश्याय मणिग्रीवसुताय च ॥
श्वशुरस्य गृहं गत्वा स्वमित्रं प्रत्यचिन्तयत् ॥ 9 ॥
3.2.m: to Madapāla, a vaiśya, the son of Maṇigrīva. / Having gone to her father-in-law's house, she thought about her friend.

3.2.s:
navame'hani tatsvāmī gṛhītvā kāminīṃ balāt ..
kāmāturaḥ sa patnīṃ tāmāliliṃga madānvitaḥ .. 3.2.9.10 ..
3.2.d:
नवमेऽहनि तत्स्वामी गृहीत्वा कामिनीं बलात् ॥
कामातुरः स पत्नीं तामालिलिंग मदान्वितः ॥ 3.2.9.10 ॥
3.2.m: On the ninth day, her husband seized the lovely woman by force; / stricken with desire and filled with passion, he embraced his wife.

3.2.s:
arudatsā tu tatpatnī mitravākyena karṣitā ..
tāmuvāca tadā vaiśyaḥ śāṃtipūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ .. 11 ..
3.2.d:
अरुदत्सा तु तत्पत्नी मित्रवाक्येन कर्षिता ॥
तामुवाच तदा वैश्यः शांतिपूर्वमिदं वचः ॥ 11 ॥
3.2.m: His wife wept, tormented by her promise to her friend. / Then the vaiśya spoke these words to her peacefully:

3.2.s:
kiṃ rodiṣi madāpūrṇe satyaṃ kathaya śobhane ..
sā tu satyavatī prāha yathājātaṃ hi kānane .. 12 ..
3.2.d:
किं रोदिषि मदापूर्णे सत्यं कथय शोभने ॥
सा तु सत्यवती प्राह यथाजातं हि कानने ॥ 12 ॥
3.2.m: 'Why do you weep, O passionate one? Tell the truth, O fair lady!' / And that truthful woman told him just as it had happened in the forest:

3.2.s:
yadi nāyāmi pārśve tvāṃ somadatta dhanottama ..
tadā vaidhavyatāṃ prāpya bhajāmi vṛjinaṃ hi tat .. 13 ..
3.2.d:
यदि नायामि पार्श्वे त्वां सोमदत्त धनोत्तम ॥
तदा वैधव्यतां प्राप्य भजामि वृजिनं हि तत् ॥ 13 ॥
3.2.m: 'If I do not come to your side, O Somadatta, foremost in wealth, / then may I attain widowhood and suffer that sin!' —

3.2.s:
iti vākyena baddhāhaṃ yāsyāmyadya tadaṃtike ..
iti śrutvā ca tatsvāmī tāmājñāpya mudānvitaḥ .. 14 ..
3.2.d:
इति वाक्येन बद्धाहं यास्याम्यद्य तदंतिके ॥
इति श्रुत्वा च तत्स्वामी तामाज्ञाप्य मुदान्वितः ॥ 14 ॥
3.2.m: Bound by these words, I must go to his presence today.' / Hearing this, her husband, filled with joy, gave her permission.

3.2.s:
suṣvāpa sā tu tatpārśve hyagamatkāmavihvalā ..
tadā caurastu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām .. 15 ..
3.2.d:
सुष्वाप सा तु तत्पार्श्वे ह्यगमत्कामविह्वला ॥
तदा चौरस्तु तां दृष्ट्वा सर्वाभरणभूषिताम् ॥ 15 ॥
3.2.m: He went to sleep, but she, overcome with desire, went towards him. / Then a thief, seeing her adorned with all kinds of ornaments,

3.2.s:
vacaścovāca lobhātmā kutra yāsi ca sundari ..
kenaivāpekṣitā rātrau satyaṃ kathaya bhāmini .. 16 ..
3.2.d:
वचश्चोवाच लोभात्मा कुत्र यासि च सुन्दरि ॥
केनैवापेक्षिता रात्रौ सत्यं कथय भामिनि ॥ 16 ॥
3.2.m: greedy-minded, spoke these words: 'Where are you going, beautiful one? / By whom were you awaited at night? Tell the truth, lovely lady!'

3.2.s:
kāmālasā tu taṃ cauramuvāca madavihvalā ..
rakṣitā kāmabāṇena svamitraṃ prati yāmi bhoḥ .. 17 ..
3.2.d:
कामालसा तु तं चौरमुवाच मदविह्वला ॥
रक्षिता कामबाणेन स्वमित्रं प्रति यामि भोः ॥ 17 ॥
3.2.m: Kāmālasā, overcome with passion, said to the thief: / 'Kept safe by the arrow of Kāma, I am going to my friend, sir!'

3.2.s:
caurastāmāha bhoḥ subhrūrbhūṣaṇa dehi me'bale ..
cauro'haṃ te dhanagrāhī sā śrutvā vākyamabravīt .. 18 ..
3.2.d:
चौरस्तामाह भोः सुभ्रूर्भूषण देहि मेऽबले ॥
चौरोऽहं ते धनग्राही सा श्रुत्वा वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥ 18 ॥
3.2.m: The thief said to her: 'O fair-browed one, give me your ornaments, O delicate woman! / I am a thief who takes your wealth.' Hearing this, she said:

3.2.s:
āliṃgyopapatiṃ mitraṃ tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi bhūṣaṇam ..
tathetyuktvā tu tenaiva somadattaṃ samāgatā .. 19 ..
3.2.d:
आलिंग्योपपतिं मित्रं तुभ्यं दास्यामि भूषणम् ॥
तथेत्युक्त्वा तु तेनैव सोमदत्तं समागता ॥ 19 ॥
3.2.m: 'After embracing my lover, my friend, I will give you the ornaments.' / Saying 'So be it,' he let her go, and she went to Somadatta.

3.2.s:
dṛṣṭvā tāmabravīdvaiśyaḥ kathaṃ yātā smarālase ..
satyaṃ kathaya me śīghraṃ tatpaścāttvāṃ bhajāmyaham .. 3.2.9.20 ..
3.2.d:
दृष्ट्वा तामब्रवीद्वैश्यः कथं याता स्मरालसे ॥
सत्यं कथय मे शीघ्रं तत्पश्चात्त्वां भजाम्यहम् ॥ 3.2.9.20 ॥
3.2.m: Seeing her, the vaiśya said: 'How have you come, O woman languid with desire? / Tell me the truth quickly, and after that I will unite with you.'

3.2.s:
kāmālasā tu tacchrutvā yathā jātaṃ tathā'bravīt ..
śrutvā sa jñānahṛdayo viṣṇudevena bodhitaḥ .. 21 ..
3.2.d:
कामालसा तु तच्छ्रुत्वा यथा जातं तथाऽब्रवीत् ॥
श्रुत्वा स ज्ञानहृदयो विष्णुदेवेन बोधितः ॥ 21 ॥
3.2.m: Hearing that, Kāmālasā told [him] everything just as it had happened. / Hearing it, his heart filled with understanding, awakened by Lord Viṣṇu,

3.2.s:
matvā pativratāṃ nārīṃ parikramya vyasarjayat ..
caurastu kāraṇaṃ śrutvā viṣṇudevena bodhitaḥ .. 22 ..
3.2.d:
मत्वा पतिव्रतां नारीं परिक्रम्य व्यसर्जयत् ॥
चौरस्तु कारणं श्रुत्वा विष्णुदेवेन बोधितः ॥ 22 ॥
3.2.m: considering her a devoted wife, he circumambulated her and sent her away. / And the thief, hearing the cause, awakened by Lord Viṣṇu,

3.2.s:
gehe praveśayāmāsa tatpatiryatra tiṣṭhati ..
sā tu kāmālasā devī svapātivratya dharmiṇī .. 23 ..
3.2.d:
गेहे प्रवेशयामास तत्पतिर्यत्र तिष्ठति ॥
सा तु कामालसा देवी स्वपातिव्रत्य धर्मिणी ॥ 23 ॥
3.2.m: brought her into the house where her husband stayed. / And that noble lady Kāmālasā, steadfast in her duty of devotion to her husband,

3.2.s:
bubhuje viṣayāndivyāndevadevena coditān ..
ityuktvā sa tu vaitālo nṛpatiṃ prāha kovidam ..
kasya satyaṃ smṛtaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ teṣāṃ madhye vadasva me .. 24 ..
3.2.d:
बुभुजे विषयान्दिव्यान्देवदेवेन चोदितान् ॥
इत्युक्त्वा स तु वैतालो नृपतिं प्राह कोविदम् ॥
कस्य सत्यं स्मृतं श्रेष्ठं तेषां मध्ये वदस्व मे ॥ 24 ॥
3.2.m: enjoyed divine pleasures prompted by the god of gods. / Having spoken thus, the vetāla said to the wise king: / "Whose truthfulness among them is considered the greatest? Tell me!"

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ityuktaḥ sa tu bhūpālo vaitālamidamabravīt .. 25 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
इत्युक्तः स तु भूपालो वैतालमिदमब्रवीत् ॥ 25 ॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / Thus addressed, the king said this to the vetāla:

3.2.s:
caurasya satyatā śreṣṭhā yathā jātā tathā śṛṇu ..
nṛpabhītyā sa vaiśyastu tāṃ nārīṃ na tu bhuktavān.. 26 ..
3.2.d:
चौरस्य सत्यता श्रेष्ठा यथा जाता तथा शृणु ॥
नृपभीत्या स वैश्यस्तु तां नारीं न तु भुक्तवान्॥ 26 ॥
3.2.m: "The thief's truthfulness is the greatest; hear how it was so: / out of fear of the king, the vaiśya did not enjoy the woman;

3.2.s:
vaidhavyabhītyā sā devī svamitraṃ prati cāgatā ..
dharmabhītyā ca tatsvāmī svapatnīṃ na tu bhuktavān .. 27 ..
3.2.d:
वैधव्यभीत्या सा देवी स्वमित्रं प्रति चागता ॥
धर्मभीत्या च तत्स्वामी स्वपत्नीं न तु भुक्तवान् ॥ 27 ॥
3.2.m: out of fear of widowhood, the lady went to her friend; / and out of fear of unrighteousness, her husband did not enjoy his wife;

3.2.s:
caurastu satyabhītyā vai tyaktvā tāṃ mudamāgataḥ .. 28 .. ..
tulanīya - vetālapañcaviṃśati
3.2.d:
चौरस्तु सत्यभीत्या वै त्यक्त्वा तां मुदमागतः ॥ 28 ॥ ॥
तुलनीय - वेतालपञ्चविंशति
3.2.m:
but the thief, truly out of awe of truth, let her go and was gladdened."
Compare: Vetālapañcaviṃśati

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
vaitālastu mahābhāga rājānamidamabravīt ..
gauḍadeśe mahārāja vardhanaṃ nāma vai puram .. 1 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
वैतालस्तु महाभाग राजानमिदमब्रवीत् ॥
गौडदेशे महाराज वर्धनं नाम वै पुरम् ॥ 1 ॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / The vetāla, O fortunate one, said this to the king: / "In the land of Gauḍa, O great king, there was a city named Vardhana.

3.2.s:
guṇaśekhara ākhyāto bhūpālastatra dharmavān ..
tanmantrī nirbhayānando jainadharmaparā yaṇaḥ .. 2 ..
3.2.d:
गुणशेखर आख्यातो भूपालस्तत्र धर्मवान् ॥
तन्मन्त्री निर्भयानन्दो जैनधर्मपरा यणः ॥ 2 ॥
3.2.m: There was a righteous king there named Guṇaśekhara; / his minister was Nirbhayānanda, devoted to the Jain religion.

3.2.s:
kadācidbhūpatiryāto mandire girijāpateḥ ..
pūjayāmāsa taṃ devaṃ sarvavyāpinamīśvaram .. 3 ..
3.2.d:
कदाचिद्भूपतिर्यातो मन्दिरे गिरिजापतेः ॥
पूजयामास तं देवं सर्वव्यापिनमीश्वरम् ॥ 3 ॥
3.2.m: Once the king went to the temple of the Lord of Girijā; / he worshipped that god, the all-pervading Lord.

3.2.s:
vṛścikastatra saṃprāpya dadaṃśa nṛpatiṃ ruṣā ..
tatkaṣṭena sa bhūpālo mūrchitaḥ patito bhuvi .. 4 ..
3.2.d:
वृश्चिकस्तत्र संप्राप्य ददंश नृपतिं रुषा ॥
तत्कष्टेन स भूपालो मूर्छितः पतितो भुवि ॥ 4 ॥
3.2.m: A scorpion arrived there and stung the king in fury; / because of that pain, the king fainted and fell to the ground.

3.2.s:
tadā tu nirbhayānando viṣamuttārya tasya vai ..
bhūpatiṃ varṇayāmāsa jainadharma parāyaṇaḥ .. 5 ..
3.2.d:
तदा तु निर्भयानन्दो विषमुत्तार्य तस्य वै ॥
भूपतिं वर्णयामास जैनधर्म परायणः ॥ 5 ॥
3.2.m: Then Nirbhayānanda, having drawn out his poison, / the minister devoted to the Jain religion described [it] to the king:

3.2.s:
śṛṇu rājanmahābhāga śatrūnṣaṇmānasādhamān ..
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho ratirhiṃsā ca tṛṣṇikā ..
rajoguṇācca te jātāsteṣāṃ bhedāḥ pṛthakpṛthak .. 6 ..
3.2.d:
शृणु राजन्महाभाग शत्रून्षण्मानसाधमान् ॥
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभो रतिर्हिंसा च तृष्णिका ॥
रजोगुणाच्च ते जातास्तेषां भेदाः पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 6 ॥
3.2.m: 'Hear, O fortunate king, of the six base enemies of the mind: / lust, anger, greed, passion, violence, and craving; / they are born of the quality of rajas, with their various distinct divisions.

3.2.s:
moho daṃbho madaścaiva mamatāśā ca garhaṇā ..
tamoguṇācca te jātāstairidaṃ pūritaṃ jagat .. 7 ..
3.2.d:
मोहो दंभो मदश्चैव ममताशा च गर्हणा ॥
तमोगुणाच्च ते जातास्तैरिदं पूरितं जगत् ॥ 7 ॥
3.2.m: Delusion, hypocrisy, arrogance, possessiveness, desire, and censure; / they are born of the quality of tamas, and with them this world is filled.

3.2.s:
kāmī viṣṇustathā rudraḥ krodhī lobhī vidhistathā ..
daṃbhī śakro yamo mohī madī yakṣapatiḥ svayam .. 8 ..
3.2.d:
कामी विष्णुस्तथा रुद्रः क्रोधी लोभी विधिस्तथा ॥
दंभी शक्रो यमो मोही मदी यक्षपतिः स्वयम् ॥ 8 ॥
3.2.m: Viṣṇu is lustful, Rudra is angry, Vidhi is greedy, / Śakra is hypocritical, Yama is deluded, and the Lord of Yakṣas himself is arrogant.

3.2.s:
māyā vaśyāśca te sarve tarhi tatpūjanena kim ..
ṣaṭśatrubhirjito yo vai sa jino munibhiḥ smṛtaḥ .. 9 ..
3.2.d:
माया वश्याश्च ते सर्वे तर्हि तत्पूजनेन किम् ॥
षट्शत्रुभिर्जितो यो वै स जिनो मुनिभिः स्मृतः ॥ 9 ॥
3.2.m: All of them are subservient to Māyā; what then is the use of worshipping them? / He who is not conquered by the six enemies is remembered as Jina by the sages.

3.2.s:
na jitaḥ sa jino jñeyo'dvaitavādī niraṃjanaḥ ..
tasya dhyānena bhāvena mokṣavaṃto narāḥ sadā .. 3.2.10.10 ..
3.2.d:
न जितः स जिनो ज्ञेयोऽद्वैतवादी निरंजनः ॥
तस्य ध्यानेन भावेन मोक्षवंतो नराः सदा ॥ 3.2.10.10 ॥
3.2.m: He who is unconquered should be known as the Jina, the non-dualist, unstained; / by meditation and devotion to him, men always attain liberation.

3.2.s:
tatprasādāya yo dharmaḥ śṛṇu me vasudhādhipa ..
gopūjanena te devāstuṣṭiṃ yānti sadaiva hi .. 11 ..
3.2.d:
तत्प्रसादाय यो धर्मः शृणु मे वसुधाधिप ॥
गोपूजनेन ते देवास्तुष्टिं यान्ति सदैव हि ॥ 11 ॥
3.2.m: Hear from me, O ruler of the earth, the duty for his grace: / through worship of cows, those gods indeed always attain satisfaction.

3.2.s:
ato gopūjanaṃ śuddhaṃ hiṃsā sarvatra varjitā ..
madapānena sarvātmā jinaḥ kleśaṃ samāpnuyāt .. 12 ..
3.2.d:
अतो गोपूजनं शुद्धं हिंसा सर्वत्र वर्जिता ॥
मदपानेन सर्वात्मा जिनः क्लेशं समाप्नुयात् ॥ 12 ॥
3.2.m: Therefore worship of cows is pure, and violence is everywhere avoided; / by drinking intoxicating liquor, the Jina, the Self of all, experiences distress.

3.2.s:
tasmānmāṃsaṃ ca pānaṃ ca varjitaṃ sarvadaiva hi.
nyāyenopārjitaṃ vittaṃ bhojayecca bubhukṣitān .. 13 ..
3.2.d:
तस्मान्मांसं च पानं च वर्जितं सर्वदैव हि।
न्यायेनोपार्जितं वित्तं भोजयेच्च बुभुक्षितान् ॥ 13 ॥
3.2.m: Therefore meat and intoxicating drink are to be avoided at all times; / with wealth acquired justly, one should feed the hungry.

3.2.s:
ravirātmā jinasyaiva tatprakāśe hi bhojayet ..
ityevaṃ varṇayitvainaṃ maṃtrī gehamupāyayau .. 14 ..
3.2.d:
रविरात्मा जिनस्यैव तत्प्रकाशे हि भोजयेत् ॥
इत्येवं वर्णयित्वैनं मंत्री गेहमुपाययौ ॥ 14 ॥
3.2.m: The sun is the very self of the Jina; one should feed [others] only in its light.' / Having thus instructed him, the minister went home.

3.2.s:
tathaiva matvā sa nṛpo jinadharmaṃ gṛhītavān ..
kiyatā caiva kālena vedamārgo hi laṃghitaḥ .. 15 ..
3.2.d:
तथैव मत्वा स नृपो जिनधर्मं गृहीतवान् ॥
कियता चैव कालेन वेदमार्गो हि लंघितः ॥ 15 ॥
3.2.m: Believing it to be just so, the king embraced the Jain religion; / and in some time, he transgressed the Vedic path.

3.2.s: tadā tu duḥkhitā rājñī śivasya śaraṇaṃ yayau .. 16 ..
3.2.d: तदा तु दुःखिता राज्ञी शिवस्य शरणं ययौ ॥ 16 ॥
3.2.m: Then the grieved queen took refuge with Śiva.

3.2.s:
varadānena rudrasya putro jāto mahottamaḥ ..
dharmarāja iti khyāto vedavrataparāyaṇaḥ .. 17 ..
3.2.d:
वरदानेन रुद्रस्य पुत्रो जातो महोत्तमः ॥
धर्मराज इति ख्यातो वेदव्रतपरायणः ॥ 17 ॥
3.2.m: By the boon of Rudra, a most excellent son was born, / celebrated as Dharmarāja, devoted to Vedic vows.

3.2.s:
guṇaśekhara evāsau paṃcatve nirayaṃ yayau ..
dharmarājastadā rājyaṃ kṛtavāndharmataḥ svayam .. 18 ..
3.2.d:
गुणशेखर एवासौ पंचत्वे निरयं ययौ ॥
धर्मराजस्तदा राज्यं कृतवान्धर्मतः स्वयम् ॥ 18 ॥
3.2.m: That Guṇaśekhara, upon his death, went to hell; / then Dharmarāja himself ruled the kingdom righteously.

3.2.s:
tasya dharmaprabhāveṇa tatpitā svargamāptavān ..
trayaḥ patnyobhavaṃstasyaguṇarūpā mahottamā .. 19 ..
3.2.d:
तस्य धर्मप्रभावेण तत्पिता स्वर्गमाप्तवान् ॥
त्रयः पत्न्योभवंस्तस्यगुणरूपा महोत्तमा ॥ 19 ॥
3.2.m: By the power of his righteousness, his father attained heaven. / He had three wives of most excellent virtue and beauty.

3.2.s:
vasaṃtasamaye rājā tābhiḥ saha vanāṃtare ..
saṃyāto ramayāmāsa puṣpabhramaranādite .. 3.2.10.20 ..
3.2.d:
वसंतसमये राजा ताभिः सह वनांतरे ॥
संयातो रमयामास पुष्पभ्रमरनादिते ॥ 3.2.10.20 ॥
3.2.m: In the spring season, the king went with them into the forest, / echoing with flowers and bees, and made love.

3.2.s:
śramitaḥ sa tu bhūpālo rājñībhiḥ saha moditaḥ ..
sarovare snāpitavānmadāghūrṇitalocanaḥ .. 21
3.2.d:
श्रमितः स तु भूपालो राज्ञीभिः सह मोदितः ॥
सरोवरे स्नापितवान्मदाघूर्णितलोचनः ॥ 21
3.2.m: Tired and delighted along with his queens, / the king, his eyes rolling with intoxication, bathed them in a lake.

3.2.s:
gṛhītvā kusumaṃ pādmaṃ kare rājñyai samārpayat ..
padi hīnatvamāyātā patatā kusumena vai ..22 ..
3.2.d:
गृहीत्वा कुसुमं पाद्मं करे राज्ञ्यै समार्पयत् ॥
पदि हीनत्वमायाता पतता कुसुमेन वै ॥22 ॥
3.2.m: Taking a lotus flower in his hand, he gave it to the queen; / by that falling flower, she was crippled in her foot.

3.2.s:
duḥkhitaḥ sa tu bhūpālo rājñīṃ tāmacikitsayat ..
rātrau prāpte dvitīyā tu candraśīlena mohitā .. 23 ..
3.2.d:
दुःखितः स तु भूपालो राज्ञीं तामचिकित्सयत् ॥
रात्रौ प्राप्ते द्वितीया तु चन्द्रशीलेन मोहिता ॥ 23 ॥
3.2.m: Grieved, the king had that queen treated. / When night arrived, the second [queen] was afflicted by the cool touch of the moon;

3.2.s:
apatadvyākulībhūtvā śuddhaṃ pādamabhūttataḥ ..
patitāyāśca śabdena tṛtīyā jvaritā'bhavat .. 24 ..
3.2.d:
अपतद्व्याकुलीभूत्वा शुद्धं पादमभूत्ततः ॥
पतितायाश्च शब्देन तृतीया ज्वरिताऽभवत् ॥ 24 ॥
3.2.m: she fell in distress, and then her foot became lame. / And at the sound of her falling, the third fell into a fever.

3.2.s:
tasyā mūrcchā tadā kṣīṇā dvitīyāyā ajāyata ..
nṛpasparśena sā subhrūrjvaratāpaṃ vihāya ca .. 25 ..
3.2.d:
तस्या मूर्च्छा तदा क्षीणा द्वितीयाया अजायत ॥
नृपस्पर्शेन सा सुभ्रूर्ज्वरतापं विहाय च ॥ 25 ॥
3.2.m: The fainting fit of the second then subsided; / and by the touch of the king, that fair-browed [third queen] abandoned the heat of her fever.

3.2.s:
prabhāte suṃdare jāte sa tābhirgṛhamāyayau ..
ityuktvā sa tu vaitālo bhūpatiṃ prāha namradhīḥ ..
āsāṃ madhye mahārāja kā śreṣṭhā sukumārikā ..26..
3.2.d:
प्रभाते सुंदरे जाते स ताभिर्गृहमाययौ ॥
इत्युक्त्वा स तु वैतालो भूपतिं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥
आसां मध्ये महाराज का श्रेष्ठा सुकुमारिका ॥26॥
3.2.m: When beautiful dawn arose, he returned home with them. / Having spoken thus, the vetāla, bowed in mind, said to the king: / 'Among these, O great king, who is the most delicate woman?'

3.2.s:
..rājovāca.. ..
tṛtīyā sukumārī ca tāsāṃ madhye mahottamā..
vāyuprakṛtitaścāsau padmapuṣpeṇa khaṃjitā..27..
3.2.d:
॥राजोवाच॥ ॥
तृतीया सुकुमारी च तासां मध्ये महोत्तमा॥
वायुप्रकृतितश्चासौ पद्मपुष्पेण खंजिता॥27॥
3.2.m: The king said: / 'The third is the most delicate and the most excellent among them: / the [first] was crippled by a lotus flower due to a vāta imbalance;

3.2.s:
śītāṃśunā dvitīyā tu mūrcchitā kaphabhāvataḥ ..
śabdamātreṇa saṃtāpo yasyāṃ jāto hi sottamā ..28..
3.2.d:
शीतांशुना द्वितीया तु मूर्च्छिता कफभावतः ॥
शब्दमात्रेण संतापो यस्यां जातो हि सोत्तमा ॥28॥
3.2.m: the second fainted because of the moon due to a kapha condition; / but she in whom burning heat arose from mere sound is indeed the most superior.'

3.2.s:
vihasyāha punardevo bhavabhaktaṃ mahīpatim ..
jainadharmaḥ pradhāno hi vedadharmotha vā vada ..29..
3.2.d:
विहस्याह पुनर्देवो भवभक्तं महीपतिम् ॥
जैनधर्मः प्रधानो हि वेदधर्मोथ वा वद ॥29॥
3.2.m: Laughing, the vetāla said again to the king, a devotee of Śiva: / 'Tell me, is the Jain religion superior, or the Vedic religion?'

3.2.s:
sa hovāca pradhāno'sau vedadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ..
aṣṭau śreṇyo hi tasyaiva brahmaṇovyaktarūpiṇaḥ..3.2.10.30..
3.2.d:
स होवाच प्रधानोऽसौ वेदधर्मः सनातनः॥
अष्टौ श्रेण्यो हि तस्यैव ब्रह्मणोव्यक्तरूपिणः॥3.2.10.30॥
3.2.m: He said: 'The eternal Vedic religion is superior; / for it has eight stages of Brahman in unmanifest form:

3.2.s:
śūdro vaiśyastathā kṣatrī brāhmaṇo brahmacaryakṛt ..
gehī vanyo yatiścaiva kramācchreṣṭhāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 31 ..
3.2.d:
शूद्रो वैश्यस्तथा क्षत्री ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मचर्यकृत् ॥
गेही वन्यो यतिश्चैव क्रमाच्छ्रेष्ठाः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥ 31 ॥
3.2.m: the śūdra, the vaiśya, the kṣatriya, the brāhmaṇa, the celibate student, / the householder, the forest-dweller, and the ascetic are proclaimed superior in order.

3.2.s:
yaḥ kṛtvā dārasaṃsargaṃ yativadvartate gṛhī ..
sa pāpī narakaṃ yāti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 32 ..
3.2.d:
यः कृत्वा दारसंसर्गं यतिवद्वर्तते गृही ॥
स पापी नरकं याति यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ॥ 32 ॥
3.2.m: A householder who, having engaged in sexual union with his wife, behaves like an ascetic, / that sinner goes to hell until the dissolution of all beings.

3.2.s:
gṛheṣu yativaddharmo jainaśāstre prakīrtitaḥ ..
pākhaṇḍaḥ sa smṛtaḥ prājñairvarjanīyo hi sarvadā .. 33 ..
tulanīya - vetālapaṃcaviṃśati
3.2.d:
गृहेषु यतिवद्धर्मो जैनशास्त्रे प्रकीर्तितः ॥
पाखण्डः स स्मृतः प्राज्ञैर्वर्जनीयो हि सर्वदा ॥ 33 ॥
तुलनीय - वेतालपंचविंशति
3.2.m:
Conduct like an ascetic within households is proclaimed in the Jain scripture; / that is considered heresy by the wise, and must always be avoided.'
Compare: Vetālapañcaviṃśati

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
bhoḥ śaunaka mahābhāga sa vaitālo hi devatā...
rājānamabravīdgāthāṃ dharmapraśnamayīṃ śubhām ..1..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
भोः शौनक महाभाग स वैतालो हि देवता॥।
राजानमब्रवीद्गाथां धर्मप्रश्नमयीं शुभाम् ॥1॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / O fortunate Śaunaka, that vetāla, a divine being, / spoke a verse to the king consisting of an auspicious question on dharma:

3.2.s:
rājanpuṇyapure ramye nānājananiṣevite ..
dharmavallabhabhūpālastatra rājyaṃ purākarot ..2..
3.2.d:
राजन्पुण्यपुरे रम्ये नानाजननिषेविते ॥
धर्मवल्लभभूपालस्तत्र राज्यं पुराकरोत् ॥2॥
3.2.m: "O king, in the delightful city of Puṇyapura, frequented by various people, / King Dharmavallabha formerly held sway.

3.2.s:
satyaprakāśastanmaṃtrī lakṣmīścāmātyakāminī ..
kadācitsa tu bhūpālo maṃtriṇaṃ prāha dharmavit ..3..
3.2.d:
सत्यप्रकाशस्तन्मंत्री लक्ष्मीश्चामात्यकामिनी ॥
कदाचित्स तु भूपालो मंत्रिणं प्राह धर्मवित् ॥3॥
3.2.m: Satyaprakāśa was his minister, and Lakṣmī was the minister's beloved wife. / Once that king, knower of dharma, said to the minister:

3.2.s:
ānaṃdaḥ katidhā loke tanmamācakṣva sattama ..
sa hovāca mahārāja sukhaṃ caiva caturvidham ..4..
3.2.d:
आनंदः कतिधा लोके तन्ममाचक्ष्व सत्तम ॥
स होवाच महाराज सुखं चैव चतुर्विधम् ॥4॥
3.2.m: 'How many kinds of bliss are there in the world? Tell me that, O best of men.' / He said: 'O great king, happiness is indeed fourfold.

3.2.s:
brahmacaryāśrame yo vai brahmānaṃdo mahottamaḥ ..
gārhasthye viṣayānaṃdo madhyamaḥ kathito budhaiḥ ..5..
3.2.d:
ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमे यो वै ब्रह्मानंदो महोत्तमः ॥
गार्हस्थ्ये विषयानंदो मध्यमः कथितो बुधैः ॥5॥
3.2.m: The bliss of Brahman in the stage of studenthood is the supreme; / the bliss of sensory objects in householdership is said by the wise to be middling.

3.2.s:
vānaprasthe mahārāja sa dharmānaṃdako'dhamaḥ ..
karmakāṃḍena cānaṃdaḥ satyadharmaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ..6..
3.2.d:
वानप्रस्थे महाराज स धर्मानंदकोऽधमः ॥
कर्मकांडेन चानंदः सत्यधर्मः स वै स्मृतः॥6॥
3.2.m: In the forest-dweller's stage, O great king, the bliss of righteousness is the lowest; / and bliss through the ritual portion of the Veda is handed down as true dharma.

3.2.s:
saṃnyaste tu śivānaṃdassa hi sarvottamottamaḥ..
viṣayānaṃdako rājanstrīpradhānaḥ prakīrtitaḥ..7..
3.2.d:
संन्यस्ते तु शिवानंदस्स हि सर्वोत्तमोत्तमः॥
विषयानंदको राजन्स्त्रीप्रधानः प्रकीर्तितः॥7॥
3.2.m: In renunciation, however, there is the bliss of Śiva, which is the highest of all. / The bliss of sensory objects, O king, is declared to have woman as its chief element.

3.2.s:
striyaṃ vinā sukhaṃ nāsti gṛhasthāśramake nṛpa..
iti śrutvā sa bhūpālo deśāṃtaramupāyayau ..8..
3.2.d:
स्त्रियं विना सुखं नास्ति गृहस्थाश्रमके नृप॥
इति श्रुत्वा स भूपालो देशांतरमुपाययौ ॥8॥
3.2.m: Without a woman there is no happiness in the stage of the householder, O king.' / Hearing this, the king went to another land.

3.2.s:
patnīmanveṣayāmāsa svayogyāṃ dharmatatparām ..
prāptavānna tu vāmāṃgīṃ manovṛttyanusāriṇīm..9..
3.2.d:
पत्नीमन्वेषयामास स्वयोग्यां धर्मतत्पराम् ॥
प्राप्तवान्न तु वामांगीं मनोवृत्त्यनुसारिणीम्॥9॥
3.2.m: He sought a wife suitable for himself, devoted to dharma, / but he did not find a fair woman who followed his inclination of mind.

3.2.s:
sa bhūpo maṃtriṇaṃ prāha nārīmanveṣayādya bhoḥ..
no cetprāṇānahaṃ tyakṣye satyaṃ vākyaṃ bravīmyaham..3.2.11.10..
3.2.d:
स भूपो मंत्रिणं प्राह नारीमन्वेषयाद्य भोः॥
नो चेत्प्राणानहं त्यक्ष्ये सत्यं वाक्यं ब्रवीम्यहम्॥3.2.11.10॥
3.2.m: The king said to the minister: 'Search for a woman today! / Otherwise I shall abandon my life; I speak the truth.'

3.2.s:
iti śrutvā yayau maṃtrī deśāddeśāṃtaraṃ prati ..
siṃdhudeśe ca saṃprāpya samudraṃ prati so'gamat ..
tuṣṭāva manasā siṃdhuṃ sarvatīrthapatiṃ śubham.. 11 ..
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वा ययौ मंत्री देशाद्देशांतरं प्रति ॥
सिंधुदेशे च संप्राप्य समुद्रं प्रति सोऽगमत् ॥
तुष्टाव मनसा सिंधुं सर्वतीर्थपतिं शुभम्॥ 11 ॥
3.2.m: Hearing this, the minister went from land to land. / Reaching the Sindhu country, he went towards the sea, / and praised in his mind the Ocean, the auspicious lord of all sacred bathing places.

3.2.s:
.. buddhiprakāśa uvāca .. ..
siṃdhudeva namastubhyaṃ sarvaratnālaya prabho ..12..
3.2.d:
॥ बुद्धिप्रकाश उवाच ॥ ॥
सिंधुदेव नमस्तुभ्यं सर्वरत्नालय प्रभो ॥12॥
3.2.m: Buddhiprakāśa said: / 'O Ocean God, homage to you, the storehouse of all jewels, O Lord!

3.2.s:
ahaṃ te śaraṇaṃ prāptaḥ śaraṇāgatavatsala..
tvāṃ namāmi jalādhīśaṃ gaṃgādisaritāṃ patim..13..
3.2.d:
अहं ते शरणं प्राप्तः शरणागतवत्सल॥
त्वां नमामि जलाधीशं गंगादिसरितां पतिम्॥13॥
3.2.m: I have come to you for refuge, O you who are affectionate to those who seek refuge. / I bow to you, the lord of waters, the husband of the Gaṅgā and other rivers.

3.2.s:
strīratnaṃ dehi rājño'rthe no cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham ..
iti śrutvā prasannātmā sāgaraḥ saritāṃ patiḥ ..14..
3.2.d:
स्त्रीरत्नं देहि राज्ञोऽर्थे नो चेत्प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम् ॥
इति श्रुत्वा प्रसन्नात्मा सागरः सरितां पतिः ॥14॥
3.2.m: Grant a jewel of a woman for the sake of the king; otherwise I shall surrender my life.' / Hearing this, the ocean, the lord of rivers, became pleased in heart.

3.2.s:
jale vṛkṣaṃ suvarṇāṃgaṃ patravidrumakaṃ mahat ..
muktā phalānvitaṃ divyaṃ maṃtriṇe samadarśayat ..15..
3.2.d:
जले वृक्षं सुवर्णांगं पत्रविद्रुमकं महत् ॥
मुक्ता फलान्वितं दिव्यं मंत्रिणे समदर्शयत् ॥15॥
3.2.m: He showed the minister in the water a wondrous, golden-bodied tree, / with leaves of coral, laden with pearls as fruits.

3.2.s:
tasyopari sthitā bālā sukumārī manoramā ..
tatraiva sā laye jātā vṛkṣeṇa saha bhūpate ..16..
3.2.d:
तस्योपरि स्थिता बाला सुकुमारी मनोरमा ॥
तत्रैव सा लये जाता वृक्षेण सह भूपते ॥16॥
3.2.m: Upon it was seated a young maiden, delicate and enchanting. / Right there, O king, she vanished into the water together with the tree.

3.2.s:
iti dṛṣṭvā mahāścaryaṃ nṛpāṃtikamupāyayau ..
varṇayitvā tu tatsarvaṃ rājñā sārdhaṃ samāptavān.. 17 ..
3.2.d:
इति दृष्ट्वा महाश्चर्यं नृपांतिकमुपाययौ ॥
वर्णयित्वा तु तत्सर्वं राज्ञा सार्धं समाप्तवान्॥ 17 ॥
3.2.m: Seeing this great wonder, he returned to the presence of the king. / Having described all that, he reached [the place] together with the king.

3.2.s:
tathāvidhaṃ nṛpo dṛṣṭvā sāgarāṃtamupāyayau ..
bālayā saha pātālaṃ prāptavānbhūpatiḥ svayam .. 18 ..
3.2.d:
तथाविधं नृपो दृष्ट्वा सागरांतमुपाययौ ॥
बालया सह पातालं प्राप्तवान्भूपतिः स्वयम् ॥ 18 ॥
3.2.m: Seeing such a sight, the king reached the edge of the ocean. / Together with the maiden, the king himself reached the netherworld.

3.2.s:
tāṃ nārīṃ prāha namrātmā tvadarthe'haṃ samāgataḥ ..
gāṃdharveṇa vivāhena māṃ prāpaya varānane .. 19 ..
3.2.d:
तां नारीं प्राह नम्रात्मा त्वदर्थेऽहं समागतः ॥
गांधर्वेण विवाहेन मां प्रापय वरानने ॥ 19 ॥
3.2.m: Bowing low, he said to the woman: 'I have come for your sake; / unite with me by the Gandharva marriage, O fair-faced one!'

3.2.s:
vihasya sā''ha taṃ bhūpaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī ..
taddine'haṃ samāgatya tvāṃ bhajāmi nṛpottama ..3.2.11.20..
3.2.d:
विहस्य सा'ऽह तं भूपं कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशी ॥
तद्दिनेऽहं समागत्य त्वां भजामि नृपोत्तम ॥3.2.11.20॥
3.2.m: Laughing, she said to the king: 'The fourteenth day of the dark fortnight— / on that day I shall come and serve you, O best of kings.'

3.2.s:
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatistaddine smaravihvalaḥ..
khaḍgahasto yayau tatra yatra devīgṛhottamam .. 21 ..
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स नृपतिस्तद्दिने स्मरविह्वलः॥
खड्गहस्तो ययौ तत्र यत्र देवीगृहोत्तमम् ॥ 21 ॥
3.2.m: Hearing this, on that day the king, overwhelmed with love, / sword in hand, went to the place where that excellent house of the lady was.

3.2.s:
etasminnaṃtare tatra rākṣaso bakavāhanaḥ ..
tāṃ bālāṃ sa ca pasparśa nṛpaḥ krodhāturo'bhavat .. 22 ..
3.2.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र राक्षसो बकवाहनः ॥
तां बालां स च पस्पर्श नृपः क्रोधातुरोऽभवत् ॥ 22 ॥
3.2.m: In the meantime, a rākṣasa named Bakavāhana / touched that girl; and the king became overcome with wrath.

3.2.s:
kāmāṃdho rākṣasaṃ hatvā svapatnīṃ prāha nirbhayām ..
ko'yaṃ te'tra samāyātaḥ kāraṇaṃ vada bhāmini .. 23 ..
3.2.d:
कामांधो राक्षसं हत्वा स्वपत्नीं प्राह निर्भयाम् ॥
कोऽयं तेऽत्र समायातः कारणं वद भामिनि ॥ 23 ॥
3.2.m: Blind with passion, he slew the rākṣasa and said to his fearless wife: / 'Who is this who came here to you? Tell me the reason, O lovely woman!'

3.2.s:
sāha bhoḥ śṛṇu bhūpāla vidyādharasutā hyaham ..
pitṛpriyā madavatī kāmārtā vanamāgatā .. 24 ..
3.2.d:
साह भोः शृणु भूपाल विद्याधरसुता ह्यहम् ॥
पितृप्रिया मदवती कामार्ता वनमागता ॥ 24 ॥
3.2.m: She said: 'Listen, O king! I am the daughter of a vidyādhara, / dear to my father, passionate; overcome by desire, I went to the forest.

3.2.s:
nāgatā bhojane kāle pitṛmātrośca maṃdire ..
jñātvā dhyānena matpitrā śāpitā tacchṛṇuṣva bhoḥ .. 25 ..
3.2.d:
नागता भोजने काले पितृमात्रोश्च मंदिरे ॥
ज्ञात्वा ध्यानेन मत्पित्रा शापिता तच्छृणुष्व भोः ॥ 25 ॥
3.2.m: I did not come to the house of my parents at the time for a meal. / Knowing this through meditation, my father cursed me; listen to that, sir:

3.2.s:
adya kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ tvāṃ bhajiṣyati rākṣasaḥ ..
kṛṣṇapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ bhuṃkṣva tvamaparādhakam .. 26 ..
3.2.d:
अद्य कृष्णचतुर्दश्यां त्वां भजिष्यति राक्षसः ॥
कृष्णपक्षचतुर्दश्यां भुंक्ष्व त्वमपराधकम् ॥ 26 ॥
3.2.m: "Today, on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, a rākṣasa will enjoy you; / on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight you must suffer for your transgression!"

3.2.s:
tadāhaṃ rodanaṃ kṛtvā bravīmi pitaraṃ prati ..
kadā muktirbhaveddeva tattvaṃ kathaya suvrata .. 27 ..
3.2.d:
तदाहं रोदनं कृत्वा ब्रवीमि पितरं प्रति ॥
कदा मुक्तिर्भवेद्देव तत्त्वं कथय सुव्रत ॥ 27 ॥
3.2.m: Then, having wept, I said to my father: / "When will there be release, O lord? Tell me the truth, O you of good vows!"

3.2.s:
sa hovāca kumāri tvaṃ vīrabhuktā bhaviṣyasi..
tadā śāpasya muktiḥ syātsāhaṃ tava vimocitā .. 28 ..
3.2.d:
स होवाच कुमारि त्वं वीरभुक्ता भविष्यसि॥
तदा शापस्य मुक्तिः स्यात्साहं तव विमोचिता ॥ 28 ॥
3.2.m: He said: "O girl, you will be enjoyed by a hero, / and then there will be release from the curse." So I have been liberated by you.

3.2.s:
tvadājñayāhaṃ yāsyāmi bho rājanpitṛmaṃdire ..
iti śrutvā nṛpaḥ prāha mama gehaṃ samāvraja .. 29 ..
3.2.d:
त्वदाज्ञयाहं यास्यामि भो राजन्पितृमंदिरे ॥
इति श्रुत्वा नृपः प्राह मम गेहं समाव्रज ॥ 29 ॥
3.2.m: With your permission, O king, I shall go to my father’s house.' / Hearing this, the king said: 'Come to my home!

3.2.s:
tvayā sārddhaṃ gamiṣyāmi gṛhaṃ vidyādharasya tat ..
tathetyuktvā tu sā devī nṛpagehaṃ samāyayau .. 3.2.11.30 ..
3.2.d:
त्वया सार्द्धं गमिष्यामि गृहं विद्याधरस्य तत् ॥
तथेत्युक्त्वा तु सा देवी नृपगेहं समाययौ ॥ 3.2.11.30 ॥
3.2.m: Together with you I shall go to that house of the vidyādhara.' / Saying "So be it," the goddess went to the king's house.

3.2.s:
tadā tu nagare tasminnṛṇāṃ jāto mahotsavaḥ ..
maṃtrī dṛṣṭvā tu taṃ bhūpaṃ divyapatnīsamanvitam ..
pañcatvamagamattūrṇaṃ kuto hetorhi tadvada .. 31 ..
3.2.d:
तदा तु नगरे तस्मिन्नृणां जातो महोत्सवः ॥
मंत्री दृष्ट्वा तु तं भूपं दिव्यपत्नीसमन्वितम् ॥
पञ्चत्वमगमत्तूर्णं कुतो हेतोर्हि तद्वद ॥ 31 ॥
3.2.m: Then in that city there was a great festival for the people. / But the minister, seeing the king accompanied by his celestial wife, / instantly met his death. Tell me, for what reason was that?'

3.2.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
mantrī buddhiprakāśastu dṛṣṭvā devīṃ samāgatām ..32..
3.2.d:
॥ राजोवाच ॥ ॥
मन्त्री बुद्धिप्रकाशस्तु दृष्ट्वा देवीं समागताम् ॥32॥
3.2.m: The king said: / 'The minister Buddhiprakāśa, having seen the lady arrive,

3.2.s:
nṛpaṃ sa hṛdi saṃdhyātvā rājyabhaṃgabhayāturaḥ ..
tyaktvā prāṇānyayau svargaṃ śṛṇu yatkāraṇaṃ śubham .. 33 ..
3.2.d:
नृपं स हृदि संध्यात्वा राज्यभंगभयातुरः ॥
त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्ययौ स्वर्गं शृणु यत्कारणं शुभम् ॥ 33 ॥
3.2.m: reflected in his heart upon the king, and distressed by fear of the destruction of the kingdom, / abandoned his life and went to heaven. Listen to the noble reason:

3.2.s:
viṣayī yo hi bhūpālastasya rājyavināśanam ..
strīmadaṃ prāpya rājyasya sadā hānimavāpnuyāt .. 34 .. ..
tulanīya - kathāsaritsāgaraḥ
3.2.d:
विषयी यो हि भूपालस्तस्य राज्यविनाशनम् ॥
स्त्रीमदं प्राप्य राज्यस्य सदा हानिमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 34 ॥ ॥
तुलनीय - कथासरित्सागरः
3.2.m:
A king who is addicted to sensual pleasures suffers the ruin of his kingdom; / captivated by infatuation with a woman, he constantly brings about loss to his kingdom.'
Comparable: Kathāsaritsāgara

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
vihasya sa tu vaitālo rājānamidamabravīt ..
rājaṃścūḍāpure ramye bhūpaścūḍāmaṇiḥ smṛtaḥ ..1..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
विहस्य स तु वैतालो राजानमिदमब्रवीत् ॥
राजंश्चूडापुरे रम्ये भूपश्चूडामणिः स्मृतः ॥1॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / Laughing, that vetāla said this to the king: / 'O king, in the charming city of Cūḍāpura there was a king known as Cūḍāmaṇi.

3.2.s:
devasvāmī gurustasya vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ ..
tasya patnī viśālākṣī patidharmaparāyaṇā .. 2 ..
3.2.d:
देवस्वामी गुरुस्तस्य वेदवेदांगपारगः ॥
तस्य पत्नी विशालाक्षी पतिधर्मपरायणा ॥ 2 ॥
3.2.m: His guru was Devasvāmin, who had mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas. / His wife was Viśālākṣī, devoted to the duty of a wife.

3.2.s:
śivamārādhayāmāsa putrārthe varavarṇinī ..
rudrasya varadānena kāmadevasamaḥ sutaḥ .. 3 ..
3.2.d:
शिवमाराधयामास पुत्रार्थे वरवर्णिनी ॥
रुद्रस्य वरदानेन कामदेवसमः सुतः ॥ 3 ॥
3.2.m: That fair-complexioned woman worshipped Śiva for the sake of a son. / By the boon of Rudra, a son equal to the God of Love,

3.2.s:
harisvāmīti vikhyāto jāto devāṃśavānbalī ..
sarvasaṃpatsamāyukto devatulyasukhī kṣitau .. 4 ..
3.2.d:
हरिस्वामीति विख्यातो जातो देवांशवान्बली ॥
सर्वसंपत्समायुक्तो देवतुल्यसुखी क्षितौ ॥ 4 ॥
3.2.m: renowned as Harisvāmin, possessing a portion of the gods, strong, / endowed with all prosperity, enjoying happiness like a god on earth, was born.

3.2.s:
rūpalāvaṇyikā nāmnā tatpatnī hi surāṃganā ..
jātā devalaśāpena tasya nandanato nṛpa .. 5 ..
3.2.d:
रूपलावण्यिका नाम्ना तत्पत्नी हि सुरांगना ॥
जाता देवलशापेन तस्य नन्दनतो नृप ॥ 5 ॥
3.2.m: His wife, named Rūpalāvaṇyikā, was indeed a celestial nymph; / through the curse of Devala, O king, she was born from his delight.

3.2.s:
ekadā patinā sārddhaṃ vasante kusumākare ..
harmye suṣvāpa saṃprītyā śayyāmadhyāsya suṃdarī ..6..
3.2.d:
एकदा पतिना सार्द्धं वसन्ते कुसुमाकरे ॥
हर्म्ये सुष्वाप संप्रीत्या शय्यामध्यास्य सुंदरी ॥6॥
3.2.m: Once, in spring, the season of flowers, the beautiful woman / slept with delight on a bed in a mansion together with her husband.

3.2.s:
sukalo nāma gaṃdharvastasyā rūpeṇa mohitaḥ ..
tāṃ jahāra vimāne sve saṃsthāpya svapuraṃ yayau ..7..
3.2.d:
सुकलो नाम गंधर्वस्तस्या रूपेण मोहितः ॥
तां जहार विमाने स्वे संस्थाप्य स्वपुरं ययौ ॥7॥
3.2.m: A gandharva named Sukala, infatuated by her beauty, / abducted her, placed her in his celestial chariot, and went to his own city.

3.2.s:
prabuddhaḥ sa tu tāṃ nārīṃ mṛgayāmāsa vihvalaḥ ..
alabdhvā vyākulo bhūtvā deśaṃ tyaktvā vanaṃ gataḥ ..8..
3.2.d:
प्रबुद्धः स तु तां नारीं मृगयामास विह्वलः ॥
अलब्ध्वा व्याकुलो भूत्वा देशं त्यक्त्वा वनं गतः ॥8॥
3.2.m: Awaking, he searched for that woman in agitation; / not finding her, he became distraught, abandoned his country, and went to the forest.

3.2.s:
saṃnyasya viṣayānsarvānharidhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ..
kadācitprāpa sa snehī vipragehamupāgataḥ .. 9 ..
3.2.d:
संन्यस्य विषयान्सर्वान्हरिध्यानपरायणः ॥
कदाचित्प्राप स स्नेही विप्रगेहमुपागतः ॥ 9 ॥
3.2.m: Having renounced all sensual objects, intent on meditation upon Hari, / that affectionate man once arrived at a Brahmin's house.

3.2.s:
prapacya pāyasamapi vaṭavṛkṣamupāśritaḥ ..
vṛkṣopari nidhāyāśu nadīsnānamathākarot ..
bhojanaṃ ca tato rājansarpeṇa garalīkṛtam .. 3.2.12.10 ..
3.2.d:
प्रपच्य पायसमपि वटवृक्षमुपाश्रितः ॥
वृक्षोपरि निधायाशु नदीस्नानमथाकरोत् ॥
भोजनं च ततो राजन्सर्पेण गरलीकृतम् ॥ 3.2.12.10 ॥
3.2.m: Having cooked milk-rice, he resorted to a banyan tree; / placing it up in the tree, he then went quickly to bathe in the river. / And then, O king, the food was poisoned by a snake.

3.2.s:
tato yatiḥ samāyāto bhuktvā madamupāyayau ..
viṣeṇa pīḍitatanurdṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇamabravīt .. 11 ..
3.2.d:
ततो यतिः समायातो भुक्त्वा मदमुपाययौ ॥
विषेण पीडिततनुर्दृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मणमब्रवीत् ॥ 11 ॥
3.2.m: Then the ascetic returned, ate, and fell into intoxication; / his body tormented by poison, seeing the Brahmin, he said:

3.2.s:
tvayā pradattaṃ mūrkheṇa pāyasaṃ viṣamiśritam ..
maraṇaṃ yāmi bho duṣṭa brahmahatyāmavāpsyasi .. 12 ..
3.2.d:
त्वया प्रदत्तं मूर्खेण पायसं विषमिश्रितम् ॥
मरणं यामि भो दुष्ट ब्रह्महत्यामवाप्स्यसि ॥ 12 ॥
3.2.m: “By you, fool, milk-rice mixed with poison has been given; / I am dying, O wicked one; you will incur the guilt of killing a Brahmin!”

3.2.s:
ityuktvā maraṇaṃ prāpya śivalokamupāyayau ..
rūpatejoyutāṃ devīṃ gṛhītvā sukhamāptavān .. 13 ..
3.2.d:
इत्युक्त्वा मरणं प्राप्य शिवलोकमुपाययौ ॥
रूपतेजोयुतां देवीं गृहीत्वा सुखमाप्तवान् ॥ 13 ॥
3.2.m: Having spoken thus and met his death, he went to the world of Śiva; / receiving a goddess endowed with beauty and splendour, he attained happiness.

3.2.s:
ityuktvā sa tu vetālo rājānamidabravīt ..
kasmai prāptā brahmahatyā teṣāṃ madhye vadasva me .. 14 ..
3.2.d:
इत्युक्त्वा स तु वेतालो राजानमिदब्रवीत् ॥
कस्मै प्राप्ता ब्रह्महत्या तेषां मध्ये वदस्व मे ॥ 14 ॥
3.2.m: Having spoken thus, the vetāla said this to the king: / “Tell me, among them, upon whom does the guilt of Brahmin-slaughter fall?”

3.2.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
svābhāvikaviṣo nāgo hyajñānena viṣaṃ kṛtam ..
ato doṣī hi bhujago brahmahatyāṃ na cāptavān .. 15 ..
3.2.d:
॥ राजोवाच ॥ ॥
स्वाभाविकविषो नागो ह्यज्ञानेन विषं कृतम् ॥
अतो दोषी हि भुजगो ब्रह्महत्यां न चाप्तवान् ॥ 15 ॥
3.2.m: The king said: / “The serpent is naturally venomous, and the poison was shed through ignorance; / therefore, the serpent is guilty, but did not incur the guilt of Brahmin-slaughter.

3.2.s:
bubhukṣite dadau bhikṣāṃ sa dvijo daivamohitaḥ ..
brahmahatyāmato nāyātkuladharmaparāyaṇam .. 16 ..
3.2.d:
बुभुक्षिते ददौ भिक्षां स द्विजो दैवमोहितः ॥
ब्रह्महत्यामतो नायात्कुलधर्मपरायणम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.2.m: The twice-born gave alms to the hungry man, deluded by fate; / therefore, Brahmin-slaughter would not accrue to one devoted to the duties of his family.

3.2.s:
ātmanā ca kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhoktavyaṃ sarvadā janaiḥ ..
ātmatyāgo brahmahatyā cātitheścāvamānanam.. 17 ..
3.2.d:
आत्मना च कृतं पापं भोक्तव्यं सर्वदा जनैः ॥
आत्मत्यागो ब्रह्महत्या चातिथेश्चावमाननम्॥ 17 ॥
3.2.m: And the sin committed by oneself must always be reaped by people; / suicide is Brahmin-slaughter, as is disrespecting a guest.

3.2.s:
brahmahatyā tadā jñeyā viṣadattena sā tathā ..
ātmatyāgaḥ smṛto daivāttasmātsopi na pāpavān .. 18 ..
3.2.d:
ब्रह्महत्या तदा ज्ञेया विषदत्तेन सा तथा ॥
आत्मत्यागः स्मृतो दैवात्तस्मात्सोपि न पापवान् ॥ 18 ॥
3.2.m: Brahmin-slaughter would be known then, if poison had been given deliberately by him; / it is considered suicide through fate, so he too is not sinful.

3.2.s:
yairnaraiḥ kathitā vārtā brahmahatyā tvayā kṛtā ..
teṣāṃ brāhmaṇahatyā sā nyāyabhraṣṭavatāṃ nṛṇām .. 19 .. ..
tulanīya - kathāsaritsāgare vetālapañcaviṃśati
3.2.d:
यैर्नरैः कथिता वार्ता ब्रह्महत्या त्वया कृता ॥
तेषां ब्राह्मणहत्या सा न्यायभ्रष्टवतां नृणाम् ॥ 19 ॥ ॥
तुलनीय - कथासरित्सागरे वेतालपञ्चविंशति
3.2.m:
By whichever men the accusation was made, ‘A Brahmin-slaughter was committed by you,’ / upon those men, fallen from justice, falls that slaughter of a Brahmin.”
Compare: the Vetālapañcaviṃśati in the Kathāsaritsāgara.

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kṛtakṛtyaḥ prasannātmā vaitālo nṛpamabravīt ..
nagare candrahṛdaye raṇadhīro nṛpo'bhavat .. 1 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
कृतकृत्यः प्रसन्नात्मा वैतालो नृपमब्रवीत् ॥
नगरे चन्द्रहृदये रणधीरो नृपोऽभवत् ॥ 1 ॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / Satisfied and pleased in mind, the vetāla spoke to the king: / “In the city of Candrahṛdaya, there was a king named Raṇadhīra.

3.2.s:
tatra vaiśyo'vasaddharmī nāmnā dharmadhvajo dhanī ..
tasya putrī samāyātā sundarī sukhabhāvinī .. 2 ..
3.2.d:
तत्र वैश्योऽवसद्धर्मी नाम्ना धर्मध्वजो धनी ॥
तस्य पुत्री समायाता सुन्दरी सुखभाविनी ॥ 2 ॥
3.2.m: There lived a righteous and wealthy vaiśya named Dharmadhvaja; / to him was born a daughter, beautiful and devoted to pleasure.

3.2.s:
ekadā nagare tasminyātubhakto naro'bhavat ..
dyūtavidyāparo nityaṃ madyamāṃsaparāyaṇaḥ .. 3 ..
3.2.d:
एकदा नगरे तस्मिन्यातुभक्तो नरोऽभवत् ॥
द्यूतविद्यापरो नित्यं मद्यमांसपरायणः ॥ 3 ॥
3.2.m: Once in that city, there was a man who worshipped spirits, / constantly addicted to the art of gambling and devoted to liquor and meat.

3.2.s:
vāśaro nāma tatrāsīdrākṣasaḥ puruṣādanaḥ ..
tasmai madyaṃ ca māṃsaṃ ca pratyahaṃ sa ca dattavān .. 4 ..
3.2.d:
वाशरो नाम तत्रासीद्राक्षसः पुरुषादनः ॥
तस्मै मद्यं च मांसं च प्रत्यहं स च दत्तवान् ॥ 4 ॥
3.2.m: There was a man-eating rākṣasa named Vāśara; / he offered wine and meat to him every day.

3.2.s:
prasanno rākṣaso bhūtvā yātubhaktaṃ tamabravīt ..
varaṃ varaya yo yogyo mattaḥ sarvamavāpsyasi .. 5 ..
3.2.d:
प्रसन्नो राक्षसो भूत्वा यातुभक्तं तमब्रवीत् ॥
वरं वरय यो योग्यो मत्तः सर्वमवाप्स्यसि ॥ 5 ॥
3.2.m: Being pleased, the rākṣasa said to that worshipper of spirits: / ‘Choose a boon that is fitting; you will obtain everything from me.’

3.2.s:
sa hovāca varo mahyaṃ deyaste puruṣādaka ..
guptagartaṃ ca bhūmadhye kuru cauranirūpaṇam .. 6 ..
3.2.d:
स होवाच वरो मह्यं देयस्ते पुरुषादक ॥
गुप्तगर्तं च भूमध्ये कुरु चौरनिरूपणम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.2.m: He indeed said: ‘A boon must be given to me by you, O man-eater: / create a hidden pit inside the earth, an abode for a thief.’

3.2.s:
iti śrutvākarodgartaṃ nara buddhivimohanam ..
svayaṃ tatra sthito devaḥ svabhaktena samanvitaḥ .. 7 ..
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वाकरोद्गर्तं नर बुद्धिविमोहनम् ॥
स्वयं तत्र स्थितो देवः स्वभक्तेन समन्वितः ॥ 7 ॥
3.2.m: Hearing this, he made a pit that bewildered the minds of men; / the god himself stayed there together with his devotee.

3.2.s:
tena rātrau tu cauryeṇa nṛpadāsī varāṃganā ..
hṛtā saṃsthāpitā garte bahudravyaṃ tathā hṛtam .. 8 ..
3.2.d:
तेन रात्रौ तु चौर्येण नृपदासी वरांगना ॥
हृता संस्थापिता गर्ते बहुद्रव्यं तथा हृतम् ॥ 8 ॥
3.2.m: By him at night, through theft, the king’s maidservant, an excellent woman, / was abducted and placed in the pit, and much wealth was likewise stolen.

3.2.s:
saptapatnyo'bhavaṃstasya caturvarṇasya yoṣitaḥ ..
tāsāṃ madhye bhūpadāsī tasya caurasya vallabhā .. 9 ..
3.2.d:
सप्तपत्न्योऽभवंस्तस्य चतुर्वर्णस्य योषितः ॥
तासां मध्ये भूपदासी तस्य चौरस्य वल्लभा ॥ 9 ॥
3.2.m: He had seven wives, women from the four classes; / among them, the king’s maidservant was beloved of that thief.

3.2.s:
nṛpadurgasamaṃ gehaṃ racitaṃ tena rakṣasā ..
bhūtale guptarūpaṃ ca narabuddhivimohanam.. 3.2.13.10 ..
3.2.d:
नृपदुर्गसमं गेहं रचितं तेन रक्षसा ॥
भूतले गुप्तरूपं च नरबुद्धिविमोहनम्॥ 3.2.13.10 ॥
3.2.m: A dwelling resembling a king's fortress was constructed by that rākṣasa, / hidden within the earth, baffling human intelligence.

3.2.s:
coritaṃ bahudhā dravyaṃ garte saṃsthāpitaṃ balāt..
tadā te vyākulā rājañjanā rājānamabru van .. 11 ..
3.2.d:
चोरितं बहुधा द्रव्यं गर्ते संस्थापितं बलात्॥
तदा ते व्याकुला राजञ्जना राजानमब्रु वन् ॥ 11 ॥
3.2.m: Vast wealth was stolen and stored in the pit by force; / then those distressed people, O king, said to the king:

3.2.s:
tyajāma nagarīṃ bhūpa cauravighnakarīṃ tava ..
iti śrutvātha bhūpena rakṣiṇaḥ śastrasaṃyutāḥ ..
sthāpitā nagare tasmiścaurahiṃsāparāya ṇāḥ .. 12 ..
3.2.d:
त्यजाम नगरीं भूप चौरविघ्नकरीं तव ॥
इति श्रुत्वाथ भूपेन रक्षिणः शस्त्रसंयुताः ॥
स्थापिता नगरे तस्मिश्चौरहिंसापराय णाः ॥ 12 ॥
3.2.m: ‘O king, we will leave your city, which is troubled by thieves.’ / Hearing this, guards equipped with weapons, / intent on slaying thieves, were stationed in that city by the king.

3.2.s: ājñāpya sa yayau gehaṃ taistu śrutvā tathā kṛtam .. 13 ..
3.2.d: आज्ञाप्य स ययौ गेहं तैस्तु श्रुत्वा तथा कृतम् ॥ 13 ॥
3.2.m: Having issued the command, he went home; and hearing it, they acted accordingly.

3.2.s:
rākṣasyā māyayā sarve mohitā rakṣiṇastadā ..
caureṇa bahudhā dravyaṃ hṛtaṃ ca dhanināṃ valāt .. 14 ..
3.2.d:
राक्षस्या मायया सर्वे मोहिता रक्षिणस्तदा ॥
चौरेण बहुधा द्रव्यं हृतं च धनिनां वलात् ॥ 14 ॥
3.2.m: All the guards were then bewitched by the illusion of the rākṣasa; / by the thief, much wealth was stolen by force from the rich.

3.2.s:
punaste prayayurbhūpaṃ raṇadhīraṃ samerayan ..
śrutvā tu vismito rājā svayaṃ nagaramāgataḥ .. 15 ..
3.2.d:
पुनस्ते प्रययुर्भूपं रणधीरं समेरयन् ॥
श्रुत्वा तु विस्मितो राजा स्वयं नगरमागतः ॥ 15 ॥
3.2.m: Again they went to the king and reported to Raṇadhīra; / hearing it, the king was astonished and went into the city himself.

3.2.s:
ardharātre tamobhūte sa cauro nṛpamāgatam ..
jñātvābravīcca rājānaṃ ko bhavānatra cāptavān .. 16 ..
3.2.d:
अर्धरात्रे तमोभूते स चौरो नृपमागतम् ॥
ज्ञात्वाब्रवीच्च राजानं को भवानत्र चाप्तवान् ॥ 16 ॥
3.2.m: At midnight, when it had become dark, that thief, / knowing the king had come, said to the king: ‘Who are you who have come here?’

3.2.s:
nṛpo'bravīdahaṃ cauraścoditārthaḥ samāgataḥ ..
yāsyāmi dhanināṃ gehe bhavānme vacanaṃ kuru .. 17 ..
3.2.d:
नृपोऽब्रवीदहं चौरश्चोदितार्थः समागतः ॥
यास्यामि धनिनां गेहे भवान्मे वचनं कुरु ॥ 17 ॥
3.2.m: The king said: ‘I am a thief who has come driven by need of wealth; / I will go to the houses of the rich; heed my word:

3.2.s:
mayā sārddhaṃ ca bahudhā dravyaṃ hara sukhī bhava ..
tathā matvā tu bahudhā caureṇa dhanamāhṛtam .. 18 ..
3.2.d:
मया सार्द्धं च बहुधा द्रव्यं हर सुखी भव ॥
तथा मत्वा तु बहुधा चौरेण धनमाहृतम् ॥ 18 ॥
3.2.m: Steal much wealth together with me and be happy.’ / Agreeing to this, much wealth was stolen by the thief.

3.2.s:
gartamadhye gato rātrau sthāpayitvā nṛpaṃ bahiḥ ..
etasminneva tatpatnī nṛpadāsī varāṃganā .. 19 ..
3.2.d:
गर्तमध्ये गतो रात्रौ स्थापयित्वा नृपं बहिः ॥
एतस्मिन्नेव तत्पत्नी नृपदासी वरांगना ॥ 19 ॥
3.2.m: At night, he went into the pit, having left the king outside; / at that very moment, his wife, the king’s maidservant, an excellent woman,

3.2.s:
bhūpatiṃ prāha bho rājangaccha śīghraṃ svakaṃ gṛham ..
cauro'sau hi tvadarthe ca mṛtyuṃ kurvangṛhaṃ gataḥ .. 3.2.13.20 ..
3.2.d:
भूपतिं प्राह भो राजन्गच्छ शीघ्रं स्वकं गृहम् ॥
चौरोऽसौ हि त्वदर्थे च मृत्युं कुर्वन्गृहं गतः ॥ 3.2.13.20 ॥
3.2.m: said to the king: ‘O king, go quickly to your own house! / This thief has gone into the house intending to kill you.’

3.2.s:
ityuktvā sā tu bhūpāya mārgabhedamadarśayat ..
nṛpo'pi svagṛhaṃ prāpya prabhāte vimale ravau .. 21 ..
3.2.d:
इत्युक्त्वा सा तु भूपाय मार्गभेदमदर्शयत् ॥
नृपोऽपि स्वगृहं प्राप्य प्रभाते विमले रवौ ॥ 21 ॥
3.2.m: Having spoken thus, she showed another way to the king; / the king also reached his own house, and at dawn, when the sun was bright,

3.2.s:
āyayau senayā sārddhaṃ yatra cauraḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ ..
cauro'pi bhayamāsādya vāśaraṃ nāma rākṣasam .. 22 ..
3.2.d:
आययौ सेनया सार्द्धं यत्र चौरः स्वयं स्थितः ॥
चौरोऽपि भयमासाद्य वाशरं नाम राक्षसम् ॥ 22 ॥
3.2.m: he came along with an army to where the thief himself was staying. / The thief too, seized with fear, having worshipped the rākṣasa

3.2.s:
saṃpūjya varṇayāmāsa yathā jātaṃ tathāvidhi ..
vihasyāha ca rakṣastaṃ tvayā me bhojanaṃ kṛtam. 23 ..
3.2.d:
संपूज्य वर्णयामास यथा जातं तथाविधि ॥
विहस्याह च रक्षस्तं त्वया मे भोजनं कृतम्। 23 ॥
3.2.m: named Vāśara, described duly what had happened. / Laughing, the rākṣasa said to him: ‘Food has been prepared for me by you;

3.2.s:
adya bhakṣyāmyahaṃ sarvānmānuṣāndaivacoditān ..
ityuktvā sa yayau ghoro rākṣaso nṛpatiṃ prati .. .. 24 ..
3.2.d:
अद्य भक्ष्याम्यहं सर्वान्मानुषान्दैवचोदितान् ॥
इत्युक्त्वा स ययौ घोरो राक्षसो नृपतिं प्रति ॥ ॥ 24 ॥
3.2.m: today I shall devour all these men impelled by fate.’ / Having spoken thus, that dreadful rākṣasa went against the king.

3.2.s:
cakhāda bahulāṃ senāṃ tepi yātā diśo daśa ..
ākrāṃtaḥ sa ca bhūpālo rakṣasā vikalīkṛtaḥ .. 25 ..
3.2.d:
चखाद बहुलां सेनां तेपि याता दिशो दश ॥
आक्रांतः स च भूपालो रक्षसा विकलीकृतः ॥ 25 ॥
3.2.m: He devoured a large army, and they fled in the ten directions; / and that king, assaulted, was overwhelmed by the rākṣasa.

3.2.s:
tadā cauraḥ svayaṃ prāpya bhūpatiṃ prāha roṣataḥ ..
palāyanaṃ na bhūpasya yogyaṃ dharmajanasya vai .. 26 ..
3.2.d:
तदा चौरः स्वयं प्राप्य भूपतिं प्राह रोषतः ॥
पलायनं न भूपस्य योग्यं धर्मजनस्य वै ॥ 26 ॥
3.2.m: Then the thief himself approached the king and said angrily: / ‘Flight is not proper for a king, a man of righteousness!’

3.2.s:
iti śrutvā nṛpaścaiva tūrṇamāgatya tatra ha ..
dhyātvā devīṃ mahākālīṃ labdhvā maṃtraṃ mahottamam .. 27 ..
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वा नृपश्चैव तूर्णमागत्य तत्र ह ॥
ध्यात्वा देवीं महाकालीं लब्ध्वा मंत्रं महोत्तमम् ॥ 27 ॥
3.2.m: Hearing this, the king quickly came right there; / meditating on the goddess Mahākālī and obtaining a supreme mantra,

3.2.s:
rakṣasā saha tadgartaṃ bhasmasādabhavatkṣaṇāt ..
nigaḍaistaṃ babaṃdhāśu cauraṃ nagaraluṃṭhakam .. 28 ..
3.2.d:
रक्षसा सह तद्गर्तं भस्मसादभवत्क्षणात् ॥
निगडैस्तं बबंधाशु चौरं नगरलुंठकम् ॥ 28 ॥
3.2.m: that pit along with the rākṣasa was reduced to ashes in an instant. / He quickly bound with fetters that thief who plundered the city.

3.2.s:
tathā sarvadhanaiḥ sārdhaṃ strībhistābhiḥ samāyayau ..
rājyasthānaṃ samāsādya durgatistasya cābhavat .. 29 ..
3.2.d:
तथा सर्वधनैः सार्धं स्त्रीभिस्ताभिः समाययौ ॥
राज्यस्थानं समासाद्य दुर्गतिस्तस्य चाभवत् ॥ 29 ॥
3.2.m: So he departed along with all the wealth and those women; / having arrived at the capital, distress befell him [the thief].

3.2.s:
paṭahātāḍitenaiva śabdena ca gṛhegṛhe ..
jñāpitaṃ karaṇaṃ sarvaṃ taccaurasya vadhasya taiḥ .. 3.2.13.30 ..
3.2.d:
पटहाताडितेनैव शब्देन च गृहेगृहे ॥
ज्ञापितं करणं सर्वं तच्चौरस्य वधस्य तैः ॥ 3.2.13.30 ॥
3.2.m: By the very sound beaten on kettledrums, in house after house, / all the preparation for the execution of that thief was announced by them.

3.2.s:
taddine nagare tasminbhrāmito gardabhopari ..
dharmadhvajagṛhadvāre sa cauro hi samāgataḥ .. 31 ..
3.2.d:
तद्दिने नगरे तस्मिन्भ्रामितो गर्दभोपरि ॥
धर्मध्वजगृहद्वारे स चौरो हि समागतः ॥ 31 ॥
3.2.m:
On that day, he was paraded upon a donkey through that city;
and indeed, that thief arrived at the door of Dharmadhvaja's house.

3.2.s:
tasya rūpaṃ samālokya mumoha sukhabhāvinī ..
pitaraṃ prāha duḥkhārtā cauraṃ mocaya satvaram .. 32 ..
3.2.d:
तस्य रूपं समालोक्य मुमोह सुखभाविनी ॥
पितरं प्राह दुःखार्ता चौरं मोचय सत्वरम् ॥ 32 ॥
3.2.m:
Looking upon his handsome form, the joyous maiden was infatuated.
Afflicted with sorrow, she said to her father: "Release the thief quickly!

3.2.s:
sa gatvā nṛpatiṃ prāha paṃcalakṣadhanaṃ mama ..
gṛhāṇa cauramokṣārthe mriyate na hi me sutā .. 33 ..
3.2.d:
स गत्वा नृपतिं प्राह पंचलक्षधनं मम ॥
गृहाण चौरमोक्षार्थे म्रियते न हि मे सुता ॥ 33 ॥
3.2.m:
Going to the king, he said: "Take five hundred thousand [coins] of my wealth
for the release of the thief, so that my daughter will not die!"

3.2.s:
vihasyāha nṛpastaṃ vai cauro'yaṃ dhanaluṃṭhakaḥ ..
karhicinna mayā tyājyo bhuvi vai puruṣādhamaḥ .. 34 ..
3.2.d:
विहस्याह नृपस्तं वै चौरोऽयं धनलुंठकः ॥
कर्हिचिन्न मया त्याज्यो भुवि वै पुरुषाधमः ॥ 34 ॥
3.2.m:
Laughing, the king said to him: "This thief is a plunderer of wealth;
never shall this vilest of men be released by me in this world!"

3.2.s:
iti śrutvā nirāśo'bhūtsa cauro maraṇaṃ gataḥ ..
śalyāropaṇakāle tu prākprahasya tato'rudat .. 35 ..
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वा निराशोऽभूत्स चौरो मरणं गतः ॥
शल्यारोपणकाले तु प्राक्प्रहस्य ततोऽरुदत् ॥ 35 ॥
3.2.m:
Hearing this, he became despondent; that thief met his death.
Yet at the time of being impaled on the stake, having first laughed aloud, he then wept.

3.2.s:
etasminneva tatputrī devamāyāvimohitā ..
gṛhītvā cauradehaṃ tu vahnikuṇḍe tu sāgamat .. 36 ..
3.2.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव तत्पुत्री देवमायाविमोहिता ॥
गृहीत्वा चौरदेहं तु वह्निकुण्डे तु सागमत् ॥ 36 ॥
3.2.m:
At that very time, his daughter, deluded by divine māyā,
took the thief's body and entered the pit of fire.

3.2.s:
tadā prasannā sā durgā tāvujīvya prasādataḥ ..
tasyai datto varo divyo bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ .. 37 ..
3.2.d:
तदा प्रसन्ना सा दुर्गा तावुजीव्य प्रसादतः ॥
तस्यै दत्तो वरो दिव्यो भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः ॥ 37 ॥
3.2.m:
Then, being pleased, Durgā brought the two back to life by her grace;
to her she granted a divine boon that bestows the fruits of worldly enjoyment and liberation.

3.2.s:
ityuktvā sa tu bhūpālaṃ punaḥ prāha vihasya tam ..
kiṃ kāraṇena caurosau prākprahasya tato'rudat .. 38 ..
3.2.d:
इत्युक्त्वा स तु भूपालं पुनः प्राह विहस्य तम् ॥
किं कारणेन चौरोसौ प्राक्प्रहस्य ततोऽरुदत् ॥ 38 ॥
3.2.m:
Having said this, he laughed and asked the king once more:
"For what reason did that thief first laugh aloud and then weep?"

3.2.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
madarthe sundarī nārī svaprāṇāndātumudyatā ..
tasyai kiṃ ca pradātavyaṃ mayā tatsneharūpiṇā .. 39 ..
3.2.d:
॥ राजोवाच ॥ ॥
मदर्थे सुन्दरी नारी स्वप्राणान्दातुमुद्यता ॥
तस्यै किं च प्रदातव्यं मया तत्स्नेहरूपिणा ॥ 39 ॥

3.2.s:
ato roditavānpaścāddhasane kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu ..
dhanyo'yaṃ bhagavānkṛṣṇo yasya līleyamīdṛśī .. .. 3.2.13.40 ..
3.2.d:
अतो रोदितवान्पश्चाद्धसने कारणं शृणु ॥
धन्योऽयं भगवान्कृष्णो यस्य लीलेयमीदृशी ॥ ॥ 3.2.13.40 ॥
3.2.m:
Therefore he wept; now hear the reason for his laughing:
'Blessed is the Lord Kṛṣṇa, whose divine play is like this!

3.2.s:
adharmiṇe ca nākasya phalaṃ dātuṃ samarhati ..
dharmiṇe narakasyaiva phalaṃ tasmai namonamaḥ .. 41 ..
3.2.d:
अधर्मिणे च नाकस्य फलं दातुं समर्हति ॥
धर्मिणे नरकस्यैव फलं तस्मै नमोनमः ॥ 41 ॥
3.2.m:
He is able to grant the fruit of heaven to an unrighteous man,
and the fruit of hell to a righteous one! Obeisance, obeisance to him!'"

3.2.s:
ataḥ sa hasitaḥ pūrvaṃ mohito harilīlayā ..
iti śrutvāha vaitālo hareḥ śaraṇamuttamam .. 42 ..
3.2.d:
अतः स हसितः पूर्वं मोहितो हरिलीलया ॥
इति श्रुत्वाह वैतालो हरेः शरणमुत्तमम् ॥ 42 ॥
3.2.m:
"Therefore he laughed previously, bewildered by the divine play of Hari."
Hearing this, the vetāla said: "The supreme refuge is in Hari;

3.2.s:
vākyaṃ tena kṛtaṃ śūlyāmato jīvitavācchuciḥ .. 43 ..
tulanīya - vetālapaṃcaviṃśati
3.2.d:
वाक्यं तेन कृतं शूल्यामतो जीवितवाच्छुचिः ॥ 43 ॥
तुलनीय - वेतालपंचविंशति
3.2.m:
this utterance was made by him upon the stake, and so, purified, he was revived."
Comparative: Vetālapañcaviṃśati.

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
bhṛguvarya mahābhāga vaitālo nṛpamabravīt ..
rājanpuṣpāvatī ramyā nagarī tatra bhūpatiḥ ..
suvicāra iti khyātaḥ prajāpālanatatparaḥ .. 1 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
भृगुवर्य महाभाग वैतालो नृपमब्रवीत् ॥
राजन्पुष्पावती रम्या नगरी तत्र भूपतिः ॥
सुविचार इति ख्यातः प्रजापालनतत्परः ॥ 1 ॥
3.2.m:
Sūta said:
O best of the Bhṛgus, O fortunate one, the vetāla spoke to the king:
"O King, there is a delightful city named Puṣpāvatī; the king there,
renowned as Suvicāra, was intent upon protecting his subjects.

3.2.s:
candraprabhā tasya patnī rūpayauvana śālinī ..
tasyāṃ jātā sutā devī nāmnā candrāvalī matā .. 2 ..
3.2.d:
चन्द्रप्रभा तस्य पत्नी रूपयौवन शालिनी ॥
तस्यां जाता सुता देवी नाम्ना चन्द्रावली मता ॥ 2 ॥
3.2.m:
His wife Candraprabhā was endowed with beauty and youth;
to her was born a divine daughter named Candrāvalī.

3.2.s:
kadācitsvālibhiḥ sārddhaṃ vipinaṃ kusumākaram ..
āyayau tatra vai vipraṃ sudevaṃ sā dadarśa ha ..3..
3.2.d:
कदाचित्स्वालिभिः सार्द्धं विपिनं कुसुमाकरम् ॥
आययौ तत्र वै विप्रं सुदेवं सा ददर्श ह ॥3॥
3.2.m:
Once, accompanied by her female companions, she went to a blooming grove;
there she beheld the brāhmaṇa Sudeva.

3.2.s:
mohitā cābhavaddevī vipropi patitaḥ kṣitau ..
kāmabāṇavyathāṃ prāpya gataprāṇa ivābhavat .. 4 ..
3.2.d:
मोहिता चाभवद्देवी विप्रोपि पतितः क्षितौ ॥
कामबाणव्यथां प्राप्य गतप्राण इवाभवत् ॥ 4 ॥
3.2.m:
The princess was smitten, and the brāhmaṇa also collapsed to the ground;
suffering from the agony of the arrows of Kāma, he became as if lifeless.

3.2.s:
tasyāṃ gatāyāṃ sadane dvau viprau tatra cāgatau ..
mūladevaḥ śaśī nāmnā tatra vidyāviśāradau ..5..
3.2.d:
तस्यां गतायां सदने द्वौ विप्रौ तत्र चागतौ ॥
मूलदेवः शशी नाम्ना तत्र विद्याविशारदौ ॥5॥
3.2.m:
When she had returned to her residence, two brāhmaṇas arrived there,
named Mūladeva and Śaśin, both skilled in the arts.

3.2.s:
tathāgataṃ dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpayauvanaśālinam ..
papraccha kāraṇaṃ sarva yena mohatvamāgataḥ .. 6 ..
3.2.d:
तथागतं द्विजं दृष्ट्वा रूपयौवनशालिनम् ॥
पप्रच्छ कारणं सर्व येन मोहत्वमागतः ॥ 6 ॥
3.2.m:
Seeing the twice-born youth endowed with beauty and youth in that condition,
he asked for the whole cause by which he had fallen into unconsciousness.

3.2.s:
sa śrutvā rodanaṃ kṛtvā sarvaṃ tasmai nyavedayat ..
kṛpālurmūladevastu taṃ svagehamavāptavān .. 7 ..
3.2.d:
स श्रुत्वा रोदनं कृत्वा सर्वं तस्मै न्यवेदयत् ॥
कृपालुर्मूलदेवस्तु तं स्वगेहमवाप्तवान् ॥ 7 ॥
3.2.m:
Hearing him, he wept and related everything to him;
and compassionate Mūladeva took him to his own house.

3.2.s:
gṛhe japtvā mahāmaṃtraṃ cāmuṇḍābījasaṃyutam ..
kṛtavānguṭike cobhe sudevāya samārpayat .. 8 ..
3.2.d:
गृहे जप्त्वा महामंत्रं चामुण्डाबीजसंयुतम् ॥
कृतवान्गुटिके चोभे सुदेवाय समार्पयत् ॥ 8 ॥
3.2.m:
Chanting a great mantra endowed with the seed-syllable of Cāmuṇḍā in his house,
he made two pills and handed them to Sudeva.

3.2.s:
ekayā suṃdarī kanyā dvādaśābdamayī śubhā ..
dvitīyayā mahāvṛddho mūladevastadābhavat .. 9 ..
3.2.d:
एकया सुंदरी कन्या द्वादशाब्दमयी शुभा ॥
द्वितीयया महावृद्धो मूलदेवस्तदाभवत् ॥ 9 ॥
3.2.m:
With one, he became an auspicious, beautiful twelve-year-old maiden;
with the second, Mūladeva then became a very old man.

3.2.s:
dvau gatau rājasadane nṛpamāśīrbhirarcya tam ..
hetuṃ nivedayāmāsa tacchuṇuṣva mahāmate ..3.2.14.10..
3.2.d:
द्वौ गतौ राजसदने नृपमाशीर्भिरर्च्य तम् ॥
हेतुं निवेदयामास तच्छुणुष्व महामते ॥3.2.14.10॥
3.2.m:
Both went to the royal palace, and having honoured the king with blessings,
he stated the reason [for their arrival]; listen to that, O wise one:

3.2.s:
nagare tāṃtrike rājanmadgehaṃ sundaropamam ..
vilāpadhvajanāmnā vai rājñā saṃluṭhitaṃ balāt..1 1..
3.2.d:
नगरे तांत्रिके राजन्मद्गेहं सुन्दरोपमम् ॥
विलापध्वजनाम्ना वै राज्ञा संलुठितं बलात्॥1 1॥
3.2.m:
'O King, in the Tantric city, my house, which was like an abode of beauty,
was violently plundered by the king named Vilāpadhvaja.

3.2.s:
palāyitau sutaḥ patnī tāvanveṣṭuṃ samāyayau..
iyaṃ vadhūrmahārāja mama tatputrabhāvinī..12..
3.2.d:
पलायितौ सुतः पत्नी तावन्वेष्टुं समाययौ॥
इयं वधूर्महाराज मम तत्पुत्रभाविनी॥12॥
3.2.m:
My son and wife have fled; I have come here to search for them.
O Great King, this maiden is my daughter-in-law, intended for that son.

3.2.s:
yāvadahaṃ na gacchāmi svagehe rakṣa dharmataḥ ..
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatiścāhūya svasutāṃ tadā ..
tasyai samarpya tāṃ paścātsa dvijo gehamāyayau .. 13 ..
3.2.d:
यावदहं न गच्छामि स्वगेहे रक्ष धर्मतः ॥
इति श्रुत्वा स नृपतिश्चाहूय स्वसुतां तदा ॥
तस्यै समर्प्य तां पश्चात्स द्विजो गेहमाययौ ॥ 13 ॥
3.2.m:
Protect her righteously until I return to my home.'
Hearing this, the king then summoned his own daughter,
and having entrusted her to her, the twice-born man went home.

3.2.s:
sudevastu niśīthe vai ramaṇīṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ..
kutaste mana udvignaṃ satyaṃ kathaya me sakhi ..14..
3.2.d:
सुदेवस्तु निशीथे वै रमणीं प्राह निर्भयः॥
कुतस्ते मन उद्विग्नं सत्यं कथय मे सखि ॥14॥
3.2.m:
At midnight, Sudeva, free from fear, said to the lovely woman:
'Why is your mind agitated? Tell me the truth, my friend.'

3.2.s:
sāha me hṛdaye nityaṃ sudevo brāhmaṇottamaḥ ..
uṣitastadviyogena vyākulāhaṃ sadā sakhe ..15..
3.2.d:
साह मे हृदये नित्यं सुदेवो ब्राह्मणोत्तमः ॥
उषितस्तद्वियोगेन व्याकुलाहं सदा सखे ॥15॥
3.2.m:
She said: 'Sudeva, the best of brāhmaṇas, dwells constantly in my heart;
due to separation from him, I am always distraught, my friend.'

3.2.s:
sudevaścāha bhoḥ subhūryadi te brāhmaṇottamam ..
samarpayāmi tattvaṃ me kiṃ dadāsi vadasva bhoḥ ..
sāha te sarvadā dāsī bhavāmi dvijabhāmini ..16..
3.2.d:
सुदेवश्चाह भोः सुभूर्यदि ते ब्राह्मणोत्तमम् ॥
समर्पयामि तत्त्वं मे किं ददासि वदस्व भोः ॥
साह ते सर्वदा दासी भवामि द्विजभामिनि ॥16॥
3.2.m:
Sudeva said: 'O fair-browed one, if I deliver that best of brāhmaṇas to you,
then tell me, what will you give me?'
She said: 'I will become your maidservant forever, O wife of the twice-born!'

3.2.s:
iti śrutvā sudevastu mukhānniṣkṛṣya yaṃtrakam ..
pūrvadehatvamāpannastayā sārddhaṃ samāramat .. 17 ..
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वा सुदेवस्तु मुखान्निष्कृष्य यंत्रकम् ॥
पूर्वदेहत्वमापन्नस्तया सार्द्धं समारमत् ॥ 17 ॥
3.2.m:
Hearing this, Sudeva took the magical object out of his mouth,
assumed his former body, and made love with her.

3.2.s: caturmāsyo bhavadgarbhastasminkāle tu bho nṛpa .. .. 18 ..
3.2.d: चतुर्मास्यो भवद्गर्भस्तस्मिन्काले तु भो नृप ॥ ॥ 18 ॥
3.2.m: At that time, O King, her pregnancy became four months old.

3.2.s:
amātyatanayo viprastrīrūpaṃ prati mohitaḥ ..
tadā maraṇasampannaṃ jñātvā taṃ madanālasam .. 19 ..
3.2.d:
अमात्यतनयो विप्रस्त्रीरूपं प्रति मोहितः ॥
तदा मरणसम्पन्नं ज्ञात्वा तं मदनालसम् ॥ 19 ॥
3.2.m:
The minister's son was infatuated with the form of that brāhmaṇa woman;
knowing him to be languid with desire and brought close to death,

3.2.s:
mantrī snehācca bahudhā sañcitya hṛdi paṃḍitaiḥ ..
tasmai samarpayāmāsa tāṃ nārīṃ mantrasambhavām .. 3.2.14.20 ..
3.2.d:
मन्त्री स्नेहाच्च बहुधा सञ्चित्य हृदि पंडितैः ॥
तस्मै समर्पयामास तां नारीं मन्त्रसम्भवाम् ॥ 3.2.14.20 ॥
3.2.m:
the minister, out of affection, having deliberated deeply in his heart with learned men,
surrendered to him that woman produced by mantra.

3.2.s:
sāha bhomātyatanaya trimāsaṃ tīrthamaṇḍale ..
saṃsnāhi tarhi me yogyo bhaviṣyasi tathā kuru .. 21 ..
3.2.d:
साह भोमात्यतनय त्रिमासं तीर्थमण्डले ॥
संस्नाहि तर्हि मे योग्यो भविष्यसि तथा कुरु ॥ 21 ॥
3.2.m:
She said: 'O minister's son, bathe thoroughly in the circuit of sacred fords for three months;
then you will be fit for me; act accordingly.'

3.2.s:
tathā matvā maṃtrisuto namrātmā madanālasaḥ ..
tīrthāṃtaraṃ gataḥ so'pi sudevastasya yoṣitam .. 22 ..
3.2.d:
तथा मत्वा मंत्रिसुतो नम्रात्मा मदनालसः ॥
तीर्थांतरं गतः सोऽपि सुदेवस्तस्य योषितम् ॥ 22 ॥
3.2.m:
Accepting this, the minister's son, humble in mind and languid with desire,
departed for other sacred fords; meanwhile, Sudeva [approached] his woman.

3.2.s:
bhūpakāṃtiṃ kāmavaśāṃ cāliliṃga sa kāmukaḥ ..
sā tu garbhaṃ dadhārāśu dvimāsasya dvijena vai .. 23 ..
3.2.d:
भूपकांतिं कामवशां चालिलिंग स कामुकः ॥
सा तु गर्भं दधाराशु द्विमासस्य द्विजेन वै ॥ 23 ॥
3.2.m:
That lustful man embraced the one possessed of royal splendour, who was overpowered by desire;
and indeed, through that twice-born man, she quickly bore a pregnancy of two months.

3.2.s:
sudevo mānuṣo bhūtvā mūladevagṛhaṃ yayau ..
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa yathājātaṃ nṛpālaye .. 24 ..
3.2.d:
सुदेवो मानुषो भूत्वा मूलदेवगृहं ययौ ॥
सर्वं निवेदयामास यथाजातं नृपालये ॥ 24 ॥
3.2.m:
Sudeva, returning to human form, went to Mūladeva's house
and reported everything that had happened in the king's palace.

3.2.s:
mūladevaḥ prasannātmā śaśinaṃ nāma mitrakam ..
viṃśadvarṣataraṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ vṛddhasya rūpavān .. 25 ..
3.2.d:
मूलदेवः प्रसन्नात्मा शशिनं नाम मित्रकम् ॥
विंशद्वर्षतरं कृत्वा स्वयं वृद्धस्य रूपवान् ॥ 25 ॥
3.2.m:
Mūladeva, cheerful in mind, made his friend named Śaśin
into a youth of twenty years, while he himself took the form of an old man.

3.2.s:
rājñe nivedya tatsarvaṃ vadhūṃ me dehi bhūpate ..
tadā tu sa nṛpo bhītyā taṃ prāha ślakṣṇayā girā .. 26 ..
3.2.d:
राज्ञे निवेद्य तत्सर्वं वधूं मे देहि भूपते ॥
तदा तु स नृपो भीत्या तं प्राह श्लक्ष्णया गिरा ॥ 26 ॥
3.2.m:
Having reported all that to the king, he said: 'Give me back my daughter-in-law, O protector of the earth!'
Then, out of fear, that king spoke to him in smooth words:

3.2.s:
mantrī rājakaro nāma tatputro madanālasaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā tava vadhūṃ ramyāṃ mumoha maraṇonmukhaḥ .. 27 ..
3.2.d:
मन्त्री राजकरो नाम तत्पुत्रो मदनालसः ॥
दृष्ट्वा तव वधूं रम्यां मुमोह मरणोन्मुखः ॥ 27 ॥
3.2.m:
'There is a minister named Rājakara; his son, languid with desire,
seeing your lovely daughter-in-law, fell into delusion and was about to die.

3.2.s:
svaputrasya viyogena sa mantrī ca tathedṛśaḥ ..
tathāhaṃ brāhmaṇānvṛddhānpṛṣṭvā tasmai ca tāmadām .. 28 ..
3.2.d:
स्वपुत्रस्य वियोगेन स मन्त्री च तथेदृशः ॥
तथाहं ब्राह्मणान्वृद्धान्पृष्ट्वा तस्मै च तामदाम् ॥ 28 ॥
3.2.m:
Due to the [imminent] loss of his own son, the minister was likewise distressed;
therefore, having consulted elder brāhmaṇas, I gave her to him.

3.2.s:
yathā prasanno hi bhavānkuru tvaṃ ca tathāvidham ..
mūladevastu nṛpatiṃ provāca viṣamudvaman .. 29 ..
3.2.d:
यथा प्रसन्नो हि भवान्कुरु त्वं च तथाविधम् ॥
मूलदेवस्तु नृपतिं प्रोवाच विषमुद्वमन् ॥ 29 ॥
3.2.m:
Act in such a manner as to be well pleased.'
Then Mūladeva, spitting poison, spoke to the king:

3.2.s:
dehi bhūpa sutāṃ mahyaṃ tatputrasya suratāya vai ..
tathaiva matvā sa nṛpaḥ sutāṃ candrāvalīṃ śubhām .. 3.2.14.30 ..
3.2.d:
देहि भूप सुतां मह्यं तत्पुत्रस्य सुरताय वै ॥
