3.2.m: The wealth that was in the house of that merchant devoid of truth, / the king seized, and his wife became exceedingly sorrowful on account of thieves.

3.2.s:
vāsolaṃkaraṇādīni vikrīya bubhuje kila ..
nāsti tatpacyate kiṃcittadā kaṣṭamagāhata .. 7 ..
3.2.d:
वासोलंकरणादीनि विक्रीय बुभुजे किल ॥
नास्ति तत्पच्यते किंचित्तदा कष्टमगाहत ॥ 7 ॥
3.2.m: Selling her clothes, ornaments, and other things, she managed to eat; / when there was nothing left to cook, she plunged into misery.

3.2.s:
athaikasmindine kanyā bhojanācchādanaṃ vinā ..
gatā vipragṛhe'paśyatsatyanārāyaṇārcanam .. 8 ..
3.2.d:
अथैकस्मिन्दिने कन्या भोजनाच्छादनं विना ॥
गता विप्रगृहेऽपश्यत्सत्यनारायणार्चनम् ॥ 8 ॥
3.2.m: Then one day the daughter, without food or clothing, / went to a Brahmin's house and saw the worship of Satyanārāyaṇa.

3.2.s:
prārthayaṃtaṃ jagannāthaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā prārthayaddharim ..
satyanārāyaṇa hare pitā bhartā ca me gṛham ..9..
3.2.d:
प्रार्थयंतं जगन्नाथं दृष्ट्वा सा प्रार्थयद्धरिम् ॥
सत्यनारायण हरे पिता भर्ता च मे गृहम् ॥9॥
3.2.m: Seeing [them] praying to the Lord of the Universe, she prayed to Hari: / "O Satyanārāyaṇa, O Hari, let my father and my husband return home!

3.2.s:
āgacchatvarcayiṣyāmi bhavaṃtamiti vācaye ..
tathāstu brāhmaṇairuktā tataḥ sā tvāśramaṃ yayau .. 3.2.29.10 ..
3.2.d:
आगच्छत्वर्चयिष्यामि भवंतमिति वाचये ॥
तथास्तु ब्राह्मणैरुक्ता ततः सा त्वाश्रमं ययौ ॥ 3.2.29.10 ॥
3.2.m: I shall worship You!"—so she promised. / Told by the Brahmins, "So be it," she went back to her hermitage.

3.2.s:
mātrā nirbhartsiteyaṃtaṃ kālaṃ kutra sthitā śubhe ..
vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsa satyanārāyaṇārcane .. 11 ..
3.2.d:
मात्रा निर्भर्त्सितेयंतं कालं कुत्र स्थिता शुभे ॥
वृत्तांतं कथयामास सत्यनारायणार्चने ॥ 11 ॥
3.2.m: Rebuked by her mother: "Where were you staying all this time, fortunate girl?" / she recounted the incident of the worship of Satyanārāyaṇa:

3.2.s:
kalau pratyakṣa phaladaḥ sarvadā kriyate naraiḥ ..
kartumicchāmyahaṃ mātaranujñātuṃ tvamarhasi .. 12 ..
3.2.d:
कलौ प्रत्यक्ष फलदः सर्वदा क्रियते नरैः ॥
कर्तुमिच्छाम्यहं मातरनुज्ञातुं त्वमर्हसि ॥ 12 ॥
3.2.m: "In the Kali age, it grants visible fruit; it is constantly performed by people. / I wish to perform it, mother; you ought to grant permission.

3.2.s:
deśamāyātu janakaḥ svāmī ca mama kāmanā ..
rātrau niścitya manasā prabhāte sā kalāvatī .. 13 ..
3.2.d:
देशमायातु जनकः स्वामी च मम कामना ॥
रात्रौ निश्चित्य मनसा प्रभाते सा कलावती ॥ 13 ॥
3.2.m: May my father and my husband return to their country; this is my desire." / Having resolved in her mind during the night, at dawn Kalāvatī

3.2.s:
śīlapālasya guptasya gehe prāptā dhanārthinī ..
baṃdho kiṃciddhanaṃ dehi yena satyārcanaṃ bhavet .. 14 ..
3.2.d:
शीलपालस्य गुप्तस्य गेहे प्राप्ता धनार्थिनी ॥
बंधो किंचिद्धनं देहि येन सत्यार्चनं भवेत् ॥ 14 ॥
3.2.m: went to the house of Śīlapāla Gupta, seeking wealth: / "O brother, give me some money so that the worship of Satya may take place!"

3.2.s:
iti śrutvā śīlapālaḥ paṃcaniṣkaṃ dhanaṃ dadau ..
tvatpituśca ṛṇaṃ śeṣaṃ mayītyeva kalāvati .. 15 ..
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वा शीलपालः पंचनिष्कं धनं ददौ ॥
त्वत्पितुश्च ऋणं शेषं मयीत्येव कलावति ॥ 15 ॥
3.2.m: Hearing this, Śīlapāla gave money, five niṣkas: / "A remaining debt of your father was upon me, O Kalāvatī!"

3.2.s:
ityuktvā so'nṛṇo bhūtvā gayāśrāddhāya saṃyayau ..
sutāpi tena dravyeṇa kṛtaṃ satyārcanaṃ śubham .. 16 ..
3.2.d:
इत्युक्त्वा सोऽनृणो भूत्वा गयाश्राद्धाय संययौ ॥
सुतापि तेन द्रव्येण कृतं सत्यार्चनं शुभम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.2.m: Having spoken thus, freed from debt, he departed for Gayā to perform śrāddha; / and the daughter, with that money, performed the auspicious worship of Satya.

3.2.s:
līlāvatī saha tayā bhaktyākārṣītprapūjanam..
pūjanena viśeṣeṇa tuṣṭo nārāyaṇo'bhavat..17..
3.2.d:
लीलावती सह तया भक्त्याकार्षीत्प्रपूजनम्॥
पूजनेन विशेषेण तुष्टो नारायणोऽभवत्॥17॥
3.2.m: Līlāvatī performed the worship together with her with devotion; / through that worship in particular, Nārāyaṇa was pleased.

3.2.s:
narmadātīranagare nṛpaḥ suṣvāpa maṃdire ..
rātriśeṣe suparyaṃke nidrāṃ kurvati rājani ..
uvāca viprarūpeṇa bodhayañchlakṣṇayā girā .. 18 ..
3.2.d:
नर्मदातीरनगरे नृपः सुष्वाप मंदिरे ॥
रात्रिशेषे सुपर्यंके निद्रां कुर्वति राजनि ॥
उवाच विप्ररूपेण बोधयञ्छ्लक्ष्णया गिरा ॥ 18 ॥
3.2.m: In a city on the bank of the Narmadā, the king slept in his palace. / At the end of the night, while the king was sleeping on an excellent couch, / [Viṣṇu], awakening him in the form of a brāhmaṇa, said in a gentle voice:

3.2.s:
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha rājendra tau sādhū parimocaya ..
aparādhaṃ vinā baddhau no cecchaṃ na bhavettava .. 19 ..
3.2.d:
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ राजेन्द्र तौ साधू परिमोचय ॥
अपराधं विना बद्धौ नो चेच्छं न भवेत्तव ॥ 19 ॥
3.2.m: “Arise, arise, O best of kings! Release those two merchants! / They were imprisoned without fault; otherwise, good fortune will not be yours.”

3.2.s:
ityevaṃ bhūpatiścaiva viprarūpeṇa bodhitaḥ ..
tadā hyantardadhe viṣṇu rvinidro nṛpatistadā .. 3.2.29.20 ..
3.2.d:
इत्येवं भूपतिश्चैव विप्ररूपेण बोधितः ॥
तदा ह्यन्तर्दधे विष्णु र्विनिद्रो नृपतिस्तदा ॥ 3.2.29.20 ॥
3.2.m: Being thus awakened by [Viṣṇu] in the form of a brāhmaṇa, / Viṣṇu then vanished, and the king awakened.

3.2.s:
vismitaḥ sahasotthāya dadhyau brahma sanātanam ..
sabhāyāṃ maṃtriṇe rājā svapnahetuṃ nyavedayat .. 21 ..
3.2.d:
विस्मितः सहसोत्थाय दध्यौ ब्रह्म सनातनम् ॥
सभायां मंत्रिणे राजा स्वप्नहेतुं न्यवेदयत् ॥ 21 ॥
3.2.m: Astonished, rising up quickly, he meditated on eternal Brahman. / In the assembly, the king reported the cause of the dream to his minister.

3.2.s:
mahāmantrī ca bhūpālaṃ prāha satyena bho dvija ..
mayāpi darśitaṃ svapnaṃ vṛddhavipreṇa bodhitam ..
atastau hi samānīya saṃpṛccha vidhivannṛpa .. 22 ..
3.2.d:
महामन्त्री च भूपालं प्राह सत्येन भो द्विज ॥
मयापि दर्शितं स्वप्नं वृद्धविप्रेण बोधितम् ॥
अतस्तौ हि समानीय संपृच्छ विधिवन्नृप ॥ 22 ॥
3.2.m: And the prime minister said to the king: “In truth, O twice-born, / I too was shown a dream, awakened by an old brāhmaṇa. / Therefore, having summoned the two, question them properly, O king!”

3.2.s:
ānīya sādhuṃ papraccha satyamālaṃbya bhūpatiḥ ..
kutratyau vāṃ kulaṃ kiṃ vā vasatiḥ kasya vā pure .. 23 ..
3.2.d:
आनीय साधुं पप्रच्छ सत्यमालंब्य भूपतिः ॥
कुत्रत्यौ वां कुलं किं वा वसतिः कस्य वा पुरे ॥ 23 ॥
3.2.m: Having summoned the merchant, the king, relying on truth, asked: / “From where are you two? What is your family? Or in whose city is your dwelling?”

3.2.s:
.. sādhuruvāca .. ..
ramye ratnapure vāso vaṇigjātau janirmama ..
vāṇijyārthaṃ mahārāja vāṇijyaṃ jīvikāvayoḥ .. 24 ..
3.2.d:
॥ साधुरुवाच ॥ ॥
रम्ये रत्नपुरे वासो वणिग्जातौ जनिर्मम ॥
वाणिज्यार्थं महाराज वाणिज्यं जीविकावयोः ॥ 24 ॥
3.2.m: The merchant said: / “Our dwelling is in delightful Ratnapura; my birth is in the merchant caste. / For the sake of commerce, O great king—trade is the livelihood of us both—

3.2.s:
maṇimuktādi vikretuṃ kretuṃ vā tava pattane ..
prāptau dūtaiśca baddhvāvāṃ tvatsamīpamupāgatau .. 25 ..
3.2.d:
मणिमुक्तादि विक्रेतुं क्रेतुं वा तव पत्तने ॥
प्राप्तौ दूतैश्च बद्ध्वावां त्वत्समीपमुपागतौ ॥ 25 ॥
3.2.m: we arrived in your city to sell or buy gems, pearls, and the like; / and being bound by your messengers, we were brought into your presence.

3.2.s:
pratikūle vidhau ko vā daśāṃ nāpnoti vai pumān ..
vināparādhaṃ rājendra maṇicaurānavādayan .. 26 ..
3.2.d:
प्रतिकूले विधौ को वा दशां नाप्नोति वै पुमान् ॥
विनापराधं राजेन्द्र मणिचौरानवादयन् ॥ 26 ॥
3.2.m: When fate is adverse, what man indeed does not come to [such a] state? / Without any offence, O best of kings, they called us gem-thieves.

3.2.s:
āvāṃ na cauro rājeṃdra tattvatastvaṃ vicāraya ..
śrutvā tanniścayaṃ jñātvā tayorbaṃdhanakāraṇam .. 27 ..
3.2.d:
आवां न चौरो राजेंद्र तत्त्वतस्त्वं विचारय ॥
श्रुत्वा तन्निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा तयोर्बंधनकारणम् ॥ 27 ॥
3.2.m: We two are not thieves, O best of kings; examine this in truth!” / Having heard and ascertained the cause of their imprisonment,

3.2.s:
chedayitvā dṛḍhaṃ pāśaṃ lomaśātimakārayat ..
kārayitvā pariṣkāraṃ bhojayāmāsa tau nṛpaḥ .. 28 ..
3.2.d:
छेदयित्वा दृढं पाशं लोमशातिमकारयत् ॥
कारयित्वा परिष्कारं भोजयामास तौ नृपः ॥ 28 ॥
3.2.m: having the tight fetters severed, he had their hair shaved off; / and having made them cleanse themselves, the king fed them.

3.2.s:
nagare pūjayāmāsa vastrābhūṣaṇavāhanaiḥ ..
abravītpūjitaḥ sādhurbhūpatiṃ vinayānvitaḥ .. 29 ..
3.2.d:
नगरे पूजयामास वस्त्राभूषणवाहनैः ॥
अब्रवीत्पूजितः साधुर्भूपतिं विनयान्वितः ॥ 29 ॥
3.2.m: In the city, he honoured them with garments, ornaments, and mounts. / Honoured, the merchant, full of modesty, said to the king:

3.2.s:
kārāgāre bahuvidhaṃ prāptaṃ duḥkhamataḥ param ..
ājñāpaya mahārāja deśaṃ gaṃtuṃ kṛpānidhe .. 3.2.29.30 ..
3.2.d:
कारागारे बहुविधं प्राप्तं दुःखमतः परम् ॥
आज्ञापय महाराज देशं गंतुं कृपानिधे ॥ 3.2.29.30 ॥
3.2.m: “Much sorrow was suffered in the prison up to this point. / Grant us leave, O great king, O ocean of compassion, to go to our own country.”

3.2.s:
śrutvā sādhuvaco rājā prāha kośādhikāriṇam ..
mudrābhistaraṇīḥ sadyaḥ pūrayāśu madājñayā .. 31 ..
3.2.d:
श्रुत्वा साधुवचो राजा प्राह कोशाधिकारिणम् ॥
मुद्राभिस्तरणीः सद्यः पूरयाशु मदाज्ञया ॥ 31 ॥
3.2.m: Hearing the merchant’s words, the king said to the treasurer: / “Quickly fill their boats with coins at once, by my command!”

3.2.s:
jāmātrā sahitaḥ sādhurgītavāditramaṃgalaiḥ ..
svadeśaṃ calito'dyāpi na cakre harisevanam.. 32 ..
3.2.d:
जामात्रा सहितः साधुर्गीतवादित्रमंगलैः ॥
स्वदेशं चलितोऽद्यापि न चक्रे हरिसेवनम्॥ 32 ॥
3.2.m: Together with his son-in-law, the merchant departed for his own country / with auspicious songs and musical instruments; yet even now he did not worship Hari.

3.2.s:
satyanārāyaṇo devaḥ pratyakṣaphaladaḥ kalau ..
sa eva tāpaso bhūtvā cakre sādhuviḍaṃbanam .. 33 ..
3.2.d:
सत्यनारायणो देवः प्रत्यक्षफलदः कलौ ॥
स एव तापसो भूत्वा चक्रे साधुविडंबनम् ॥ 33 ॥
3.2.m: Lord Satyanārāyaṇa grants visible fruits in the Kali age. / He himself, having assumed the form of an ascetic, deceived the merchant.

3.2.s:
.. tāpasa uvāca .. ..
dharmaḥ kiṃ nauṣu te sādho māmanādṛtya yāsi bhoḥ ..
pratyuttaramadātsādhuḥ kṣipa naukāśca satvaram .. 34 ..
3.2.d:
॥ तापस उवाच ॥ ॥
धर्मः किं नौषु ते साधो मामनादृत्य यासि भोः ॥
प्रत्युत्तरमदात्साधुः क्षिप नौकाश्च सत्वरम् ॥ 34 ॥
3.2.m: The ascetic said: / “What cargo is in your boats, O merchant? You pass by disregarding me!” / The merchant replied: “Hasten the boats quickly!

3.2.s:
bhoḥ svāminme dhanaṃ nāsti latāpatrādipūritam ..
naubhirgacchāmi svasthānaṃ virodhe nātra kiṃ phalam .. 35 ..
3.2.d:
भोः स्वामिन्मे धनं नास्ति लतापत्रादिपूरितम् ॥
नौभिर्गच्छामि स्वस्थानं विरोधे नात्र किं फलम् ॥ 35 ॥
3.2.m: O master, there is no wealth belonging to me; [the boat] is filled with vines, leaves, and the like. / I am going to my own place by boat; what profit is there in conflict here?”

3.2.s:
ityuktastāpasaḥ prāha tathāstviti vacaḥ kṣaṇāt ..
dhanamaṃtardadhe sādhorlatāpatrāvaśeṣitam .. 36 ..
3.2.d:
इत्युक्तस्तापसः प्राह तथास्त्विति वचः क्षणात् ॥
धनमंतर्दधे साधोर्लतापत्रावशेषितम् ॥ 36 ॥
3.2.m: Being addressed thus, the ascetic said the words: “So be it!” In an instant, / the merchant’s wealth disappeared, leaving only vines and leaves.

3.2.s:
dhanaṃ naukāsu nāstīti sādhuściṃtāturo'bhavat ..
kimidaṃ kasya vā hetordhanaṃ kutra gataṃ mama .. 37 ..
3.2.d:
धनं नौकासु नास्तीति साधुश्चिंतातुरोऽभवत् ॥
किमिदं कस्य वा हेतोर्धनं कुत्र गतं मम ॥ 37 ॥
3.2.m: Seeing that there was no wealth in the boats, the merchant became distressed with worry: / “What is this? For what cause? Where has my wealth gone?”

3.2.s:
vajrapātāhata iva bhṛśaṃ duḥkhitamānasaḥ ..
kva yāsyāmi kva tiṣṭhāmi kiṃ karomi dhanaṃ kutaḥ .. 38 ..
3.2.d:
वज्रपाताहत इव भृशं दुःखितमानसः ॥
क्व यास्यामि क्व तिष्ठामि किं करोमि धनं कुतः ॥ 38 ॥
3.2.m: As if struck by a bolt of lightning, his mind severely grieved: / “Where shall I go? Where shall I stay? What shall I do? Whence will wealth come?”

3.2.s:
iti mūrchāgataḥ sādhurvilalāpa punaḥpunaḥ ..
jāmātrā bodhitaḥ paścāttāpasaṃ taṃ jagāma ha .. 39 ..
3.2.d:
इति मूर्छागतः साधुर्विललाप पुनःपुनः ॥
जामात्रा बोधितः पश्चात्तापसं तं जगाम ह ॥ 39 ॥
3.2.m: Having thus fallen into a swoon, the merchant lamented again and again. / Afterward, consoled by his son-in-law, he went to that ascetic.

3.2.s:
gale vasanamādāya praṇanāma sa tāpasam ..
ko bhavāniti papraccha devo gaṃdharva īśvaraḥ..3.2.29.40..
3.2.d:
गले वसनमादाय प्रणनाम स तापसम् ॥
को भवानिति पप्रच्छ देवो गंधर्व ईश्वरः॥3.2.29.40॥
3.2.m: Placing his upper garment around his neck, he bowed to the ascetic / and asked: “Who are you? A god, a gandharva, or the supreme Lord?

3.2.s:
devadevo'thavā ko'pi na jāne tava vikramam ..
ājñāpaya mahābhāga tadviḍambanakāraṇam .. 41 ..
3.2.d:
देवदेवोऽथवा कोऽपि न जाने तव विक्रमम् ॥
आज्ञापय महाभाग तद्विडम्बनकारणम् ॥ 41 ॥
3.2.m: Or some god of gods? I do not know your prowess. / Command, O blessed one, what is the cause of this mockery?”

3.2.s:
.. tāpasa uvāca .. ..
ātmā caivātmanaḥ śatrustathātra ca priyo'priyaḥ ..
tyaja mauḍhyamati sādho pravādaṃ mā vṛthā kṛthāḥ ..42..
3.2.d:
॥ तापस उवाच ॥ ॥
आत्मा चैवात्मनः शत्रुस्तथात्र च प्रियोऽप्रियः ॥
त्यज मौढ्यमति साधो प्रवादं मा वृथा कृथाः ॥42॥
3.2.m: The ascetic said: / “One’s self is indeed one’s own enemy, and here one's self is dear or not dear. / Abandon your foolish mind, O merchant! Do not utter false words in vain!”

3.2.s:
iti vijñāpitaḥ sādhurna bubodha mahādhanaḥ ..
punaḥ sa tāpasaḥ prāha kṛpayā pūrvakarmataḥ..43..
3.2.d:
इति विज्ञापितः साधुर्न बुबोध महाधनः ॥
पुनः स तापसः प्राह कृपया पूर्वकर्मतः॥43॥
3.2.m: Though spoken to thus, the merchant of great wealth did not understand. / Again that ascetic said, out of compassion, concerning his past actions:

3.2.s:
caṃdracūḍo yadānarca satyanārāyaṇaṃ nṛpaḥ ..
anapatyena suciraṃ putrakanyārthinā tvayā .. 44 ..
3.2.d:
चंद्रचूडो यदानर्च सत्यनारायणं नृपः ॥
अनपत्येन सुचिरं पुत्रकन्यार्थिना त्वया ॥ 44 ॥
3.2.m: “When King Candracūḍa worshipped Satyanārāyaṇa, / you, being childless for a long time, desiring a son or a daughter,

3.2.s:
prārthitaṃ na smṛtaṃ hyeva idānīṃ tapyase vṛthā ..
satyanārāyaṇo devo viśvavyāpī phalapradaḥ ..45..
3.2.d:
प्रार्थितं न स्मृतं ह्येव इदानीं तप्यसे वृथा ॥
सत्यनारायणो देवो विश्वव्यापी फलप्रदः ॥45॥
3.2.m: made a prayer, but did not remember it at all; now you grieve in vain! / Lord Satyanārāyaṇa is all-pervading and the giver of fruits.

3.2.s:
tamanādṛtya durbuddhe kutaḥ samyagbhavettava ..
purālabdhavaraṃ smṛtvā sasmāra jagadīśvaram .. 46 ..
3.2.d:
तमनादृत्य दुर्बुद्धे कुतः सम्यग्भवेत्तव ॥
पुरालब्धवरं स्मृत्वा सस्मार जगदीश्वरम् ॥ 46 ॥
3.2.m: Disregarding him, O fool, whence could good come to you?” / Remembering the boon obtained formerly, he remembered the Lord of the universe.

3.2.s:
satyanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ tāpasaṃ taṃ dadarśa ha ..
praṇamya bhuvi kāyena parikramya punaḥpunaḥ ..
tuṣṭāva tāpasaṃ tatra sādhurgadgadayā girā .. 47 ..
3.2.d:
सत्यनारायणं देवं तापसं तं ददर्श ह ॥
प्रणम्य भुवि कायेन परिक्रम्य पुनःपुनः ॥
तुष्टाव तापसं तत्र साधुर्गद्गदया गिरा ॥ 47 ॥
3.2.m: He saw that ascetic to be the god Satyanārāyaṇa. / Bowing on the earth with his body and circumambulating again and again, / the merchant there praised the ascetic in a choked voice.

3.2.s:
.. sādhuruvāca .. ..
satyarūpaṃ satyasaṃdhaṃ satyanārāyaṇaṃ harim ..
yatsatyatvena jagatastaṃ satyaṃ tvāṃ namāmyaham .. 48 ..
3.2.d:
॥ साधुरुवाच ॥ ॥
सत्यरूपं सत्यसंधं सत्यनारायणं हरिम् ॥
यत्सत्यत्वेन जगतस्तं सत्यं त्वां नमाम्यहम् ॥ 48 ॥
3.2.m: The merchant said: / “O Hari Satyanārāyaṇa, whose form is truth, who are true to your promise, / by whose reality the world exists—I bow to you, who are Truth!

3.2.s:
tvanmāyāmohitātmāno na paśyaṃtyātmanaḥ śubham ..
duḥkhāṃbhodhau sadā magnā duḥkhe ca sukhamāninaḥ .. 49 ..
3.2.d:
त्वन्मायामोहितात्मानो न पश्यंत्यात्मनः शुभम् ॥
दुःखांभोधौ सदा मग्ना दुःखे च सुखमानिनः ॥ 49 ॥
3.2.m: Those whose minds are deluded by your Māyā do not see their own welfare; / they are perpetually sunk in an ocean of sorrow, yet consider sorrow to be happiness.

3.2.s:
mūḍhohaṃ dhanagarveṇa madāṃdhīkṛtalocanaḥ ..
na jāne svātmanaḥ kṣemaṃ kathaṃ paśyāmi mūḍhadhīḥ .. 3.2.29.50 ..
3.2.d:
मूढोहं धनगर्वेण मदांधीकृतलोचनः ॥
न जाने स्वात्मनः क्षेमं कथं पश्यामि मूढधीः ॥ 3.2.29.50 ॥
3.2.m: I am a fool, with eyes blinded by pride, arrogant from wealth. / I do not know my own welfare; how could I, foolish in mind, see it?

3.2.s:
kṣamasva mama daurātmyaṃ tapo dhāmne hare namaḥ..
ājñāpayātmadāsyaṃ me yena te caraṇau smare .. 51 ..
3.2.d:
क्षमस्व मम दौरात्म्यं तपो धाम्ने हरे नमः॥
आज्ञापयात्मदास्यं मे येन ते चरणौ स्मरे ॥ 51 ॥
3.2.m: Pardon my wickedness! Homage to Hari, the abode of austerities! / Ordain for me servitude to you, so that I may remember your feet!”

3.2.s:
iti stutvā lakṣamudrāḥ sthāpitāḥ svapurodhasi ..
gatvāvāsaṃ pūjayiṣye satyanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ..52..
3.2.d:
इति स्तुत्वा लक्षमुद्राः स्थापिताः स्वपुरोधसि ॥
गत्वावासं पूजयिष्ये सत्यनारायणं प्रभुम् ॥52॥
3.2.m: Having praised him thus, he placed a hundred thousand coins before himself: / “Having gone to my dwelling, I will worship Lord Satyanārāyaṇa.”

3.2.s:
tuṣṭo nārāyaṇaḥ prāha vāṃchā pūrṇā bhavettu te ..
putrapautrasamāyukto bhuktvā bhogāṃstvanuttamān ..
aṃte sāṃnidhyamāsādya modase tvaṃ mayā saha ..53..
3.2.d:
तुष्टो नारायणः प्राह वांछा पूर्णा भवेत्तु ते ॥
पुत्रपौत्रसमायुक्तो भुक्त्वा भोगांस्त्वनुत्तमान् ॥
अंते सांनिध्यमासाद्य मोदसे त्वं मया सह ॥53॥
3.2.m: Pleased, Nārāyaṇa said: “May your wish be fulfilled! / Endowed with sons and grandsons, having enjoyed unsurpassed pleasures, / attaining my presence at the end, you shall rejoice with me.”

3.2.s:
ityuktvāntardadhe viṣṇuḥ sādhuśca svāśramaṃ yayau ..
saptāhena gṛhaṃ prāptaḥ satyadevena rakṣitaḥ .. 54 ..
3.2.d:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे विष्णुः साधुश्च स्वाश्रमं ययौ ॥
सप्ताहेन गृहं प्राप्तः सत्यदेवेन रक्षितः ॥ 54 ॥
3.2.m: Having said this, Viṣṇu vanished, and the merchant went to his own vessel. / Protected by Lord Satya, he reached home in seven days.

3.2.s:
āgatya nagarābhyāśe prāhi ṇoddrutamāśramam ..
gṛhamāgatya dūtopi prāha līlāvatīṃ prati .. 55 ..
3.2.d:
आगत्य नगराभ्याशे प्राहि णोद्द्रुतमाश्रमम् ॥
गृहमागत्य दूतोपि प्राह लीलावतीं प्रति ॥ 55 ॥
3.2.m: Having arrived near the city, he quickly sent [a messenger] to his abode. / Arriving at the house, the messenger said to Līlāvatī:

3.2.s:
jāmātrā sahitaḥ sādhuḥ kṛtakṛtyaḥ samāgataḥ ..
satyanārāyaṇārcāyāṃ sthitā sādhvī sakanyakā .. 56 ..
3.2.d:
जामात्रा सहितः साधुः कृतकृत्यः समागतः ॥
सत्यनारायणार्चायां स्थिता साध्वी सकन्यका ॥ 56 ॥
3.2.m: “Accompanied by his son-in-law, the merchant has arrived, having accomplished his purpose.” / The virtuous woman remained with her daughter engaged in the worship of Satyanārāyaṇa.

3.2.s:
pūjābhāraṃ sutāyai sā dattvā naukāṃtikaṃ yayau ..
sakhīgaṇaiḥ parivṛtā kṛtakautukamaṃgalā .. 57 ..
3.2.d:
पूजाभारं सुतायै सा दत्त्वा नौकांतिकं ययौ ॥
सखीगणैः परिवृता कृतकौतुकमंगला ॥ 57 ॥
3.2.m: Having entrusted the burden of the worship to her daughter, she went to the boat, / surrounded by hosts of friends, having performed joyful and auspicious rites.

3.2.s:
kalāvatī tvavajñāya prasādaṃ satvarā yayau ..
pātuṃ patimukhāṃbhojaṃ cakorīva dinātyaye .. 58 ..
3.2.d:
कलावती त्ववज्ञाय प्रसादं सत्वरा ययौ ॥
पातुं पतिमुखांभोजं चकोरीव दिनात्यये ॥ 58 ॥
3.2.m: Kalāvatī, however, neglecting the prasāda, went quickly / to drink the lotus-face of her husband, like a cakorī bird at the end of day.

3.2.s:
avajñānātprasādasya naukāśaṃkhapateratha ..
nimagnā jalamadhye tu jāmātrā saha tatkṣaṇāt .. 59 ..
3.2.d:
अवज्ञानात्प्रसादस्य नौकाशंखपतेरथ ॥
निमग्ना जलमध्ये तु जामात्रा सह तत्क्षणात् ॥ 59 ॥
3.2.m:
Because of the slighting of the prasāda, the boat of the lord of conches
then sank in the midst of the water at that very moment along with the son-in-law.

3.2.s:
magnaṃ jāmātaraṃ paśyanvilalāpa sa mūrcchitaḥ ..
līlāvatī tu taddṛṣṭvā mūrcchitā vilalāpa ha .. 3.2.29.60 ..
3.2.d:
मग्नं जामातरं पश्यन्विललाप स मूर्च्छितः ॥
लीलावती तु तद्दृष्ट्वा मूर्च्छिता विललाप ह ॥ 3.2.29.60 ॥
3.2.m:
Seeing his son-in-law sink, he fell into a faint and lamented;
and Līlāvatī, seeing that, fainted away and lamented.

3.2.s:
tataḥ kalāvatī dṛṣṭvā papāta bhuvi mūrcchitā ..
raṃbheva vātavihatā kāntakāntetivādinī .. 61 ..
3.2.d:
ततः कलावती दृष्ट्वा पपात भुवि मूर्च्छिता ॥
रंभेव वातविहता कान्तकान्तेतिवादिनी ॥ 61 ॥
3.2.m:
Then Kalāvatī, having seen [this], fell to the earth in a faint,
like a plantain tree struck down by the wind, crying: “O beloved, O beloved!”

3.2.s:
hā nātha priya dharmajña karuṇākarakauśala ..
tvayā virahitā patyā nirāśā vidhinā kṛtā ..
patyurarddhaṃ gataṃ kasmādarddhāṃgaṃ jīvanaṃ katham.. 62 ..
3.2.d:
हा नाथ प्रिय धर्मज्ञ करुणाकरकौशल ॥
त्वया विरहिता पत्या निराशा विधिना कृता ॥
पत्युरर्द्धं गतं कस्मादर्द्धांगं जीवनं कथम्॥ 62 ॥
3.2.m:
“Ah, lord, beloved, knower of righteousness, mine of compassion and skill!
Separated from you, my husband, I am reduced to despair by fate.
Half of my husband is gone; how can the [other] half of the body go on living?”

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kalāvatī cārukalāsu kauśalā pravālaraktāṃghritalātikomalā ..
sarojanetrāṃbukaṇānvimuṃcatī muktāvalībhistanakuḍmalāṃcitā .. 63 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
कलावती चारुकलासु कौशला प्रवालरक्तांघ्रितलातिकोमला ॥
सरोजनेत्रांबुकणान्विमुंचती मुक्तावलीभिस्तनकुड्मलांचिता ॥ 63 ॥
3.2.m:
Sūta said:
Kalāvatī, skilled in the fine arts, whose soles were as soft and red as coral,
shed drops of water from her lotus eyes, adorned with pearl necklaces resting upon her budding breasts:

3.2.s:
hā satyanārāyaṇa satyasiṃdho magnaṃ hi māmu ddhara tadviyoge ..
śrutvārtaśabdaṃ bhagavānuvāca vacastadākāśasamudbhavaṃ ca .. 64 ..
3.2.d:
हा सत्यनारायण सत्यसिंधो मग्नं हि मामु द्धर तद्वियोगे ॥
श्रुत्वार्तशब्दं भगवानुवाच वचस्तदाकाशसमुद्भवं च ॥ 64 ॥
3.2.m:
“Ah, Satyanārāyaṇa, ocean of truth, save me, sunken here in separation from him!”
Hearing her cry of distress, the Blessed Lord spoke words that arose then from the sky:

3.2.s:
sādho kalāvatī kṣipraṃ matprasādaṃ hi bhojayet ..
tatpaścādiha saṃprāpya patiṃ prāpsyati mā śucaḥ .. 65 ..
3.2.d:
साधो कलावती क्षिप्रं मत्प्रसादं हि भोजयेत् ॥
तत्पश्चादिह संप्राप्य पतिं प्राप्स्यति मा शुचः ॥ 65 ॥
3.2.m:
“O good merchant, let Kalāvatī quickly eat my prasāda;
after that, arriving here, she will find her husband; do not grieve!”

3.2.s:
ityākāśe vacaḥ śrutvā vismitā taccakāra sā ..
nārāyaṇasya kṛpayā patiṃ prāptā kalāvatī .. 66 ..
3.2.d:
इत्याकाशे वचः श्रुत्वा विस्मिता तच्चकार सा ॥
नारायणस्य कृपया पतिं प्राप्ता कलावती ॥ 66 ॥
3.2.m:
Hearing this voice in the sky, she was astonished and did so;
and by the grace of Nārāyaṇa, Kalāvatī regained her husband.

3.2.s:
tatraiva sādhuḥ sāhlādo bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ ..
pūjanaṃ lakṣamudrābhiḥ satyadevasya cākarot .. 67 ..
3.2.d:
तत्रैव साधुः साह्लादो भक्त्या परमया युतः ॥
पूजनं लक्षमुद्राभिः सत्यदेवस्य चाकरोत् ॥ 67 ॥
3.2.m:
Right there the merchant, joyful and filled with supreme devotion,
performed the worship of the true deity with a hundred thousand coins.

3.2.s:
tena vrataprabhāvena putrapautrasamanvitaḥ ..
bhuktvā bhogānmudā yukto mṛtaḥ svargapuraṃ yayau .. 68 ..
3.2.d:
तेन व्रतप्रभावेन पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः ॥
भुक्त्वा भोगान्मुदा युक्तो मृतः स्वर्गपुरं ययौ ॥ 68 ॥
3.2.m:
By the power of that votive observance, endowed with sons and grandsons,
having enjoyed delights filled with joy, when he died he went to the heavenly city.

3.2.s:
itihāsamimaṃ bhaktyā śṛṇuyādyo hi mānavaḥ ..
so'pi viṣṇupriyataraḥ kāmasiddhimavāpnuyāt .. .. 69 ..
3.2.d:
इतिहासमिमं भक्त्या शृणुयाद्यो हि मानवः ॥
सोऽपि विष्णुप्रियतरः कामसिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् ॥ ॥ 69 ॥
3.2.m:
Whatever mortal listens to this sacred history with devotion,
he too becomes most dear to Viṣṇu and attains the fulfillment of his desires.

3.2.s:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra vratānāmuttamaṃ vrata..
kalikāle paraṃ puṇyaṃ brāhmaṇasya mukhodbhavam .. 3.2.29.70 ..
3.2.d:
इति ते कथितं विप्र व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रत॥
कलिकाले परं पुण्यं ब्राह्मणस्य मुखोद्भवम् ॥ 3.2.29.70 ॥
3.2.m:
Thus has been told to you, O brāhmaṇa, the highest votive observance among votive observances,
supremely meritorious in the Kali age, arisen from the mouth of a brāhmaṇa.

3.2.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ.. ..
bhagavanguhyajaṃ karma vṛttaṃ proktaṃ purātanaiḥ ..
vratānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nārāyaṇavratam .. 1 ..
3.2.d:
॥ ऋषय ऊचुः॥ ॥
भगवन्गुह्यजं कर्म वृत्तं प्रोक्तं पुरातनैः ॥
व्रतानां चैव सर्वेषां श्रेष्ठं नारायणव्रतम् ॥ 1 ॥

3.2.s:
tvanmukhena śrutaṃ sūta tāpatrayavināśanam ..
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi liṃgajaṃ karma cottamam .. 2 ..
3.2.d:
त्वन्मुखेन श्रुतं सूत तापत्रयविनाशनम् ॥
इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामि लिंगजं कर्म चोत्तमम् ॥ 2 ॥
3.2.m:
Through your mouth, O Sūta, has been heard that which destroys the three kinds of suffering;
now I wish to hear the excellent rite born of gender.

3.2.s:
sarveṣāṃ brahmacaryāṇāṃ brahmacarye hi kiṃ param ..
tanme vada mahāprājña sarvaṃjño'si matau mama .. 3 ..
3.2.d:
सर्वेषां ब्रह्मचर्याणां ब्रह्मचर्ये हि किं परम् ॥
तन्मे वद महाप्राज्ञ सर्वंज्ञोऽसि मतौ मम ॥ 3 ॥
3.2.m:
Among all forms of celibacy, what indeed is the supreme celibacy?
Tell me that, O greatly wise one; in my opinion you are omniscient.

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
āsītpurā kaliyuge pitṛśarmā dvijottamaḥ ..
vedavedāṃgatattvajño yamalokabhayānvitaḥ .. 4 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
आसीत्पुरा कलियुगे पितृशर्मा द्विजोत्तमः ॥
वेदवेदांगतत्त्वज्ञो यमलोकभयान्वितः ॥ 4 ॥
3.2.m:
Sūta said:
Formerly, in the Kali age, there was an excellent twice-born named Pitṛśarman,
who knew the truth of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, yet was filled with fear of the realm of Yama.

3.2.s:
jñātvā ghoratamaṃ kālaṃ kali kālamadharmajam..
vārdhanaṃ yamarāṣṭrasya tadā ciṃtāturo'bhavat .. 5 ..
3.2.d:
ज्ञात्वा घोरतमं कालं कलि कालमधर्मजम्॥
वार्धनं यमराष्ट्रस्य तदा चिंतातुरोऽभवत् ॥ 5 ॥
3.2.m:
Knowing the Kali age to be the most dreadful time, born of unrighteousness,
which augments the kingdom of Yama, he then became overwhelmed with anxiety:

3.2.s:
kenāśrameṇa varṇena mama śreyo bhavediha ..
kalau saṃnyāsamārgo hi daṃbhapākhaṃḍakhaṃḍitaḥ .. 6 ..
3.2.d:
केनाश्रमेण वर्णेन मम श्रेयो भवेदिह ॥
कलौ संन्यासमार्गो हि दंभपाखंडखंडितः ॥ 6 ॥
3.2.m:
“By which stage of life or caste would my highest good come to be here?
For in the Kali age the path of renunciation is shattered by deceit and hypocrisy.

3.2.s:
vānaprasthaḥ kalau nāsti brahmacaryaṃ kvacitkvacit ..
gārhasthyaṃ karma sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ śreṣṭhamucyate .. 7 ..
3.2.d:
वानप्रस्थः कलौ नास्ति ब्रह्मचर्यं क्वचित्क्वचित् ॥
गार्हस्थ्यं कर्म सर्वेषां कर्मणां श्रेष्ठमुच्यते ॥ 7 ॥
3.2.m:
The forest-dweller does not exist in the Kali age; celibacy is found only here and there;
the stage of the householder is said to be the best of all works.

3.2.s:
ataḥ strī saṃgrāhyo mayā ghore kalau yuge ..
yadi me ca bhavennārī manovṛttyanusāriṇī ..
tarhi me saphalaṃ janma mama śreyo bhavediha .. 8 ..
3.2.d:
अतः स्त्री संग्राह्यो मया घोरे कलौ युगे ॥
यदि मे च भवेन्नारी मनोवृत्त्यनुसारिणी ॥
तर्हि मे सफलं जन्म मम श्रेयो भवेदिह ॥ 8 ॥

3.2.s:
ityevaṃ saṃmataṃ kṛtvā śivāṃ maṃgaladāyinīm ..
caṃdanādyaiśca saṃpūjya tuṣṭāva manasā parām ..
viśveśvarīṃ jaganmūrtiṃ saccidānaṃdarūpiṇīm .. 9 .. ..
3.2.d:
इत्येवं संमतं कृत्वा शिवां मंगलदायिनीम् ॥
चंदनाद्यैश्च संपूज्य तुष्टाव मनसा पराम् ॥
विश्वेश्वरीं जगन्मूर्तिं सच्चिदानंदरूपिणीम् ॥ 9 ॥ ॥
3.2.m:
Having thus resolved, having worshipped Śivā, the giver of auspiciousness, with sandalwood and other offerings,
he praised with his mind the supreme ruler of the universe, the embodiment of the world, whose nature is being, consciousness, and bliss.

3.2.s:
.. pitṛśarmovāca ..
namaḥ prakṛtyai sarvāyai kaivalyāyai namonamaḥ ..
triguṇaikyasvarūpāyai turīyāyai namonamaḥ .. 3.2.30.10 ..
3.2.d:
॥ पितृशर्मोवाच ॥
नमः प्रकृत्यै सर्वायै कैवल्यायै नमोनमः ॥
त्रिगुणैक्यस्वरूपायै तुरीयायै नमोनमः ॥ 3.2.30.10 ॥
3.2.m:
Pitṛśarman said:
Homage to Prakṛti, who is all! Homage, homage to the state of absolute liberation!
Homage, homage to her whose nature is the unity of the three guṇas, to the Fourth State!

3.2.s:
mahattattvajananyai ca dvaṃdvakartryai namonamaḥ ..
brahmamātarnamastubhyaṃ sāhaṃkārapitāmahi .. 11 ..
3.2.d:
महत्तत्त्वजनन्यै च द्वंद्वकर्त्र्यै नमोनमः ॥
ब्रह्ममातर्नमस्तुभ्यं साहंकारपितामहि ॥ 11 ॥
3.2.m:
Homage, homage to the mother of the cosmic intellect, to the creator of duality!
Homage to you, mother of Brahmā, grandmother endowed with egoity!

3.2.s:
pṛthagguṇāyai śuddhāyai namo mātarnamonamaḥ ..
vidyāyai śuddhasattvāyai lakṣmyai sattvarajomayi ..12..
3.2.d:
पृथग्गुणायै शुद्धायै नमो मातर्नमोनमः ॥
विद्यायै शुद्धसत्त्वायै लक्ष्म्यै सत्त्वरजोमयि ॥12॥
3.2.m:
Homage, homage, O Mother, to the pure one who has separate guṇas!
To knowledge, pure sattva; to Lakṣmī, composed of sattva and rajas!

3.2.s:
namo mātaravidyāyai tataḥ śuddhyai namonamaḥ..
kālyai sattvatamobhūtyai namo mātarnarmonamaḥ ..13..
3.2.d:
नमो मातरविद्यायै ततः शुद्ध्यै नमोनमः॥
काल्यै सत्त्वतमोभूत्यै नमो मातर्नर्मोनमः ॥13॥
3.2.m:
Homage to the Mother who is ignorance, and homage, homage to her beyond purity!
To Kālī, the manifestation of sattva and tamas, homage, homage, O Mother!

3.2.s:
striyai śuddharajomūrtyai namastrailokyavāsini ..
namorajastamomūrtyai durgāyai ca namonamaḥ .. 14 ..
3.2.d:
स्त्रियै शुद्धरजोमूर्त्यै नमस्त्रैलोक्यवासिनि ॥
नमोरजस्तमोमूर्त्यै दुर्गायै च नमोनमः ॥ 14 ॥
3.2.m:
To woman, the pure form of rajas, homage to you, dweller in the three worlds!
Homage, homage to Durgā, the form of rajas and tamas!

3.2.s:
iti śrutvā stavaṃ devyā prasādaḥ sthāpitastayā ..
sutāyāṃ viṣṇuyaśaso brāhmaṇasya tadā svayam .. 15 ..
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स्तवं देव्या प्रसादः स्थापितस्तया ॥
सुतायां विष्णुयशसो ब्राह्मणस्य तदा स्वयम् ॥ 15 ॥
3.2.m:
Hearing this hymn of praise, grace was established by the goddess herself
in the daughter of the brāhmaṇa Viṣṇuyaśas at that time.

3.2.s:
tāmudvāhya dvijo devīṃ nāmnā vai brahmacāriṇīm ..
nyavasanmathurāyāṃ sa kṛtvā dharmaṃ svayaṃ hṛdi .. 16 ..
3.2.d:
तामुद्वाह्य द्विजो देवीं नाम्ना वै ब्रह्मचारिणीम् ॥
न्यवसन्मथुरायां स कृत्वा धर्मं स्वयं हृदि ॥ 16 ॥
3.2.m:
Having married that goddess, indeed Brahmacāriṇī by name,
the twice-born dwelled in Mathurā, holding righteousness in his heart.

3.2.s:
priyāyai sa rajovatyai ṛtudānaṃ karoti hi ..
catvāraścātmajāścāsaṃścaturvedaikyadhāriṇaḥ .. 17 ..
3.2.d:
प्रियायै स रजोवत्यै ऋतुदानं करोति हि ॥
चत्वारश्चात्मजाश्चासंश्चतुर्वेदैक्यधारिणः ॥ 17 ॥
3.2.m:
He indeed performed the approach in season with his beloved during her fertile period;
and four sons were born, upholding the unity of the four Vedas:

3.2.s:
ṛgyajuśca tathā sāma turyaścāsī datharvaṇaḥ ..
ṛcaśca tanayo vyāḍirnyāyaśāstraviśāradaḥ .. 18 ..
3.2.d:
ऋग्यजुश्च तथा साम तुर्यश्चासी दथर्वणः ॥
ऋचश्च तनयो व्याडिर्न्यायशास्त्रविशारदः ॥ 18 ॥
3.2.m:
Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāman, and the fourth was Atharvaṇa;
and the son of Ṛc was Vyāḍi, expert in the Nyāya treatise.

3.2.s:
yajuṣastu suto jāto mīmāṃso lokaviśrutaḥ ..
pāṇiniḥ sāmanasyaiva suto'bhū cchabdapālaḥ .. 19 ..
3.2.d:
यजुषस्तु सुतो जातो मीमांसो लोकविश्रुतः ॥
पाणिनिः सामनस्यैव सुतोऽभू च्छब्दपालः ॥ 19 ॥
3.2.m:
The son born of Yajus was Mīmāṃsa, renowned in the world;
Pāṇini was indeed the son of Sāman, a protector of words.

3.2.s:
putro vararuciḥ śreṣṭho'tharvaṇasya nṛpapriyaḥ ..
te gatā māgadheśasya candraguptasya vai sabhām 3.2.30.20 ..
3.2.d:
पुत्रो वररुचिः श्रेष्ठोऽथर्वणस्य नृपप्रियः ॥
ते गता मागधेशस्य चन्द्रगुप्तस्य वै सभाम् 3.2.30.20 ॥
3.2.m:
The excellent son of Atharvaṇa was Vararuci, dear to kings;
they went indeed to the assembly of Candragupta, ruler of Magadha.

3.2.s:
nṛpastānpūjayāmāsa bahumānapuraḥsaram ..
abravīttāṃstato rājā brahmacaryaṃ hi kiṃ param .. 21 ..
3.2.d:
नृपस्तान्पूजयामास बहुमानपुरःसरम् ॥
अब्रवीत्तांस्ततो राजा ब्रह्मचर्यं हि किं परम् ॥ 21 ॥
3.2.m:
The king honored them preceded by great respect;
the king then said to them: “What indeed is the supreme celibacy?”

3.2.s:
vyāḍirāha mahārāja yaḥ stutau tatparaḥ pumān ..
nyāyato'khila devānāṃ brahmacārī hi me mataḥ .. 22 ..
3.2.d:
व्याडिराह महाराज यः स्तुतौ तत्परः पुमान् ॥
न्यायतोऽखिल देवानां ब्रह्मचारी हि मे मतः ॥ 22 ॥
3.2.m:
Vyāḍi said: “O great king, whatever man is devoted to praise
of all the gods according to Nyāya, he indeed is considered by me a celibate student.”

3.2.s:
mīmāṃsaścāha bho rājanyajñe yo hi pumānparaḥ ..
karmaṇā yajate devānrocanādibhirarcayet .. 23 ..
3.2.d:
मीमांसश्चाह भो राजन्यज्ञे यो हि पुमान्परः ॥
कर्मणा यजते देवान्रोचनादिभिरर्चयेत् ॥ 23 ॥
3.2.m:
And Mīmāṃsa said: “O king, whatever man is devoted to sacrifice,
worships the gods through rite, and honors them with yellow pigment and the like,

3.2.s:
havanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā brahmādikasurānprati ..
tatprasādaṃ hi gṛhṇīyādbrahmacārī ca sa smṛtaḥ .. 24 ..
3.2.d:
हवनं तर्पणं कृत्वा ब्रह्मादिकसुरान्प्रति ॥
तत्प्रसादं हि गृह्णीयाद्ब्रह्मचारी च स स्मृतः ॥ 24 ॥
3.2.m:
making oblations and libations to the gods headed by Brahmā,
and receives their prasāda—he is regarded as a celibate student.”

3.2.s:
śrutvedaṃ pāṇiniścāha candragupta śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ ..
tridhā svaraiḥ paraṃ brahma śuddhaśabdamayaiḥ paraiḥ .. 25 ..
3.2.d:
श्रुत्वेदं पाणिनिश्चाह चन्द्रगुप्त शृणुष्व भोः ॥
त्रिधा स्वरैः परं ब्रह्म शुद्धशब्दमयैः परैः ॥ 25 ॥
3.2.m:
Hearing this, Pāṇini said: “Listen, O Candragupta!
By means of the three accents, the supreme brahman consists of pure, supreme words;

3.2.s:
tathaiva sūtrapāṭhaiśca liṃgadhātugaṇāvṛtaiḥ ..
yo yajedbrahmacārī sa paraṃ brahmādhigacchati .. 26 ..
3.2.d:
तथैव सूत्रपाठैश्च लिंगधातुगणावृतैः ॥
यो यजेद्ब्रह्मचारी स परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति ॥ 26 ॥
3.2.m:
likewise, he who worships with the recitation of sūtras encompassed by genders, verbal roots, and classes of words—
he, a celibate student, attains the supreme brahman.”

3.2.s:
śrutvā vararuciścāha śṛṇu māgadhabhūpate ..
gṛhītvā yajñasūtraṃ yaḥ prāpto gurukule vasan .. 27 ..
3.2.d:
श्रुत्वा वररुचिश्चाह शृणु मागधभूपते ॥
गृहीत्वा यज्ञसूत्रं यः प्राप्तो गुरुकुले वसन् ॥ 27 ॥
3.2.m:
Having heard [this], Vararuci said: “Listen, O king of Magadha!
He who, having received the sacred thread, arrives and lives in the teacher's house,

3.2.s:
daṃḍalomanakhādhārī bhikṣārthī vedatatparaḥ ..
ājñayā ca gurorvartedbrahmacārī hi sa smṛtaḥ .. 28 ..
3.2.d:
दंडलोमनखाधारी भिक्षार्थी वेदतत्परः ॥
आज्ञया च गुरोर्वर्तेद्ब्रह्मचारी हि स स्मृतः ॥ 28 ॥
3.2.m:
bearing a staff, body-hair, and nails, seeking alms, devoted to the Veda,
and acts by the command of the teacher—he indeed is remembered as a celibate student.”

3.2.s:
iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā pitṛśarmābravīdidam ..
yo gṛhasthe vasanvipraḥ pitṛdevātithipriyaḥ .. 29 ..
3.2.d:
इति तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा पितृशर्माब्रवीदिदम् ॥
यो गृहस्थे वसन्विप्रः पितृदेवातिथिप्रियः ॥ 29 ॥
3.2.m: Hearing their words, Pitṛśarman spoke this: / "A brāhmaṇa who, dwelling as a householder, cherishes the ancestors, the gods, and guests,

3.2.s:
gāmī pāṇigṛhītāyāmṛtukāle yateṃdriyaḥ ..
brahmacārī hi mukhyassa śrutvā rājābravīdidam .. 3.2.30.30 ..
3.2.d:
गामी पाणिगृहीतायामृतुकाले यतेंद्रियः ॥
ब्रह्मचारी हि मुख्यस्स श्रुत्वा राजाब्रवीदिदम् ॥ 3.2.30.30 ॥
3.2.m: and goes only to his wedded wife at the proper season, with his senses restrained, / is indeed the foremost celibate." Hearing this, the king said:

3.2.s:
svāminyadbhavatā coktaṃ dharmajñena yaśasvinā ..
kalau bhayaṃkare prāpte sa dharmo hi mato mama ..31..
3.2.d:
स्वामिन्यद्भवता चोक्तं धर्मज्ञेन यशस्विना ॥
कलौ भयंकरे प्राप्ते स धर्मो हि मतो मम ॥31॥
3.2.m: "O lord, what you, the knower of dharma, renowned, have declared— / now that the terrifying Kali [age] has arrived, that indeed is my accepted dharma."

3.2.s:
ityuktvā tasya śiṣyo'bhūdguruvākyaparāyaṇaḥ ..
tathānte maraṇaṃ prāpya svargalokaṃ nṛpo yayau ..32..
3.2.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तस्य शिष्योऽभूद्गुरुवाक्यपरायणः ॥
तथान्ते मरणं प्राप्य स्वर्गलोकं नृपो ययौ ॥32॥
3.2.m: Having said this, he became his disciple, devoted to the words of his guru. / And so, meeting his death at the end, the king went to the world of heaven.

3.2.s:
pitṛśarmāpi manasā dhyātvā dāmodaraṃ harim ..
himālayaṃ giriṃ prāpya yogadhyānaparo'bhavat .. 33 ..
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe pratisargaṃ parvaṇi caturyugakhaṇḍāparaparyāye kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccaye triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 30 .. cha ..
agrimapuṭam
pūrvapuṭam
3.2.d:
पितृशर्मापि मनसा ध्यात्वा दामोदरं हरिम् ॥
हिमालयं गिरिं प्राप्य योगध्यानपरोऽभवत् ॥ 33 ॥
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे प्रतिसर्गं पर्वणि चतुर्युगखण्डापरपर्याये कलियुगीयेतिहाससमुच्चये त्रिंशोऽध्यायः ॥ 30 ॥ छ ॥
अग्रिमपुटम्
पूर्वपुटम्
3.2.m:
Pitṛśarman also, meditating with his mind on Hari, Dāmodara, / reached the Himālaya mountain and became intent on yoga and meditation.
Thus ends the thirtieth chapter in the Kali-era compendium of history, in the section on the four ages, in the Pratisargaparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Next page.
Previous page.

3.2.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
bhagavansarvatīrthānāṃ dānānāṃ kiṃ paraṃ smṛtam ..
yatkṛtvā ca kalau ghore parāṃ nirvṛtimāpnuyāt .. 1 ..
3.2.d:
॥ ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ ॥
भगवन्सर्वतीर्थानां दानानां किं परं स्मृतम् ॥
यत्कृत्वा च कलौ घोरे परां निर्वृतिमाप्नुयात् ॥ 1 ॥
3.2.m: The sages said: / "O blessed one, what is remembered as the highest of all sacred fords and gifts, / by doing which in the terrible Kali [age] one may attain supreme beatitude?"

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
sāmanasya sutaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pāṇinirnāma viśrutaḥ ..
kaṇabhugvaraśiṣyaiśca śāstrajñaiḥ sa parājitaḥ .. 2 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
सामनस्य सुतः श्रेष्ठः पाणिनिर्नाम विश्रुतः ॥
कणभुग्वरशिष्यैश्च शास्त्रज्ञैः स पराजितः ॥ 2 ॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / "There was an excellent son of Sāmana, celebrated by the name of Pāṇini; / he was defeated by the excellent disciples of Kaṇabhuj who were knowledgeable in the śāstras.

3.2.s:
lajjitaḥ pāṇinistatra gatastīrthāntaraṃ prati ..
snātvā sarvāṇi tīrthāni saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ..3..
3.2.d:
लज्जितः पाणिनिस्तत्र गतस्तीर्थान्तरं प्रति ॥
स्नात्वा सर्वाणि तीर्थानि संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः ॥3॥
3.2.m: Ashamed, Pāṇini then went towards various sacred fords. / Having bathed at all the sacred fords and gratified the ancestors and the deities,

3.2.s:
kedāramudakaṃ pītvā śivadhyānaparo'bhavat ..
parṇāśī saptadivasāñjalabhakṣastato'bhavat .. 4 ..
3.2.d:
केदारमुदकं पीत्वा शिवध्यानपरोऽभवत् ॥
पर्णाशी सप्तदिवसाञ्जलभक्षस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ 4 ॥
3.2.m: and having drunk the water of Kedāra, he became intent on meditating upon Śiva. / For seven days he fed on leaves, and then he fed on water.

3.2.s:
tato daśadinānte sa vāyubhakṣo daśāhani ..
aṣṭāviṃśaddine rudro varaṃ brūhi vaco'bravīt .. 5 ..
3.2.d:
ततो दशदिनान्ते स वायुभक्षो दशाहनि ॥
अष्टाविंशद्दिने रुद्रो वरं ब्रूहि वचोऽब्रवीत् ॥ 5 ॥
3.2.m: Then, after ten days, he fed on air for ten days. / On the twenty-eighth day, Rudra spoke the word: 'Choose a boon!'

3.2.s:
śrutvāmṛtamayaṃ vākyamastaudgadgadayā girā ..
sarveśaṃ sarvaliṃgeśaṃ girijāvallabhaṃ haram .. 6..
3.2.d:
श्रुत्वामृतमयं वाक्यमस्तौद्गद्गदया गिरा ॥
सर्वेशं सर्वलिंगेशं गिरिजावल्लभं हरम् ॥ 6॥
3.2.m: Hearing that speech full of nectar, with a choked voice he praised / Hara, the lord of all, the lord of all liṅgas, the beloved of the mountain's daughter.

3.2.s:
.. pāṇiniruvāca .. ..
namo rudrāya mahate sarveśāya hitaiṣiṇe ..
nandīsaṃsthāya devāya vidyābhayakarāya ca .. 7 ..
3.2.d:
॥ पाणिनिरुवाच ॥ ॥
नमो रुद्राय महते सर्वेशाय हितैषिणे ॥
नन्दीसंस्थाय देवाय विद्याभयकराय च ॥ 7 ॥
3.2.m: Pāṇini said: / 'Homage to great Rudra, the lord of all, who wishes well, / to the god who resides on Nandin, who grants knowledge and freedom from fear;

3.2.s:
pāpāntakāya bhargāya namonantāya vedhase ..
namo māyāhareśāya namaste lokaśaṃkara .. 8 ..
3.2.d:
पापान्तकाय भर्गाय नमोनन्ताय वेधसे ॥
नमो मायाहरेशाय नमस्ते लोकशंकर ॥ 8 ॥
3.2.m: to Bharga, the destroyer of sins; homage to the infinite creator; / homage to the lord who removes delusion; homage to you, O benefactor of the world!

3.2.s:
yadi prasanno deveśa vidyāmūlaprado bhava ..
paraṃ tīrthaṃ hi me dehi dvaimāturapitarnamaḥ .. 9 ..
3.2.d:
यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश विद्यामूलप्रदो भव ॥
परं तीर्थं हि मे देहि द्वैमातुरपितर्नमः ॥ 9 ॥
3.2.m: If you are pleased, O lord of the gods, grant the root of knowledge; / give me indeed the supreme sacred ford; homage to you, father of the two-mothered one!'

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ...
iti śrutvā mahādevaḥ sūtrāṇi pradadau mudā ..
sarvavarṇamayānyeva aiuṇādiśubhāni vai .. 3.2.31.10 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥।
इति श्रुत्वा महादेवः सूत्राणि प्रददौ मुदा ॥
सर्ववर्णमयान्येव ऐउणादिशुभानि वै ॥ 3.2.31.10 ॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / Hearing this, Mahādeva joyfully gave the sūtras / made of all phonemes, auspicious, beginning with 'a-i-uṇ'.

3.2.s:
jñānahrade satyajale rāga dveṣamalāpahe ..
yaḥ prāpto mānase tīrthe sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhajet ..11..
3.2.d:
ज्ञानह्रदे सत्यजले राग द्वेषमलापहे ॥
यः प्राप्तो मानसे तीर्थे सर्वतीर्थफलं भजेत् ॥11॥
3.2.m: "He who reaches the mental sacred ford, the lake of knowledge with water of truth / that removes the impurity of passion and hatred, attains the fruit of all sacred fords.

3.2.s:
mānasaṃ hi mahattīrtha brahmadarśanakārakam ..
pāṇine te dadau vipra kṛtakṛtyo bhavānbhava .. 12 ..
3.2.d:
मानसं हि महत्तीर्थ ब्रह्मदर्शनकारकम् ॥
पाणिने ते ददौ विप्र कृतकृत्यो भवान्भव ॥ 12 ॥
3.2.m: Indeed, the Mānasa is a great sacred ford that brings about the vision of Brahman. / O brāhmaṇa Pāṇini, I have given it to you; may you have fulfilled your purpose!"

3.2.s:
ityuktvāṃtardadhe rudraḥ pāṇiniḥ svagṛhaṃ yayau ..
sūtrapāṭhaṃ dhātupāṭhaṃ gaṇapāṭhaṃ tathaiva ca .. 13 ..
3.2.d:
इत्युक्त्वांतर्दधे रुद्रः पाणिनिः स्वगृहं ययौ ॥
सूत्रपाठं धातुपाठं गणपाठं तथैव च ॥ 13 ॥
3.2.m: Having said this, Rudra vanished; Pāṇini went to his own home. / Composing the Sūtrapāṭha, the Dhātupāṭha, and likewise the Gaṇapāṭha,

3.2.s:
liṃgasūtraṃ tathā kṛtvā paraṃ nirvāṇamāpta vān ..
tasmāttvaṃ bhārgavaśreṣṭha mānasaṃ tīrthamācara .. 14 ..
3.2.d:
लिंगसूत्रं तथा कृत्वा परं निर्वाणमाप्त वान् ॥
तस्मात्त्वं भार्गवश्रेष्ठ मानसं तीर्थमाचर ॥ 14 ॥
3.2.m: and likewise the Liṅgasūtra, he attained supreme nirvāṇa. / Therefore, O best of the Bhārgavas, practice the mental sacred ford,

3.2.s:
yato yātā svayaṃ gaṃgā sarvatīrthamayī śivā ..
gaṃgātīrthātparaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhavi ṣyati .. 15 .. ..
3.2.d:
यतो याता स्वयं गंगा सर्वतीर्थमयी शिवा ॥
गंगातीर्थात्परं तीर्थं न भूतं न भवि ष्यति ॥ 15 ॥ ॥
3.2.m: from which Gaṅgā herself, auspicious, embodying all sacred fords, issued. / There has been no sacred ford higher than the Gaṅgā ford, nor will there be.

3.2.s: iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe pratisargaparvaṇi caturyugakhaṇḍāparaparyāye kaliyugīyetihāsasamuccaya ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 31 .. ..
3.2.d: इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे प्रतिसर्गपर्वणि चतुर्युगखण्डापरपर्याये कलियुगीयेतिहाससमुच्चय एकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः ॥ 31 ॥ ॥
3.2.m: Thus ends the thirty-first chapter in the Kali-era compendium of history, in the section on the four ages, in the Pratisargaparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
totādaryāṃ dvijaḥ kaścidbopadeva iti śrutaḥ ..
babhūva kṛṣṇabhaktaśca vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ .. 1 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
तोतादर्यां द्विजः कश्चिद्बोपदेव इति श्रुतः ॥
बभूव कृष्णभक्तश्च वेदवेदांगपारगः ॥ 1 ॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / At Totādri there was a certain twice-born known as Bopadeva; / he was a devotee of Kṛṣṇa and had mastered the Vedas and their auxiliary sciences.

3.2.s:
gatvā vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ gopagopīniṣevitam ..
manasā pūjayāmāsa devadevaṃ janārddanam .. 2 ..
3.2.d:
गत्वा वृन्दावनं रम्यं गोपगोपीनिषेवितम् ॥
मनसा पूजयामास देवदेवं जनार्द्दनम् ॥ 2 ॥
3.2.m: Having gone to delightful Vṛndāvana, frequented by cowherds and cowherdesses, / he worshipped in his mind Janārdana, the god of gods.

3.2.s:
varṣānte ca hariḥ sākṣāddadau jñānamanuttamam ..
tena jñānena saṃprāptā hṛdi bhāgavatī kathā .. 3 ..
3.2.d:
वर्षान्ते च हरिः साक्षाद्ददौ ज्ञानमनुत्तमम् ॥
तेन ज्ञानेन संप्राप्ता हृदि भागवती कथा ॥ 3 ॥
3.2.m: And at the end of a year, Hari in person bestowed upon him unexcelled knowledge; / by that knowledge, the narrative of the Bhāgavata was received in his heart.

3.2.s:
śukena varṇitā yā vai viṣṇurātāya dhīmate ..
tāṃ kathāṃ varṇayāmāsa mokṣamūrtiṃ sanātanīm .. 4 ..
3.2.d:
शुकेन वर्णिता या वै विष्णुराताय धीमते ॥
तां कथां वर्णयामास मोक्षमूर्तिं सनातनीम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.2.m: He described that very narrative, the eternal embodiment of liberation, / which was recounted by Śuka to the wise Viṣṇurāta.

3.2.s:
kathānte bhagavānviṣṇuḥ prādurāsījjanārdanaḥ ..
uvāca snigdhayā vācā varaṃ brūhi mahāmate .. 5 ..
3.2.d:
कथान्ते भगवान्विष्णुः प्रादुरासीज्जनार्दनः ॥
उवाच स्निग्धया वाचा वरं ब्रूहि महामते ॥ 5 ॥
3.2.m: At the conclusion of the narrative, the blessed Lord Viṣṇu Janārdana manifested; / he said in an affectionate voice: 'Choose a boon, O noble-minded one!'

3.2.s:
.. bopadeva uvāca .. ..
namaste bhagavanviṣṇo lokānugrahakāraka ..
tvayā tatamidaṃ viśvaṃ devatiryaṅnarādikam .. 6 ..
3.2.d:
॥ बोपदेव उवाच ॥ ॥
नमस्ते भगवन्विष्णो लोकानुग्रहकारक ॥
त्वया ततमिदं विश्वं देवतिर्यङ्नरादिकम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.2.m: Bopadeva said: / 'Homage to you, blessed Viṣṇu, who grant grace to the worlds; / by you this universe—gods, animals, men, and the rest—is pervaded.

3.2.s:
tvannāmnā narakārtāśca te kṛtārthāḥ kalau yuge ..
tvayā dattaṃ bhāgavataṃ śrīma dvyāsena nirmitam ..
māhātmyaṃ tasya me brūhi yadi datto varastvayā .. 7 ..
3.2.d:
त्वन्नाम्ना नरकार्ताश्च ते कृतार्थाः कलौ युगे ॥
त्वया दत्तं भागवतं श्रीम द्व्यासेन निर्मितम् ॥
माहात्म्यं तस्य मे ब्रूहि यदि दत्तो वरस्त्वया ॥ 7 ॥
3.2.m: By your name, those tormented in hell have achieved their purpose in the Kali age. / You gave the Bhāgavata composed by glorious Vyāsa; / tell me its greatness, if a boon is granted by you.'

3.2.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
ekadā bhagavānrudro bhavānyā saha śaṃkaraḥ .. 8 ..
3.2.d:
॥ श्रीभगवानुवाच ॥ ॥
एकदा भगवान्रुद्रो भवान्या सह शंकरः ॥ 8 ॥
3.2.m: The blessed Lord said: / Once the blessed Rudra, Śaṅkara, together with Bhavānī—

3.2.s:
bauddharājye jagatprāpte daṃbhapākhaṇḍanirmite ..
dṛṣṭvā kāśyāṃ bhūmituṃgaṃ praṇanāma mudā yutaḥ ..
jaya saccidānanda vibho jagadānaṃ dakāraka .. 9 ..
3.2.d:
बौद्धराज्ये जगत्प्राप्ते दंभपाखण्डनिर्मिते ॥
दृष्ट्वा काश्यां भूमितुंगं प्रणनाम मुदा युतः ॥
जय सच्चिदानन्द विभो जगदानं दकारक ॥ 9 ॥
3.2.m: when the world had fallen into the Buddhist kingdom produced by deceit and heresy— / seeing an elevation of ground at Kāśī, bowed down full of joy: / 'Victory to the all-pervading Being-Consciousness-Bliss, who causes bliss to the world!'

3.2.s:
iti śrutvā śivā prāha ko devo'sti tavottamaḥ ..
sa hovāca mahādevi yajñaḥ saptāhamatra vai .. 3.2.32.10 ..
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वा शिवा प्राह को देवोऽस्ति तवोत्तमः ॥
स होवाच महादेवि यज्ञः सप्ताहमत्र वै ॥ 3.2.32.10 ॥
3.2.m: Hearing this, Śivā said: 'What god is superior to you?' / He said: 'O great goddess, a seven-day sacrificial rite [was held] here indeed.

3.2.s:
tasmādbhūmipavitratvamiha prāptaṃ varānane ..
sarvatīrthādhikatvaṃ ca svayaṃ brahma sanātanam .. 11 ..
3.2.d:
तस्माद्भूमिपवित्रत्वमिह प्राप्तं वरानने ॥
सर्वतीर्थाधिकत्वं च स्वयं ब्रह्म सनातनम् ॥ 11 ॥
3.2.m: Therefore the sanctity of the ground has been attained here, O fair-faced lady, / as well as superiority over all sacred fords; it is the eternal Brahman itself.'

3.2.s:
iti śrutvā śivā devī prāptāsīdguhyakālayam ..
rudreṇa sahitā tatra bhūmiśuddhimakārayat .. 12 ..
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वा शिवा देवी प्राप्तासीद्गुह्यकालयम् ॥
रुद्रेण सहिता तत्र भूमिशुद्धिमकारयत् ॥ 12 ॥
3.2.m: Hearing this, the goddess Śivā went to the abode of the Guhyakas; / together with Rudra, she performed the purification of the ground there.

3.2.s:
caṇḍīśaśca gaṇeśaśca naṃdino guha eva ca ..
rakṣārthe sthāpitāstatra devadevena bho dvija .. 13 ..
3.2.d:
चण्डीशश्च गणेशश्च नंदिनो गुह एव च ॥
रक्षार्थे स्थापितास्तत्र देवदेवेन भो द्विज ॥ 13 ॥
3.2.m: Caṇḍīśa, Gaṇeśa, the Nandins, and Guha / were established there for protection by the god of gods, O twice-born.

3.2.s:
śṛṇu devi kathāṃ ramyāṃ mama mānasasaṃsthitām ..
ityuktvā dhyānamāsthāya saptāhena svavarṇayat .. 14 ..
3.2.d:
शृणु देवि कथां रम्यां मम मानससंस्थिताम् ॥
इत्युक्त्वा ध्यानमास्थाय सप्ताहेन स्ववर्णयत् ॥ 14 ॥
3.2.m: 'Listen, O goddess, to the delightful narrative situated within my mind.' / Having said this and entered into meditation, he described it himself over seven days.

3.2.s:
aṣṭāhe netra unmīlya dṛṣṭvā nidrāgatāṃ śivām ..
bodhayāmāsa bhagavānkathāṃte lokaśaṃkaraḥ .. 15 ..
3.2.d:
अष्टाहे नेत्र उन्मील्य दृष्ट्वा निद्रागतां शिवाम् ॥
बोधयामास भगवान्कथांते लोकशंकरः ॥ 15 ॥
3.2.m: Opening his eyes on the eighth day and seeing that Śivā had fallen asleep, / the blessed Lord, the benefactor of the world, awakened her at the conclusion of the narrative.

3.2.s:
kiyatī te śrutā gāthā śrutvāha jagadaṃbikā ..
sudhāmaṃthanaparyaṃtaṃ caritraṃ śivayeritam .. 16 ..
3.2.d:
कियती ते श्रुता गाथा श्रुत्वाह जगदंबिका ॥
सुधामंथनपर्यंतं चरित्रं शिवयेरितम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.2.m: 'How much of the story did you hear?' Having heard [this], the mother of the universe said: / 'Up to the churning for the nectar of immortality was the deed heard by Śivā.'

3.2.s:
koṭarasthaḥ śukaḥ śrutvā ciraṃjīvatvamāgataḥ ..
pārvatyā rakṣitosau vai śukaḥ paramasundaraḥ .. 17 ..
3.2.d:
कोटरस्थः शुकः श्रुत्वा चिरंजीवत्वमागतः ॥
पार्वत्या रक्षितोसौ वै शुकः परमसुन्दरः ॥ 17 ॥
3.2.m: A parrot dwelling in a hollow, having heard it, attained immortality; / protected indeed by Pārvatī, that parrot was exceedingly beautiful.

3.2.s:
sthitvā śivasya sadane mama dhyānaparo'bhavat ..
mamājñayā śukaḥ sākṣāttvadīyahṛdayasthitaḥ .. 18 ..
3.2.d:
स्थित्वा शिवस्य सदने मम ध्यानपरोऽभवत् ॥
ममाज्ञया शुकः साक्षात्त्वदीयहृदयस्थितः ॥ 18 ॥
3.2.m: Remaining in the abode of Śiva, he became intent on meditating upon me; / by my command, that very Śuka took his place in your heart.

3.2.s:
tena prāptaṃ bhāgavataṃ māhātmyaṃ cāsya durlabham ..
tvaṃ vai gaṃdharvasenāya pitre vikramabhūpateḥ .. 19 ..
3.2.d:
तेन प्राप्तं भागवतं माहात्म्यं चास्य दुर्लभम् ॥
त्वं वै गंधर्वसेनाय पित्रे विक्रमभूपतेः ॥ 19 ॥
3.2.m: By him the Bhāgavata was attained, and its hard-to-obtain greatness. / You, having reached the bank of the Narmadā, must recite

3.2.s:
narmadākūlamāsādya śrāvayasva kathāṃ śubhām ..
harimāhātmyadānaṃ hi sarvadānaparaṃ smṛtam .. 3.2.32.20 ..
3.2.d:
नर्मदाकूलमासाद्य श्रावयस्व कथां शुभाम् ॥
हरिमाहात्म्यदानं हि सर्वदानपरं स्मृतम् ॥ 3.2.32.20 ॥
3.2.m: this auspicious narrative to Gandharvasena, the father of King Vikrama; / for the gift of Hari's greatness is remembered as superior to all gifts."

3.2.s:
satpātrāya pradātavyaṃ viṣṇubhaktāya dhīmate ..
bubhukṣitānnadānaṃ ca taddānasya samaṃ na hi .. 21 ..
3.2.d:
सत्पात्राय प्रदातव्यं विष्णुभक्ताय धीमते ॥
बुभुक्षितान्नदानं च तद्दानस्य समं न हि ॥ 21 ॥
3.2.m: It should be given to a worthy recipient, a wise devotee of Viṣṇu; / indeed, giving food to the hungry does not equal that gift.

3.2.s: ityuktvāṃtardadhe devo bopadevaḥ prasannadhīḥ .. 22 ..
3.2.d: इत्युक्त्वांतर्दधे देवो बोपदेवः प्रसन्नधीः ॥ 22 ॥
3.2.m: Having spoken thus, the divine Bopadeva, with a gratified mind, disappeared.

3.2.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
vāgjaṃ karma smṛtaṃ sūta veda pāṭhaḥ sanātanaḥ ..
bahutvātsarvavedānāṃ śrotumicchāmahe vayam .. 1 ..
3.2.d:
॥ ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ ॥
वाग्जं कर्म स्मृतं सूत वेद पाठः सनातनः ॥
बहुत्वात्सर्ववेदानां श्रोतुमिच्छामहे वयम् ॥ 1 ॥
3.2.m: The sages said: / Action born of speech is declared, O Sūta, to be the eternal recitation of the Veda; / because of the vastness of all the Vedas, we wish to hear:

3.2.s:
kena stotreṇa vedānāṃ pāṭhasya phalamāpnuyāt ..
pāpāni vilayaṃ yāṃti tanme vada vicakṣaṇa .. 2 ..
3.2.d:
केन स्तोत्रेण वेदानां पाठस्य फलमाप्नुयात् ॥
पापानि विलयं यांति तन्मे वद विचक्षण ॥ 2 ॥
3.2.m: By which hymn does one obtain the fruit of reciting the Vedas, / [and] sins dissolve away? Tell me that, O wise one!

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
vikramādityarājye tu dvijaḥ kaścidabhūdbhuvi ..
vyādhakarmeti vikhyāto brāhmaṇyāṃ śūdrato'bhavat .. .. 3 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
विक्रमादित्यराज्ये तु द्विजः कश्चिदभूद्भुवि ॥
व्याधकर्मेति विख्यातो ब्राह्मण्यां शूद्रतोऽभवत् ॥ ॥ 3 ॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / In the kingdom of Vikramāditya, there was a certain twice-born on earth; / renowned as Vyādhakarma, he was born of a Śūdra upon a brāhmaṇa woman.

3.2.s:
tripāṭhino dvijasyaiva bhāryā nāmnā hi kāminī ..
maithunecchāvatī nityaṃ madāghūrṇitalocanā .. 4 ..
3.2.d:
त्रिपाठिनो द्विजस्यैव भार्या नाम्ना हि कामिनी ॥
मैथुनेच्छावती नित्यं मदाघूर्णितलोचना ॥ 4 ॥
3.2.m: A twice-born named Tripāṭhī had a wife named Kāminī; / she was always desirous of sexual union, her eyes rolling with passion.

3.2.s:
dvijassaptaśatīpāṭhe vṛttyarthī karhicidgataḥ ..
grāme devalake ramye vahuvaiśyaniṣevite .. 5 ..
3.2.d:
द्विजस्सप्तशतीपाठे वृत्त्यर्थी कर्हिचिद्गतः ॥
ग्रामे देवलके रम्ये वहुवैश्यनिषेविते ॥ 5 ॥
3.2.m: Once, seeking a livelihood by reciting the Saptaśatī, the twice-born went / to the lovely village of Devalaka, inhabited by many vaiśyas.

3.2.s:
tatra māso gataḥ kālo nāyayau sa svamaṃdiram ..
tadā tu kāminī duṣṭā rūpayauvanasaṃyutā .. 6 ..
3.2.d:
तत्र मासो गतः कालो नाययौ स स्वमंदिरम् ॥
तदा तु कामिनी दुष्टा रूपयौवनसंयुता ॥ 6 ॥
3.2.m: A month’s time passed there, and he did not return to his own home; / then the wicked Kāminī, endowed with beauty and youth,

3.2.s:
dṛṣṭvā niṣādaṃ sabalaṃ kāṣṭhabhāropajīvinam ..
tasmai dattvā pañca mudrā bubhuje kāmapīḍitā .. 7 ..
3.2.d:
दृष्ट्वा निषादं सबलं काष्ठभारोपजीविनम् ॥
तस्मै दत्त्वा पञ्च मुद्रा बुभुजे कामपीडिता ॥ 7 ॥
3.2.m: seeing a strong Niṣāda who made his living carrying loads of firewood, / gave him five coins and, afflicted by desire, enjoyed [him].

3.2.s:
tadā garbhaṃ dadhau sā ca vyādhivīryeṇa saṃci tam ..
putro'bhūddaśamāsāṃte jātakarma pitākarot .. 8 ..
3.2.d:
तदा गर्भं दधौ सा च व्याधिवीर्येण संचि तम् ॥
पुत्रोऽभूद्दशमासांते जातकर्म पिताकरोत् ॥ 8 ॥
3.2.m: Then she conceived a womb gathered from the seed of the hunter; / at the end of ten months a son was born, and the father performed the birth rites.

3.2.s:
dvādaśābde gate kāle sa dhūrto vedavarjitaḥ ..
vyādhakarmakaro nityaṃ vyādhakarmā hyatobhavat.. .. 9 ..
3.2.d:
द्वादशाब्दे गते काले स धूर्तो वेदवर्जितः ॥
व्याधकर्मकरो नित्यं व्याधकर्मा ह्यतोभवत्॥ ॥ 9 ॥
3.2.m: When twelve years had passed, he became a rogue devoid of the Veda, / always doing the work of a hunter; hence he was called Vyādhakarmā.

3.2.s:
niṣkāsitau dvijenaiva mātṛputrau dvijādhamau ..
tripāṭhī brahmacaryaṃ tu kṛtavāndharmatatparaḥ .. 3.2.33.10 ..
3.2.d:
निष्कासितौ द्विजेनैव मातृपुत्रौ द्विजाधमौ ॥
त्रिपाठी ब्रह्मचर्यं तु कृतवान्धर्मतत्परः ॥ 3.2.33.10 ॥
3.2.m: Mother and son, the lowest of the twice-born, were driven out by that very twice-born; / and Tripāṭhī, devoted to righteousness, practiced celibacy.

3.2.s:
pratyahaṃ caṃḍikāpāṭhaṃ kṛtvā viṃdhyagirau vasan ..
jīvanmuktobhavacchīghraṃ jagadaṃbāprasādataḥ .. 11 ..
3.2.d:
प्रत्यहं चंडिकापाठं कृत्वा विंध्यगिरौ वसन् ॥
जीवन्मुक्तोभवच्छीघ्रं जगदंबाप्रसादतः ॥ 11 ॥
3.2.m: Reciting the hymn to Caṇḍikā every day while living on the Vindhya mountain, / he quickly became liberated while living by the grace of the Mother of the Universe.

3.2.s:
niṣādasya gṛhe cobhau vane gatvoṣaturmudā ..
pratyahaṃ jārabhāvena bahudravyamupārjitam .. .. 12 ..
3.2.d:
निषादस्य गृहे चोभौ वने गत्वोषतुर्मुदा ॥
प्रत्यहं जारभावेन बहुद्रव्यमुपार्जितम् ॥ ॥ 12 ॥
3.2.m: And both of them went to the forest to live gladly in the house of the Niṣāda; / every day, through adultery, much wealth was acquired.

3.2.s:
vyādhakarmā tu cauryeṇa pitṛmātṛpriyaṃkaraḥ ..
ekadā daivayogena śivāmaṃdiramāyayau .. 13 ..
3.2.d:
व्याधकर्मा तु चौर्येण पितृमातृप्रियंकरः ॥
एकदा दैवयोगेन शिवामंदिरमाययौ ॥ 13 ॥
3.2.m: Vyādhakarmā, pleasing his mother and [step]father by theft, / once by the turn of fate came to a temple of Śivā.

3.2.s:
cauravṛttiparo dhūrtaḥ striyā bhūṣaṇamāharat ..
kaiścijjātaḥ sa nī? dhūrto bahumāyāviśāradaḥ .. 14 ..
3.2.d:
चौरवृत्तिपरो धूर्तः स्त्रिया भूषणमाहरत् ॥
कैश्चिज्जातः स नी? धूर्तो बहुमायाविशारदः ॥ 14 ॥
3.2.m: Devoted to the profession of stealing, the rogue snatched the ornament of a woman; / he had become a rogue, skilled in many deceptions.

3.2.s:
kadācitprāptavāṃstatra dvijavastrasamudgatam ..
śrutamādicaritraṃ hi tena śabdapriyeṇa vai .. 15 ..
3.2.d:
कदाचित्प्राप्तवांस्तत्र द्विजवस्त्रसमुद्गतम् ॥
श्रुतमादिचरित्रं हि तेन शब्दप्रियेण वै ॥ 15 ॥
3.2.m: At some time he found there [a book] taken from a twice-born's garment; / fond of the words, he heard the First Episode [of the Devīmāhātmya].

3.2.s:
pāṭhapuṇyaprabhāveṇa dharmabuddhistato'bhavat ..
dattvā cauryadhanaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai viprāya pāṭhine .. 16 ..
3.2.d:
पाठपुण्यप्रभावेण धर्मबुद्धिस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
दत्त्वा चौर्यधनं सर्वं तस्मै विप्राय पाठिने ॥ 16 ॥
3.2.m: By the power of the merit of that recitation, an inclination toward righteousness arose in him; / giving all his stolen wealth to that twice-born reciter,

3.2.s:
śiṣyatvamagamattatrākṣaramaiśaṃ jajāpa ha ..
bījamaṃtraprabhāveṇa tadaṃgātpāpamulbaṇam .. 17 ..
3.2.d:
शिष्यत्वमगमत्तत्राक्षरमैशं जजाप ह ॥
बीजमंत्रप्रभावेण तदंगात्पापमुल्बणम् ॥ 17 ॥
3.2.m: he became his disciple there and chanted the syllable of the Lord; / by the power of the seed-mantra, dreadful sin from his body

3.2.s:
niḥsṛtaṃ kṛmirūpeṇa bahuvarṇena tāpitam ..
trivarṣānte ca niṣpāpo babhūva dvijasattamaḥ .. 16 ..
3.2.d:
निःसृतं कृमिरूपेण बहुवर्णेन तापितम् ॥
त्रिवर्षान्ते च निष्पापो बभूव द्विजसत्तमः ॥ 16 ॥
3.2.m: came forth in the form of worms of many colours, burnt [away]; / and at the end of three years, that best of the twice-born became sinless.

3.2.s:
paṭhitvākṣaramālāṃ ca jajāpādicaritrakam ..
dvādaśābdamite kāle kāśyāṃ gatvā sa tu dvijaḥ .. 19 ..
3.2.d:
पठित्वाक्षरमालां च जजापादिचरित्रकम् ॥
द्वादशाब्दमिते काले काश्यां गत्वा स तु द्विजः ॥ 19 ॥
3.2.m: Having recited the garland of syllables, he chanted the First Episode; / when a period of twelve years had elapsed, that twice-born went to Kāśī,

3.2.s:
annapūrṇāṃ mahādevīṃ tuṣṭāva parayā mudā ..
rocanādyaiśca saṃpūjyāṃ munidevaniṣevitām .. 3.2.33.20 ..
3.2.d:
अन्नपूर्णां महादेवीं तुष्टाव परया मुदा ॥
रोचनाद्यैश्च संपूज्यां मुनिदेवनिषेविताम् ॥ 3.2.33.20 ॥
3.2.m: and with supreme joy praised Annapūrṇā, the Great Goddess, / who is to be worshipped with yellow pigment and the like, and served by sages and gods:

3.2.s:
nityānaṃdakarī parābhayakarī sauṃdaryaratnākarī nirdhūtākhilapāpapāvanakarī kāśīpurādhīśvarī ..
nānālokakarī mahābhayaharī viśvaṃbharī sundarī vidyāṃ dehi kṛpāvalaṃbanakarī mātānnapūrṇeśvarī .. 21 ..
3.2.d:
नित्यानंदकरी पराभयकरी सौंदर्यरत्नाकरी निर्धूताखिलपापपावनकरी काशीपुराधीश्वरी ॥
नानालोककरी महाभयहरी विश्वंभरी सुन्दरी विद्यां देहि कृपावलंबनकरी मातान्नपूर्णेश्वरी ॥ 21 ॥
3.2.m: “O giver of eternal bliss, giver of supreme fearlessness, mine of jewels of beauty, / washer of all sins, purifier, sovereign lady of the city of Kāśī! / O creator of various worlds, remover of great fear, all-supporting, beautiful one, / bestow knowledge, O Mother Annapūrṇeśvarī, you who grant the support of your grace!”

3.2.s:
sa ityaṣṭottaraṃ japtvā dhyānastimitalocanaḥ ..
suṣvāpa tatra muditaḥ svapne prādurabhūcchivā .. 22 ..
3.2.d:
स इत्यष्टोत्तरं जप्त्वा ध्यानस्तिमितलोचनः ॥
सुष्वाप तत्र मुदितः स्वप्ने प्रादुरभूच्छिवा ॥ 22 ॥
3.2.m: Having chanted thus one hundred and eight times, his eyes motionless in meditation, / he fell asleep there joyfully; in a dream Śivā appeared to him.

3.2.s:
dattvā tasmai hi ṛgvidyāṃ punaraṃtaradhīyata ..
utthāya sa dvijo dhīmām̐llabdhvā vidyāmanuttamām .. 23 ..
3.2.d:
दत्त्वा तस्मै हि ऋग्विद्यां पुनरंतरधीयत ॥
उत्थाय स द्विजो धीमाम्̐ल्लब्ध्वा विद्यामनुत्तमाम् ॥ 23 ॥
3.2.m: Having given him the knowledge of the Ṛgveda, she disappeared again; / rising up, that wise twice-born, having obtained unexcelled knowledge,

3.2.s:
vikramādityabhūpasya yajñācāryo babhūva ha ..
yajñāṃte yogamāsthāya jagāma tu himālayam .. 24 ..
3.2.d:
विक्रमादित्यभूपस्य यज्ञाचार्यो बभूव ह ॥
यज्ञांते योगमास्थाय जगाम तु हिमालयम् ॥ 24 ॥
3.2.m: became the master of the sacrifice for King Vikramāditya; / and at the conclusion of the sacrifice, resorting to yoga, he went to the Himālayas.

3.2.s:
etatte varṇitaṃ vipra puṇyamādicaritrakam ..
brahmībhūya yathā vipro lebhe siddhimanuttamām .. 25 ..
3.2.d:
एतत्ते वर्णितं विप्र पुण्यमादिचरित्रकम् ॥
ब्रह्मीभूय यथा विप्रो लेभे सिद्धिमनुत्तमाम् ॥ 25 ॥
3.2.m: This holy First Episode has been described to you, O brāhmaṇa, / how the twice-born, becoming identified with brahman, attained unexcelled perfection.

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ujjayinyāṃ purā vipra rājanyaḥ sarvahiṃsakaḥ ..
babhūva madyamāṃsāśī bhīmavarmeti viśrutaḥ .. 1 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
उज्जयिन्यां पुरा विप्र राजन्यः सर्वहिंसकः ॥
बभूव मद्यमांसाशी भीमवर्मेति विश्रुतः ॥ 1 ॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / Formerly in Ujjayinī, O brāhmaṇa, there was a kṣatriya who killed all beings, / an eater of wine and meat, known as Bhīmavarmā.

3.2.s:
māṃsalobhena sa khalaḥ sūkarāngrāmakukkuṭān ..
hatvā cābhakṣayatpāpī veśyāsaṃgaparāyaṇaḥ .. .. 2 ..
3.2.d:
मांसलोभेन स खलः सूकरान्ग्रामकुक्कुटान् ॥
हत्वा चाभक्षयत्पापी वेश्यासंगपरायणः ॥ ॥ 2 ॥
3.2.m: Greedy for meat, that villain killed pigs and village roosters / and ate them, a sinner devoted to the company of prostitutes.

3.2.s:
naramāṃsaṃ sa kravyādastyaktvānyānbhakṣako'bhavat ..
evaṃ bahugate kāle bhīmavarmā mahādhamaḥ ..
visūcyagnivaśaṃ yāto mamāra ca yuvāpi saḥ .. 3 ..
3.2.d:
नरमांसं स क्रव्यादस्त्यक्त्वान्यान्भक्षकोऽभवत् ॥
एवं बहुगते काले भीमवर्मा महाधमः ॥
विसूच्यग्निवशं यातो ममार च युवापि सः ॥ 3 ॥
3.2.m: Abandoning other [foods], that flesh-eater became a consumer of human meat; / in this way, when much time had passed, the utterly degraded Bhīmavarmā, / fallen under the power of the fire of cholera, died though still young.

3.2.s:
kāritaścaṃḍikāpāṭhastena duṣṭena bhīruṇā ..
tasya puṇyaprabhāvena nāgato narakānprati .. 4 ..
3.2.d:
कारितश्चंडिकापाठस्तेन दुष्टेन भीरुणा ॥
तस्य पुण्यप्रभावेन नागतो नरकान्प्रति ॥ 4 ॥
3.2.m: A recitation of Caṇḍikā had been caused to be performed by that wicked coward; / by the power of its merit, he did not go to the hells.

3.2.s:
punaḥ kṣatratvamagamanmāgadhe sa mahīpatiḥ ..
mahānandīti vikhyāto rājanītiparāyaṇaḥ .. 5 ..
3.2.d:
पुनः क्षत्रत्वमगमन्मागधे स महीपतिः ॥
महानन्दीति विख्यातो राजनीतिपरायणः ॥ 5 ॥
3.2.m: He attained kṣatriyahood again as a king in Magadha, / known as Mahānandī, devoted to royal policy.

3.2.s:
jātismaro babhūvāsau vedadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ..
kātyāyanasya śiṣyo'bhūnmahāśāktasya dhīmataḥ .. 6 ..
3.2.d:
जातिस्मरो बभूवासौ वेदधर्मपरायणः ॥
कात्यायनस्य शिष्योऽभून्महाशाक्तस्य धीमतः ॥ 6 ॥
3.2.m: He became one who remembered his former lives, devoted to Vedic righteousness; / he became a disciple of the wise Kātyāyana, a great Śākta.

3.2.s:
tasmai nṛpāya sa munirdattvā madhyacaritrakam ..
sabījaṃ punarāgatya vindhye śakti paro'bhavat .. 7 ..
3.2.d:
तस्मै नृपाय स मुनिर्दत्त्वा मध्यचरित्रकम् ॥
सबीजं पुनरागत्य विन्ध्ये शक्ति परोऽभवत् ॥ 7 ॥
3.2.m: Having given that king the Middle Episode / along with its seed-mantra, that sage went back to the Vindhyas and was devoted to the Śakti.

3.2.s:
nṛpo'pi pratyahaṃ devīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ sanātanīm ..
rocanādyaiśca saṃpūjya japanmadhyacaritrakam .. 8 ..
3.2.d:
नृपोऽपि प्रत्यहं देवीं महालक्ष्मीं सनातनीम् ॥
रोचनाद्यैश्च संपूज्य जपन्मध्यचरित्रकम् ॥ 8 ॥
3.2.m: The king too, worshipping daily the eternal goddess Mahālakṣmī / with yellow pigment and other offerings, chanted the Middle Episode.

3.2.s:
puṇyakṣetratvamagamanmahāmāyāprasādataḥ ..
śūdrabhāvaṃ parityajya kṣatrabhāvamupāgataḥ .. 9 ..
3.2.d:
पुण्यक्षेत्रत्वमगमन्महामायाप्रसादतः ॥
शूद्रभावं परित्यज्य क्षत्रभावमुपागतः ॥ 9 ॥
3.2.m: By the grace of Mahāmāyā he attained the status of a sacred field; / abandoning the nature of a Śūdra, he attained the nature of a kṣatriya.

3.2.s:
dvādaśābdāṃtare prāptastadguruḥ śaktitatparaḥ ..
lakṣacaṇḍīṃ nṛpādeva kārayāmāsa dharmataḥ .. 3.2.34.10 ..
3.2.d:
द्वादशाब्दांतरे प्राप्तस्तद्गुरुः शक्तितत्परः ॥
लक्षचण्डीं नृपादेव कारयामास धर्मतः ॥ 3.2.34.10 ॥
3.2.m: At the end of twelve years his guru, devoted to the Śakti, arrived, / and caused a Lakṣacaṇḍī [sacrifice] to be duly performed by the king.

3.2.s:
tadā prādurabhūddevī jagadaṃbā sanātanī ..
nṛpāya dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ mokṣaṃ hi cādadāt .. 11 ..
3.2.d:
तदा प्रादुरभूद्देवी जगदंबा सनातनी ॥
नृपाय धर्ममर्थं च कामं मोक्षं हि चाददात् ॥ 11 ॥
3.2.m: Then the eternal goddess, the Mother of the Universe, manifested; / she gave to the king righteousness, wealth, pleasure, and liberation.

3.2.s:
mahānandī mahābhāgo bhuktvā bhogaṃ surepsitam ..
ante jagāma paramaṃ lokaṃ devanamaskṛtam .. 12 ..
3.2.d:
महानन्दी महाभागो भुक्त्वा भोगं सुरेप्सितम् ॥
अन्ते जगाम परमं लोकं देवनमस्कृतम् ॥ 12 ॥
3.2.m: The highly fortunate Mahānandī, having enjoyed pleasures desired by the gods, / in the end went to the supreme realm worshipped by the gods.

3.2.s:
iti te kathitā vipra yatproktaṃ yajuṣo gatiḥ ..
sā vai madhyacaritreṇa prāptā śūdranṛpeṇa vai .. 13 ..
3.2.d:
इति ते कथिता विप्र यत्प्रोक्तं यजुषो गतिः ॥
सा वै मध्यचरित्रेण प्राप्ता शूद्रनृपेण वै ॥ 13 ॥
3.2.m: Thus it has been told to you, O brāhmaṇa: that destination of the Yajurveda which is spoken of / was attained indeed through the Middle Episode by that Śūdra-king.

3.2.s: ityevaṃ varṇitaṃ vipra māhātmyaṃ munivarṇitam .. 14 ..
3.2.d: इत्येवं वर्णितं विप्र माहात्म्यं मुनिवर्णितम् ॥ 14 ॥
3.2.m: In this way, O brāhmaṇa, the greatness described by the sages has been related.

3.2.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
citrakūṭe girau ramye nānādhātuvicitrite ..
tatrāvasanmahāprājña upādhyāyaḥ patañjaliḥ. 1 ..
3.2.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
चित्रकूटे गिरौ रम्ये नानाधातुविचित्रिते ॥
तत्रावसन्महाप्राज्ञ उपाध्यायः पतञ्जलिः। 1 ॥
3.2.m: Sūta said: / On the delightful mountain of Citrakūṭa, variegated with various minerals, / there lived the highly intelligent teacher Patañjali. (1)

3.2.s:
vedavedāṃgatattvajño gītāśāstraparāyaṇaḥ ..
viṣṇubhaktaḥ satyasandho bhāṣyaśāstra viśāradaḥ .. 2 ..
3.2.d:
वेदवेदांगतत्त्वज्ञो गीताशास्त्रपरायणः ॥
विष्णुभक्तः सत्यसन्धो भाष्यशास्त्र विशारदः ॥ 2 ॥
3.2.m: He knew the essential truth of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, was devoted to the scripture of the Gītā, / was a devotee of Viṣṇu, faithful to his word, and skilled in the treatise of the commentary. (2)

3.2.s:
kadācitsa tu śuddhātmā gatastīrthāṃtaraṃ prati ..
kāśyāṃ kātyāyanenaiva tasya vādo mahānabhūt .. 3 ..
3.2.d:
कदाचित्स तु शुद्धात्मा गतस्तीर्थांतरं प्रति ॥
काश्यां कात्यायनेनैव तस्य वादो महानभूत् ॥ 3 ॥
3.2.m: Once that pure-souled one went on a pilgrimage to sacred places. / In Kāśī a great debate arose between him and Kātyāyana. (3)

3.2.s:
varṣānte ca tadā vipro devībhaktena nirjitaḥ ..
lajjitaḥ sa tu dharmātmā saṃtuṣṭāva sarasvatīm .. 4 ..
3.2.d:
वर्षान्ते च तदा विप्रो देवीभक्तेन निर्जितः ॥
लज्जितः स तु धर्मात्मा संतुष्टाव सरस्वतीम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.2.m: At the end of a year, the brāhmaṇa was then defeated by that devotee of the goddess. / Ashamed, that righteous-souled one praised Sarasvatī. (4)

3.2.s:
.. patañjaliruvāca .. ..
namo devyai mahāmūrtyai sarvamūrtyai namo nama ..
śivāyai sarvamāṃgalyai viṣṇumāye ca te namaḥ .. 5 ..
3.2.d:
॥ पतञ्जलिरुवाच ॥ ॥
नमो देव्यै महामूर्त्यै सर्वमूर्त्यै नमो नम ॥
शिवायै सर्वमांगल्यै विष्णुमाये च ते नमः ॥ 5 ॥
3.2.m: Patañjali said: / Obeisance to the goddess of great form, obeisance again and again to her who is all forms! / To Śivā, to her who brings all auspiciousness, and to you, Viṣṇumāyā, obeisance! (5)

3.2.s:
tvameva śraddhā buddhistvaṃ medhā vidyā śivaṃkarī ..
śāṃtirvāṇī tvamevāsi nārāyaṇi namonamaḥ .. 6 ..
3.2.d:
त्वमेव श्रद्धा बुद्धिस्त्वं मेधा विद्या शिवंकरी ॥
शांतिर्वाणी त्वमेवासि नारायणि नमोनमः ॥ 6 ॥
3.2.m: You alone are faith; you are intellect, wisdom, knowledge bringing well-being. / You alone are peace and speech; Nārāyaṇī, obeisance, obeisance to you! (6)

3.2.s:
ityukte sati vipre tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
viprottama caritraṃ me japa caikāgramānasaḥ .. 7 ..
3.2.d:
इत्युक्ते सति विप्रे तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ॥
विप्रोत्तम चरित्रं मे जप चैकाग्रमानसः ॥ 7 ॥
3.2.m: When the brāhmaṇa had spoken thus, a bodiless voice spoke: / "Best of brāhmaṇas, recite my narrative with a one-pointed mind. (7)

3.2.s:
taccaritraprabhāveṇa satyaṃ jñānamavāpsyasi ..
kātyāyanasya viprasya rājasaṃjñānamuddhatam ..
madbhaktyā tena saṃprāptaṃ parājaya patañjale ..8 ..
3.2.d:
तच्चरित्रप्रभावेण सत्यं ज्ञानमवाप्स्यसि ॥
कात्यायनस्य विप्रस्य राजसंज्ञानमुद्धतम् ॥
मद्भक्त्या तेन संप्राप्तं पराजय पतञ्जले ॥8 ॥
3.2.m: By the power of that narrative you will attain true knowledge. / The knowledge of the brāhmaṇa Kātyāyana is haughty and passionate; / it was obtained by him through devotion to me. Defeat him, Patañjali!" (8)

3.2.s:
iti śrutvā vaco devyā vindhyavāsini mandiram ..
gatvā tāṃ pūjayāmāsa tuṣṭāva stotrapāṭhataḥ .. 9 ..
3.2.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो देव्या विन्ध्यवासिनि मन्दिरम् ॥
गत्वा तां पूजयामास तुष्टाव स्तोत्रपाठतः ॥ 9 ॥
3.2.m: Having heard this speech of the goddess, he went to the temple of Vindhyavāsinī, / worshipped her, and praised her by reciting a hymn. (9)

3.2.s:
jñānaṃ prasādajaṃ vipraḥ prāpya viṣṇuparāyaṇam ..
kātyāyanaṃ parājitya parāṃ mudamavāpa ha .. 3.2.35.10 ..
3.2.d:
ज्ञानं प्रसादजं विप्रः प्राप्य विष्णुपरायणम् ॥
कात्यायनं पराजित्य परां मुदमवाप ह ॥ 3.2.35.10 ॥
3.2.m: Having attained knowledge born of her grace, centered on Viṣṇu, / the brāhmaṇa defeated Kātyāyana and obtained supreme joy. (10)

3.2.s:
ūrddhvapuṃḍraṃ ca tilakaṃ tulasīkaṇṭhamālikām ..
kṛṣṇamantraṃ ca śivadaṃ sthāpayitvā gṛhegṛhe .. 11 ..
3.2.d:
ऊर्द्ध्वपुंड्रं च तिलकं तुलसीकण्ठमालिकाम् ॥
कृष्णमन्त्रं च शिवदं स्थापयित्वा गृहेगृहे ॥ 11 ॥
3.2.m: Having established the upward mark and forehead mark, the neck-garland of tulasī, / and the auspicious Kṛṣṇa-mantra in every house (11)

3.2.s:
janejane tathā kṛtvā mahābhāṣya mudairayat ..
ciraṃjīvitvamagamadviṣṇumāyāprasādataḥ .. 12 ..
3.2.d:
जनेजने तथा कृत्वा महाभाष्य मुदैरयत् ॥
चिरंजीवित्वमगमद्विष्णुमायाप्रसादतः ॥ 12 ॥
3.2.m: and among all the people, he proclaimed the Mahābhāṣya. / Through the grace of Viṣṇumāyā he attained long life. (12)

3.2.s:
iti te kathito vipra jāpyānāmuttamo japaḥ ..
kimanyacchrotumicchaṃti śaunakādyā maharṣayaḥ .. 13 ..
3.2.d:
इति ते कथितो विप्र जाप्यानामुत्तमो जपः ॥
किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छंति शौनकाद्या महर्षयः ॥ 13 ॥
3.2.m: Thus has been related to you, O brāhmaṇa, the best recitation among recitations. / What else do the great sages headed by Śaunaka wish to hear? (13)

3.2.s: sarve bhadrāṇi paśyaṃtu mā kaścidduḥkhabhāgbhavet .. 14 ..
3.2.d: सर्वे भद्राणि पश्यंतु मा कश्चिद्दुःखभाग्भवेत् ॥ 14 ॥
3.2.m: May all see auspicious things; may no one experience sorrow! (14)

3.2.s:
maṃgalaṃ bhagavānviṣṇurmaṃgalaṃ garuḍadhvajaḥ ..
maṃgalaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣo maṃgalā yatano hariḥ .. 15 ..
3.2.d:
मंगलं भगवान्विष्णुर्मंगलं गरुडध्वजः ॥
मंगलं पुंडरीकाक्षो मंगला यतनो हरिः ॥ 15 ॥
3.2.m: Auspicious is the Blessed Lord Viṣṇu; auspicious is the one whose banner is Garuḍa. / Auspicious is the lotus-eyed one; Hari is the abode of auspiciousness. (15)

3.2.s:
śuciryo hi naro nityamitihāsasamuccayam ..
śṛṇuyāddharmakāmārthī sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 16 ..
samāpto'yaṃ dvitīyaḥ khaṃḍaḥ..
